notes: Cook chicken over medium heat to prevent spices burning and develop a golden brown crust.
Prepare the samurai sauce and cucumber salad in bulk and store separately. Serve fresh when ready to eat.
Reheat chicken and rice in a pan on low heat, covered, for 5 minutes.

52.intro: This is truly one of the tastiest meal preps i’ve made! Impeccable flavors and everything is made from scratch!

steps.text: Slice the chicken breast cutlets and boneless thighs into halves. Marinate with minced garlic, Gyros spice mix, olive oil, yogurt, lemon juice, and lemon zest. Mix thoroughly until evenly coated.

Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers and place on a lined baking tray. Oven-bake or air-fry at 200°C (400°F) for 25 minutes until golden brown and juicy then set aside covered to rest and keep warm.

Cut the raw potatoes into fries and season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and a drizzle of olive oil. Toss until well coated, then oven-bake or air-fry at 200°C (400°F) for 20–25 minutes until crispy and golden brown. (If space allows, cook the chicken and fries together to save time)
For the tzatziki sauce, mix yogurt, grated cucumber, a pinch of salt, and lemon juice in a bowl. Stir until smooth and creamy, then refrigerate until ready to serve.
To prepare the garlic naan, combine flour, yogurt, salt, garlic powder, and baking powder in a bowl. Mix gently until crumbly, then knead into a smooth dough ball.

Divide the dough into four equal smaller balls, then roll each one out as thin as possible without tearing. Melt a little butter in a pan over medium-low heat and cook the naan for 2–3 minutes per side until golden and fully cooked through.
Roughly chop the cooked chicken into bite-sized cubes. Serve with crispy fries, warm garlic naan, a fresh side salad, and creamy tzatziki sauce. ENJOY!

notes: Marinate the chicken overnight for maximum flavor. Prepare the naan dough in advance to save time.
Air-fry the chicken and fries together if space allows for a quicker cook time.
Make the tzatziki sauce ahead of time and store it in the fridge until ready to serve.
When reheating, keep the salad separate. Reheat the chicken and fries in the air fryer for 5 minutes at 180°C (370°F) for the best texture.

54.intro: Easily the best chicken i’ve made, so easy, low effort and simple to meal prep! Paired perfectly with a side of fluffy mash and creamy sauce.

groups.name: Light & Fluffy Mash
items: 800g Raw White Potatoes peeled and diced into 1 inch chuncks

groups.name: Creamy Cajun Sauce
items: ¾ Tsp Each Salt, Italian Herbs, Chilli Flakes, Garlic, Onion Powder, Parsley, Paprika

steps.text: First get your boneless skinless chicken thighs, season with salt, Italian herbs, chilli flakes, parsley, garlic and onion powder, paprika and olive oil. Mix till well coated and combined
Next peel all your potatoes then slice into chunks. Place them in a pot of cold water then boil for 12-14 mins until fork tender. Drain all the water then cover with a lid for 5 mins to steam
Uncover then mash the potatoes using a masher or ricer till smooth and fluffy. Note - don’t overly mash them!
Next add a knob of room temperature butter with warm milk, salt and garlic powder. Use a spatula to mix everything till smooth and combined
Now place all your chicken thighs flat and evenly spread on a lined sheet pan. Now oven bake or air fry for 22-25mins at 200C / 400F. The chicken should come out golden and charred!
For the cream sauce get a pan on low heat, melt down some butter then add the spice mix consisting of the same spices used for the chicken. Toast the spices for 2 mins in the butter
Add milk followed by cream cheese, parmesan cheese and chopped spinach. Mix gently till everything is melted, thickened and the spinach wilted
Finally when the sauce is ready, chop your chicken into delicious cubes then serve with the mashed potatoes topped with the sauce and ENJOY!

notes: Oven Bake or Air Fry for 22-25mins at 200C / 400F. You can cook these on a pan in some butter too for 4-5 mins each side on medium heat

Toast the spices in butter for 2mins on low heat then add milk, cream cheese, parmesan and spinach. Keep stirring till smooth, creamy and slightly thick. Let this warm up for 3-4 mins and your sauce is ready
Slice your chicken into cubes then serve with the fluffy mash. I recommend storing the creamy sauce separately and serving when ready to eat

56.intro: High Protein Loaded Nachos! Always satisfying and tastes incredible! This can be great as a meal or perfect as a sharing snack platter

groups.name: Nachos
items: 2 Low Calorie Tortilla Wraps Cut Into Triangles
Season With a Pinch of Salt, Garlic Powder, Parsley & Chilli Flakes

groups.name: Salsa
items: 1 Light Mozzarella Slice or Any Other Light Cheese

groups.name: Toppings
items: 30g (1.1oz) Low Fat Shredded Mozzarella or Any Other Cheese
Fat Free Sour Cream or Yogurt

steps.text: Take 2 tortilla wraps and cut them into triangle-shaped pieces using a knife. Place the pieces on a baking tray, spray with oil, and season with salt, garlic powder, parsley, and chili flakes. Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 5 minutes until crisp.

Cut the chicken breast in half, then rub with olive oil, salt, chili powder, paprika, parsley, garlic powder, and cumin until fully coated. Cook over medium heat for 4 minutes on each side, then shred the chicken once cooked.
In a bowl, combine chopped tomato, red onion, avocado, and coriander. Season with salt, pepper, and a squeeze of lime juice, then mix everything together to make a fresh salsa.
Layer the baked tortilla chips with shredded chicken and grated cheese. Return to the oven and bake for 3–4 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and top with the fresh salsa and a dollop of sour cream or yogurt. Serve immediately and enjoy!

58.intro: The flavours are phenomenal! Truly one of the tastiest chicken I’ve made using NO OIL! So simple, low effort and incredibly easy to meal prep.

groups.name: Crunchy & Tangy Cucumber Salad
items: 1 Tsp Red Pepper Flakes or Chilli Flakes (Omit for less heat)

groups.name: To Serve
items: 200g (7oz) Uncooked Basmati Rice (≈130g or 4.6oz cooked rice per serving)

steps.text: Trim any excess fat from your boneless chicken thighs. In a mixing bowl, marinate the chicken with black pepper, garlic & ginger paste, gochujang, sriracha, sesame seeds, and light soy sauce. Mix thoroughly then set aside to marinate.
While the chicken marinates, cook your rice by boiling it or use leftover rice as a time-saving option.

Thinly slice the cucumbers and place them in a bowl. Add salt, minced garlic, gochujang, honey, rice vinegar, sesame seeds, red pepper flakes (optional), and soy sauce. Toss well until evenly combined.
Transfer the cucumber salad to a separate container and refrigerate—it will keep fresh for the week.
Spread the marinated chicken thighs evenly on a lined sheet pan (use baking paper). Oven bake or air fry at 200°C/400°F for 16–18 minutes until the chicken has a beautifully golden char and juicy.
Let the chicken thighs rest for 3–4 minutes, then slice them into bite-sized cubes. Serve with the rice and cucumber salad, and ENJOY!

notes: Swap for chicken breast if preferred—slice into thin fillets before marinating.
Marinate overnight for the best flavor, but you can cook immediately if needed.
Make the cucumber salad in batches and store separately—it gets better over time.
Monitor chicken while air frying; if not crowded, it may cook in 12–13 minutes. Aim for a nice char.
For reheating, warm the chicken and rice on low heat in a pan; store cucumbers separately and serve cold.

groups.name: Chicken
items: 1 Large Chicken Breast Cut Into 2 Thinner Fillets

steps.text: Fill a pot with water, add 1 tsp of salt, bring to a boil, then cook the spaghetti for 8 minutes. Reserve ½ cup of pasta water, then drain the rest.
Slice your chicken breast and season both sides evenly with garlic powder, paprika, basil, salt, and pepper.

In a blender cup, combine spinach, basil, olive oil, garlic, cream cheese, parmesan, cashew nuts, salt, pepper, lemon juice, and reserved pasta water. Blend until completely smooth to make the pesto sauce.
Heat a pan on medium heat, spray with cooking spray, then cook the chicken for 5 minutes on each side until golden and cooked through. Set aside.
Lower the heat, add the blended pesto sauce to the same pan, then add the cooked spaghetti. Mix until well combined.
Place the chicken pieces on top, garnish with extra basil, parmesan, and chilli flakes. Serve and ENJOY!

61.intro: Sweet, smoky and slightly spicy with a rich chipotle glaze and caramelised edges. Pairs well with rice, roasted potatoes, or fresh salsas for a balanced meal.

groups.name: Honey Chipotle Chicken Marinade
items: 100g (3.5oz) Chipotle Paste or Chipotle Peppers in Adobo
300g (7oz) Fresh Pineapple, chopped into chunks (big batch, store in bottle)

steps.text: Place the boneless, skinless chicken thighs in a bowl and season with salt, oregano, garlic powder, smoked paprika, cumin, chipotle paste, honey, and fresh lime juice. Mix thoroughly until the chicken is fully coated and deeply coloured, then set aside to marinate.

Lay the marinated chicken thighs evenly on a lined sheet pan, then scatter pineapple chunks around the chicken. This allows the pineapple to caramelise and soften while releasing extra sweetness and moisture that enhances the flavour of the chicken. Oven bake or air fry at 200°C / 400°F for 20-23 minutes, or until golden, juicy, and slightly charred at the edges, with the pineapple lightly caramelised.

While the chicken rests, make the pineapple chipotle sauce. In a blender cup add yogurt, mayo, chipotle paste, pineapple chunks, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, and lime juice. Blend for 30-60 seconds until completely smooth and creamy.

Bottle up the sauce for the week (great for wraps and bowls). For meal prep, keep the chicken whole when storing to retain juiciness, and include any tray juices for extra flavour and moisture. Allow the chicken to cool completely, then store the whole thighs in airtight containers. Slice into bite-sized cubes only when serving for maximum flavour and moisture retention and add the pineapple chipotle sauce as needed throughout the week. ENJOY!

serve: With coconut lime rice and pineapple salsa
With crispy roasted potatoes and corn salad
In a tortilla wrap with crunchy slaw and pickles
sauces: Pineapple chipotle sauce (included in this recipe)
Lime yogurt sauce
Spicy mayo

65.intro: This might just be the best mac n cheese combo! So indulgent and easy to make - The Peri Peri Chicken is so juicy and flavourful paired with Creamy Peri Peri Spicy Mac n Cheese.

groups.name: Peri Peri Chicken Marinade
items: 400g (14oz) Raw Chicken Thighs, skinless fat trimmed

groups.name: Creamy Peri Peri Cheese Sauce
items: 1 Tsp each: Salt, Black Pepper, Onion Powder, Oregano, Paprika

steps.text: Place your chicken breasts and thighs in a large dish, then marinate with minced garlic, oregano, paprika, onion powder, salt, pepper, and Nando’s marinade. Mix well until the color changes and set aside to marinate.

While the chicken marinates, bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the raw macaroni pasta and boil for 7–8 minutes until al dente. Reserve some pasta water before draining the rest, then set pasta aside.
Heat a pan over medium heat, add a little oil or cooking spray, and cook the marinated chicken for 5 minutes on each side until golden brown and juicy. Repeat in batches if needed.
Once all the chicken is cooked, set aside to rest, then chop into cubes just before serving with the mac n cheese.

In the same pan on medium heat, add chopped onions and tomato paste. Cook for about 5 minutes until softened. Then lower the heat and add milk, cream cheese, grated cheddar, extra seasonings, peri-peri hot sauce, and the reserved pasta water. Stir thoroughly until everything melts into a smooth, creamy cheese sauce.
Once the sauce is thick and creamy, add the cooked macaroni and mix well to coat. Serve evenly with the cubed chicken, and your high-protein meal prep is ready to ENJOY!

notes: Marinate the chicken for at least 30 minutes or overnight for the best flavor.
You can use all chicken breast, all thighs, or a mix — thighs add extra juiciness and flavor.
Trim any excess fat from the chicken thighs before marinating.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before cutting into cubes to lock in the juices.
When making the sauce, keep the heat low to prevent the milk and cheese from splitting.

69.intro: Great for meal prep, goes well with any meat!

items: 1 Tsp Olive Oil or Cooking Spray

steps.text: Cook the pasta according to the package instructions. While it’s cooking, dice the onion and bell pepper, and finely chop the garlic.
In a pan, heat a bit of olive oil over medium heat. Add the onion, garlic, bell pepper, and chopped tomatoes. Season with salt, pepper, Italian herbs, and chilli flakes.
Stir and cook for about 5 minutes until the vegetables soften. Stir in the tuna and the cooked pasta. Mix everything well, then transfer to a baking dish.
Top with shredded mozzarella and bake in a preheated oven at 180ºC for 10 minutes. Remove from the oven and serve hot—enjoy! EXCLUSIVE COOKBOOK

71.intro: Another incredibly easy flavourful meal, packed with lots of protein, way better than takeout and perfect for meal prep!

groups.name: Bulgogi Beef Marinade
items: 900g (32oz) Raw Topside/Top Sirloin Beef, cut into thin strips

steps.text: Slice your beef into thin strips. Place in a mixing bowl and marinate with light and dark soy sauce, black pepper, chili flakes, chili powder, garlic paste, ginger paste, sesame seeds, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until all pieces are well coated, then set aside to marinate while you prep other ingredients.

Heat a pan over medium-high heat, add a small amount of light butter, and sear the marinated beef for 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown and slightly crispy. Do not overcrowd the pan—work in batches to ensure the beef sears properly. Once cooked, set the beef aside.

In the same pan on medium heat, add a bit more butter if needed, then sauté chopped garlic, gochujang paste, chopped green onion (white parts), and grated carrots. Stir-fry for 2–3 minutes until fragrant and the vegetables have softened slightly.

Add your cooked jasmine rice to the pan and stir well, ensuring each grain gets coated in the gochujang mixture. Cook for 2–3 minutes, mixing until the rice turns a vibrant orange color and is heated through.

To the rice, add kimchi juice, chopped kimchi, additional green onion (green parts), and a splash of soy sauce. Mix thoroughly till well incorporated, and cook for another 2–3 minutes so the flavors meld.
Finally, add the cooked beef back into the pan. Gently mix everything together. Let it heat through for another 1–2 minutes. Garnish with extra sesame seeds, divide into 4 servings, and ENJOY!

notes: Marinate the beef for at least 1 hour or overnight for deeper flavor.
Sear on high heat for 2–3 minutes per side to develop a rich, golden crust.
Day-old jasmine rice is best for texture, but freshly cooked works if cooled properly.
Store in bulk in the fridge or freezer—reheat in a pan or microwave for a few minutes when ready to eat.

72.intro: Guilt free easy to make Smash Burger!

steps.text: Take your lean beef mince and shape it into two equal-sized balls. Lightly season a plate with salt and pepper, then roll the meatballs in it to coat.

Heat a grill or non-stick pan over high heat. Add a small piece of butter, then place the meatballs in the pan. Use a spatula to smash them into patties and add sliced onion to the pan beside them. Cook for about 2 minutes, then flip everything.
Lower the heat, place a slice of cheese on one of the patties, and stack the other patty on top. Toast your burger buns in the same pan until golden.
Mix mustard, sriracha, and light mayo in a bowl to make the sauce. Spread the sauce generously on both sides of the buns.
Assemble the burger in this order: lettuce, the double-stacked patties, tomato slice, grilled onion, and gherkin slices. Serve and enjoy!

74.intro: Classic, bold taco seasoned beef with warm spices and savoury depth. Ideal for tacos, bowls, or loaded wraps with fresh salsa and creamy sauces.

groups.name: Taco Beef
items: 50g (1.8oz) Grass-Fed Butter (Brand: Kerrygold) (big batch - stores for the week)

steps.title: MAKE THE TACO SPICE MIX
steps.text: Combine salt, black pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, cumin, paprika, chilli powder, and oregano. Double the amounts to create 2 servings for the beef.

steps.title: MAKE THE CHIPOTLE SPICY SAUCE
steps.text: Blend the yogurt, mayo, chipotle paste, buffalo hot sauce, honey, salt, paprika, and garlic powder until smooth and creamy. Bottle and refrigerate for up to one week.

steps.title: COOK THE TACO BEEF
steps.text: Heat a pan over medium-high heat and melt the butter. Add the ground beef and cook for 8-10 minutes, breaking it apart until fully browned. Stir in the tomato paste and 2 servings of taco spice mix, then cook for another 3-4 minutes until juicy, seasoned, and lightly caramelised.

steps.title: FINISH & STORE
steps.text: Top the cooked beef with shredded mozzarella. Store the beef in glass containers and cool completely before refrigerating.

serve: With mexican rice or lime-cilantro rice
In a tortilla wrap with lettuce and pico de gallo
In a taco salad bowl with tomatoes, corn, and black beans
sauces: Chipotle spicy sauce (included in this recipe)
Lime yogurt sauce (yogurt, lime, salt, garlic)
Honey lime drizzle (honey, lime juice, chilli flakes)

76.intro: One of the easiest and most popular pasta dishes, made with minimal ingredients, perfect for weight loss and so satisfying. This is also convenient for meal prepping for the week!

groups.name: Pasta
items: 1 Cup Pasta Water I recommend cooking the pasta when the beef is left on simmer

groups.name: For cooking
items: Add 1/2 Cup Pasta Water, Cover and Simmer For 8-10 mins
Garnish with Parmesan & Basil (30g (1.1oz) Parmesan per Serving)

steps.text: Dice the onion, carrots, celery, and garlic into small pieces and set aside. These will be used as the base of the sauce.
Heat some olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the garlic and cook briefly, then add the onion, celery, and carrots. Sauté until soft and lightly golden.

Move the vegetables to the side and add the ground beef. Break it up and cook until browned. Stir in tomato paste, canned tomatoes, and your seasonings like garlic powder, Italian herbs, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Meanwhile, cook spaghetti in salted boiling water. Before draining, save a bit of the pasta water for later.
Add the pasta water to the beef mixture and toss in a few basil leaves if you like. Stir everything together, cover, and let it simmer on low heat so the flavors can come together.
Serve the spaghetti topped with the beef sauce. Garnish with grated parmesan and fresh basil, then enjoy!

80.intro: Deep, aromatic spices with tender, juicy beef and rich Middle Eastern flavour. Pairs perfectly with rice, wraps, fresh salads, and tangy sauces.

items: 1 Tsp Ginger Powder You will use for 1000g beef.

steps.title: MARINATE THE BEEF
steps.text: Thinly slice the sirloin beef into extra thin strips. Place in a large mixing bowl and add 2.5 servings of shawarma spice mix, olive oil, and lemon juice. Mix thoroughly until fully coated and set aside to marinate.

steps.title: PREPARE THE ONION MIX
steps.text: In a separate bowl, combine the thinly sliced red onion, chopped parsley, sumac, and lemon juice. Mix well and set aside. This will be used as a fresh topping.

steps.title: COOK THE BEEF
steps.text: Heat a pan on high heat and melt some of the butter. Sear the marinated beef for 1-2 minutes to get a quick char. Reduce heat to medium, add the remaining butter and parsley, and sauté for another 1-2 minutes until evenly coated and golden brown. Remove the beef from the pan and set aside. Repeat until all beef is cooked.

83.intro: One of the easiest meals you could make. This is perfect for weight loss, delicious and so easy to make! Another great example that you can eat lots of food for lower calories. I’ve also used this recipe many times for meal prep especially for those busy days!

groups.name: For cooking
items: 120g (4.2oz) Mixed Veg (Carrots, Sweetcorn, Peas - Frozen or Fresh)
1/2 Cup Green Onion, Chopped (+ More for Garnish)
1 Tsp Sesame Oil A great tip while this is all cooking, spray cooking spray over the pan and let it simmer. It will give that nice oily texture that fried rice normally has without the crazy calories

steps.text: Cube the chicken breast and marinate with olive oil, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, and soy sauce. Mix until fully coated.
Heat a pan on high, spray with oil, and cook the chicken for 3–4 minutes on each side until golden brown. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan on medium heat, add mixed vegetables and green onion. Cook for 2–3 minutes, then push to the side. Crack in the eggs, scramble them, then mix everything together.
Add the cooked rice and return the chicken to the pan.
Drizzle over extra soy sauce and sesame oil, optionally spray more oil for that classic fried rice texture, give it a final mix, and serve!

93.intro: Combining 2 of my favorite desserts into 1, this is a perfect way to satisfy your sweet tooth cravings while staying on track with your diet.

steps.text: In a wide bowl or shallow dish, crack in the whole eggs and egg whites. Add milk, vanilla extract, and a dash of cinnamon. Whisk everything together thoroughly until the mixture is smooth and slightly frothy.
Dip each slice of bread into the egg mixture, coating both sides evenly without soaking too long. Set the soaked slices aside on a plate, ready to cook.
In a separate bowl, combine softened cream cheese, finely chopped strawberries, and a spoonful of strawberry jam. Mix until well blended into a creamy, fruity filling.

Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and lightly coat with cooking spray or a bit of olive oil. Cook each slice of soaked bread for about 2 minutes per side, or until golden brown and slightly crispy.

To assemble, place one slice of the cooked French toast on a plate, spread a layer of the strawberry cream mixture, top with fresh strawberry slices, then place another slice on top. Add more cream, extra berries, and a dusting of powdered sugar. Serve warm and enjoy!

95.intro: If you struggle eating oats you gotta try this! Creamy, super easy and really convenient when you have busy mornings.

items: 1/2 Cup (4oz) Old Fashioned or Rolled Oats
Handful of Strawberries & Kiwi (Any Fruit You Like)
Chia Seeds It Would Be Better to Put Kiwi As a Topping Instead of Mixing It In As it Can Get Bitter

steps.text: In a jar, add oats, milk, Greek yogurt, chopped strawberries, protein powder, and chia seeds.
Mix everything together until well combined and the texture is thick and creamy.
Cover the jar and refrigerate for at least 3 hours or overnight to let it set.
Once chilled, top with sliced kiwi and more fresh strawberries.
Grab a spoon and enjoy straight from the jar!

96.intro: High energy and really nutritious, perfect for muscle building!

groups.name: (1 Smoothie)
items: 1 Handful Frozen Strawberries (Plus Extra to Serve)

steps.text: Add all the ingredients to a blender, saving a couple of fresh strawberries for garnish. Blend on high speed until the mixture is completely smooth and thick.
Pour the smoothie into a glass, top with the reserved strawberries (sliced if you like), and enjoy it fresh and chilled!

105.intro: A refreshing way to start your mornings, tastes amazing and is filling!

steps.text: Add all your base ingredients to a blender or food processor (excluding toppings). Blend for 2–4 minutes until smooth and thick. Add extra fruit or ice if you want a thicker consistency.
Pour the smoothie into a bowl and top with chia seeds, cacao nibs, and blueberries —or any toppings you like. Grab a spoon and enjoy! EXCLUSIVE COOKBOOK

106.intro: Absolutely one of the best combos, so indulgent, bursting with flavour and packed with 60g of protein!

groups.name: Chicken Marinade
items: 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (omit for milder flavour)

groups.name: Garlic Mac n Cheese
items: ½ Tsp Nutmeg (adds a great deep flavour!)
100g (3.5oz) Low Fat Cheddar Cheese (or any low fat cheese)

groups.name: Pasta
items: 220g (8oz) Uncooked Macaroni Pasta (or pasta of choice)

steps.text: Slice the chicken breasts into cubes. In a bowl, season with salt, pepper, chili flakes, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated, then set aside.
Bring a pot of water to a boil and add the macaroni. Cook for 8 minutes until the pasta is al dente, then drain immediately and set aside, as the pasta will finish cooking in the sauce.
Heat a large pan over medium heat and melt 10g of butter. Add half of the chicken cubes in a single layer and cook for 5 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy

Now lower the heat, add an extra 10g of butter, minced garlic, a drizzle of honey, and freshly chopped parsley. Toss the chicken until it’s well coated in these vibrant flavours. Remove the chicken and set aside. Repeat for the second batch.

In the same pan on low heat with the flavorful butter left behind, add more minced garlic and sauté until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Stir in milk and cream cheese, then season with salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, and a pinch of nutmeg. Mix until the sauce is smooth.
Stir in grated cheddar cheese until it melts into the sauce and thickens slightly. Add the drained macaroni and gently toss to ensure everything is evenly coated.
Portion the mac n cheese with the juicy honey garlic chicken into 4 servings and ENJOY!

notes: Preheat a pan over medium heat, melt butter, then add chicken. Avoid overcrowding for even cooking.
Sear for 4–5 minutes on one side until golden brown, then flip and cook for another 3 minutes.
Lower heat completely then add butter, garlic, and honey. Stir until chicken is well coated and sticky.

107.intro: Combining 2 very popular takeout meals! This tastes absolutely delicious, is low in calories, filling and easy to make for the week ahead!

groups.name: Salt n Pepper Chips
items: 1 Tsp each Salt, Pepper, Garlic Powder, Paprika

groups.name: For Cooking
items: 1 Tsp each Salt, Pepper, Garlic Powder, Paprika, Chilli Flakes

steps.text: Slice the chicken breasts into cubes. In a bowl, marinate the cubes with soy sauce, black pepper, garlic powder, and cornflour. Mix thoroughly until the color changes; if needed, add more soy sauce and spices.

Slice your washed potatoes into chips. Arrange them on a lined baking tray (use baking paper) and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and olive oil until evenly coated. Oven bake at 210°C/420°F for 25 minutes or air fry for 15 minutes.

While the chips are cooking, heat a pan over medium heat and add olive oil. Cook the marinated chicken for 4–5 minutes on each side until a golden-brown, crispy crust forms. If needed, cook a few extra minutes. Remove the chicken and set aside, cooking in batches if necessary.

In the same pan, over medium heat, add the chopped onions and bell peppers. Sauté for 2–4 minutes until softened. Then add extra salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, chilli flakes, a drizzle of honey, the cooked chips, and chopped green onion.
Mix everything together until well incorporated and let cook for an additional 1–2 minutes. Finally, divide into 4 equal servings and ENJOY!

notes: Mix chicken thoroughly until dark and rich in color. Add more spices or soy sauce if needed.
Avoid overcrowding the pan to ensure a crispy crust on the chicken.
Bake fries for 25 minutes or air fry for 15 minutes at 210°C (420°F).
Reheat fries in a pan or air fryer to restore crispiness.

108.intro: One of the best meal preps you can make! So easy and simple - Juicy seasoned steak paired with creamy chipotle potatoes

groups.name: Garlic Steak Bites
items: 800g (28oz) Raw Topside/Top Sirloin Beef, 1 inch cubed

steps.text: Slice the steaks into 1 inch cubes. Season with salt, garlic powder, parsley, cumin, smoked paprika, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until each piece is well coated.
Wash the potatoes and cut into small cubes. Place them in a bowl and mix with Italian herbs, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and olive oil until evenly coated.
Arrange the seasoned potatoes on a lined baking tray (use baking paper). Oven bake or air fry at 200°C/400°F for 20–22 minutes until golden and crispy.
While the potatoes are cooking, heat a pan over medium-high heat and add 5g of butter. Cook half of the steak bites for about 2-3 minutes per side until a beautiful brown crust forms.

Once cooked, lower the heat completely, then add 5g extra butter and freshly chopped parsley to the pan. Toss the steak bites until each piece is well coated, then set aside. Repeat for the second batch.

In the same pan over medium-low heat, add chopped garlic and red onion. Sauté for 5 minutes until softened, then stir in Italian herbs and chipotle paste for 2-3 minutes. Next, add evaporated milk, cream cheese, and grated parmesan; stir until the sauce is smooth and creamy.
Drop the crispy potatoes and fold into the sauce, ensuring every piece is well coated. Divide the dish evenly with the steak bites, and ENJOY!

notes: Marinate steak bites for at least 10–15 minutes for deeper flavor.
Cook on medium-high heat for 2–3 minutes per side in butter until nicely charred. Avoid overcrowding for a proper crust.
Oven-bake or air-fry potatoes for 20–22 minutes at 200°C (400°F).
No need to cook the sauce—just mix on low heat until smooth, then add the cooked potatoes.

109.intro: The flavours in this are absolutely incredible, so simple and perfect to meal prep for the week ahead!

groups.name: Lemon Pepper Chicken
items: 800g (28oz) Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cubed

steps.text: Trim any excess fat from the chicken thighs and cut them into cubes. Season with salt, black pepper, oregano, chilli flakes, garlic powder, paprika, lemon zest & juice, and olive oil.
Mix the chicken thoroughly until the color deepens, then set aside to marinate. Meanwhile, prepare your white basmati rice for later use.

In a bowl, combine yogurt, mayo, Dijon mustard, garlic & onion powder, salt, pepper, lemon juice, and parsley. Mix until smooth, then fold in the chopped tomato and cucumber. Give it one final mix till creamy and well coated.

Heat a pan over medium-high heat and melt butter. Sear the marinated chicken for 6–7 minutes until golden brown. Lower the heat, then drizzle with lemon juice and honey. Toss until the chicken is well glazed, then set aside.
In the same pan on low heat, add chopped garlic and onion. Sauté for 5 minutes until fragrant, then stir in turmeric, paprika, salt, and oregano. Cook for an additional 2 minutes.

Add the cooked basmati rice and fresh parsley to the pan. Mix well until the rice turns a vibrant golden yellow. Drizzle with a little more lemon juice, toss, and serve alongside the lemon pepper chicken and ranch salad then ENJOY!

notes: Marinate the chicken for at least 30 minutes; trim excess fat from the thighs for a leaner finish.
For a higher-protein, lower-fat option, use chicken breast instead.
Cook on medium-high heat for 4 minutes per side until a golden crust forms.
Prepare the rice and ranch salad in advance—store the salad separately to keep it fresh when reheating.
Reheat chicken and rice in a pan over low heat for 5 minutes or microwave, then serve the ranch salad at room temperature.

110.intro: This is without a doubt THE BEST recipe i’ve made this year so far! The flavours are INCREDIBLE!

groups.name: Taco Spice Mix (1 Serving)
items: 1 Tsp each: Salt, Black Pepper, Onion Powder, Garlic Powder, Cumin, Paprika, Chilli Powder, Oregano

groups.name: Taco Beef
items: 40g (1.4oz) Shredded Mozzarella (or any low fat cheese / 10g per serving)
20g (0.7oz) Grass Fed Butter (or butter of choice)

groups.name: Chipotle Spicy Sauce
items: ¾ Tsp each Salt, Paprika, Garlic Powder

groups.name: Pico de Gallo
items: ½ Tsp each Salt, Pepper, Garlic Powder, Cumin, Paprika

steps.text: Slice the potatoes into small cubes and place them in a mixing bowl. Season with 1 serving of taco spice mix and a drizzle of olive oil. Toss until evenly coated, then spread them on a lined baking sheet (use baking paper). Bake or air fry at 200°C/400°F for 20–22 minutes until golden and crispy.
For the chipotle spicy sauce, blend yogurt, mayo, chipotle paste, buffalo hot sauce, honey, salt, paprika, and garlic powder until smooth and creamy. Store in a bottle to use throughout the week.

For the pico de gallo, combine chopped tomatoes, red onion, red and green bell peppers, and coriander in a large bowl. Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, cumin, paprika, and lime juice. Mix well, then store in a separate container for the week.

Heat a pan over medium-high heat and melt the butter. Add the ground beef and cook for 8 minutes, breaking it up with a spatula until fully browned. Stir in tomato paste and 1.5 servings of taco spice mix, then cook for another 4 minutes until juicy and golden.
Top the taco beef with shredded mozzarella and serve with crispy potatoes, pico de gallo, and a generous drizzle of chipotle spicy sauce. Enjoy!

notes: Season potatoes thoroughly and mix well to ensure every piece is evenly coated.
Prepare the sauce in advance and store in a bottle for future meals.
Keep the pico/salsa in a separate container and serve fresh when ready to eat.
If the taco beef gets too dry, add a dash of water for extra moisture.
Reheat only the potatoes and beef since the pico is stored separately.

111.intro: One of the most indulgent meal preps i’ve made! Chicken is cooked to perfection, paired with a rich creamy Alfredo Pasta. So simple and easy with great macros

groups.name: Grilled Chicken
items: 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (omit for less heat)

groups.name: Creamy Tomato Alfredo Sauce
items: 1 Tsp each Salt, Italian Herbs, Parsley, Paprika
½ Tsp Chilli Flakes (omit for milder flavour)
Optional Pasta Water if the sauce is too thick

steps.text: Slice the chicken breasts into cubes. In a bowl, season with salt, Italian herbs, parsley, chilli flakes, garlic powder, paprika, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until evenly coated, then set aside.
Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the pasta and cook for 7-8 minutes until al dente. Before draining, reserve 1/4 cup of pasta water, then set the pasta aside.
Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and melt 5g of butter. Add half of the seasoned chicken in a single layer and sear for 3–4 minutes per side, allowing a rich golden crust to form.
Reduce the heat to low, then add 10g extra butter and gently stir the chicken until glossy and well coated. Remove from the pan and repeat for the second batch.

In the same pan on low heat add chopped garlic and onion. Sauté for 5 minutes until soft and aromatic, then mix in additional seasoning (salt, Italian herbs, parsley, chilli flakes, paprika) to enhance the depth of flavor.

Pour in tomato passata and let it simmer on low heat for 5 minutes, allowing the sauce to thicken and intensify in flavor. Stir in evaporated milk, cream cheese, and grated parmesan, mixing until smooth and velvety.
Gently fold in the cooked pasta, ensuring it’s well coated in the creamy, flavorful sauce. Serve with the succulent grilled chicken, divide into 4 portions, and enjoy this rich, high-protein meal!

notes: Cook garlic and onion for 5–6 minutes until soft, then mix in the spices for 1 minute before adding tomato sauce.
Let the sauce simmer on low heat for at least 5 minutes until it bubbles and slightly separates.
Add milk and cream cheese on low heat, stirring continuously until smooth and thick.
Reheat chicken and pasta in a pan on low heat, covered, for 5 minutes. Add a splash of milk if the sauce is too thick.

112.intro: Another incredible combo! Juicy & flavourful Steak Bites paired with creamy well seasoned Mac n Cheese. So simple and easy to make, great for meal prep!

groups.name: Cajun Spice Mix (1 Serving)
items: 1 Tsp each: Salt, Black Pepper, Garlic Powder, Onion Powder, Paprika, Chilli Powder or Cayenne Pepper, Thyme, Oregano

groups.name: Garlic Butter Steak Bites
items: 800g (28oz) Raw Topside/Top Sirloin Beef, 1 inch cubed

groups.name: Pasta
items: 200g (7oz) Uncooked Macaroni Pasta (or pasta of choice)

steps.text: Cut the steaks into 1 inch cubes. In a bowl, season the cubes with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, parsley, chilli powder and olive oil. Mix well, then let the meat marinate for 10 minutes.

Bring a pot of water to a boil and add the macaroni pasta. Cook for 8 minutes until al dente. While the pasta is boiling, begin cooking the steak bites. Once the pasta is ready, drain and set it aside.
Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and melt 10g of butter. Sear half of the steak bites for about 3 minutes on each side until a golden brown crust forms.

Lower the heat to low, add extra 10g of butter, minced garlic, and chopped parsley to the pan. Toss the steak bites in this flavorful butter until each piece is well coated. Remove the beef from the pan and keep warm. Repeat this for the second batch.
Using the same pan on low heat, add the milk, cream cheese, cheddar, mozzarella, and the Cajun spice mix. Stir continuously until the sauce becomes smooth and indulgently creamy.
Now add the cooked pasta in the sauce, give it a good mix till combined. Garnish with parsley then serve with the delicious steak bites and your high protein meals are ready for the week!

notes: Sear steak bites over medium-high heat for 3–4 minutes per side until golden brown.
Lower heat, add butter, garlic, and parsley. Stir for 1 minute until well coated, then set aside.
On low heat, stir sauce until smooth. Once cheese melts, mix in macaroni, adding pasta water or milk if needed.

113.intro: There’s no reason to be meal prepping plain chicken & rice! This is an incredibly delicious meal prep and so simple to make

groups.name: Marinade
items: 70g Chipotle Paste or Chipotle Peppers in Adobo

groups.name: Cilantro Lime Rice
items: 280g Raw Basmati Rice (Cook this prior to making this)

groups.name: Chipotle Sauce
items: I like to pair this with a nice side salsa consisting of chopped tomatoes, red onion, bell peppers, cucumber, salt, pepper and pickle juice

steps.text: Place the boneless, skinless chicken thighs in a bowl and season with salt, oregano, garlic powder, smoked paprika, cumin, chipotle paste, honey, and fresh lime juice. Mix thoroughly until the chicken is fully coated and deeply coloured, then set aside to marinate.
While the chicken marinates, heat a pan over medium heat, melt a knob of butter, then add chopped onions. Cook for 5–6 minutes until soft, golden, and fragrant.
Add the seasoning blend: salt, turmeric, garlic powder, smoked paprika, and cumin. Stir well to coat the onions and let the spices toast for 1–2 minutes to deepen the flavour and aroma.
Add your cooked basmati rice to the pan. Gently fold it in using a spatula, mixing thoroughly until every grain is coated and turn a bright yellow colour.
Turn off the heat, then add a generous handful of fresh chopped coriander (cilantro) and a squeeze of lime juice. Mix to finish the rice — vibrant, fluffy, and fragrant.
Lay the marinated chicken thighs evenly on a lined sheet pan. Oven bake or air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 20–23 minutes, or until golden, juicy, and slightly charred at the edges.

While the chicken rests make the sauce. In a blender cup add yogurt, mayo, chipotle paste, pineapple chunks, salt, garlic & onion powder and lime juice. Blend for 30–60 seconds until completely smooth and creamy.

Bottle up the sauce for the week (great for wraps, bowls). Slice the rested chicken into bite-sized cubes, then serve with the golden rice and a generous drizzle of the pineapple chipotle sauce.Your flavour-packed high protein meals are ready to ENJOY!

notes: Oven bake or air fry for 20-23 mins at 200C / 400F - you can broil at the end for 2-3 mins to get the top nicely crispy and charred

114.intro: This has to be one of the most flavorful easy chicken recipes i’ve made! Packed with nutrients, perfect for muscle gains and easy to make!

groups.name: Chilli Lime spice Mix (1 serving)
items: 1 Tsp each: Salt, Black Pepper, Onion Powder, Chilli Powder, Cumin, Paprika

groups.name: Chilli Lime Sauce
items: 50g (2oz) Habanero Hot Sauce (or hot sauce of choice)

groups.name: Serve With
items: 210-220g (7.4-7.8oz) Uncooked Basmati Rice (yields approximately 560g or 20oz cooked)
200g (7oz) Avocado, thinly sliced (50g or 1.75oz per serving)

steps.text: Slice the chicken breasts into cubes. Place them in a bowl and add minced garlic, 1.5 servings chilli lime spice mix, drizzle of honey, freshly squeezed lime juice, and chopped coriander. Mix well until the color deepens and every cube is evenly coated.

For the chilli lime sauce, combine yoghurt, mayonnaise, your favorite hot sauce, honey, chilli powder, garlic powder, and a squeeze of lime juice in a blender. Blend until velvety and completely smooth!
(Optional) Bottle the sauce in batches and refrigerate for future meals.
Bring a pot of water to a boil and add the basmati rice. Simmer until the rice is fluffy and tender, then drain and set aside.

Meanwhile, slice the avocado into delicate pieces. Heat a pan over medium heat, melt some butter, and add the marinated chicken. Sauté for 6–8 minutes until the chicken turns golden brown with a slight char.
Once cooked, Lower the heat and add extra butter with a drizzle of honey. Stir for 1–2 minutes until the chicken is beautifully glazed. Repeat until all the chicken is cooked
Finally serve distribute the chicken evenly with a side of rice, avocado and top with the chilli lime sauce and ENJOY!

notes: Marinate the chicken for 10–15 minutes before cooking for better flavor.
Make the sauce in batches and store it in the fridge for the week.
Lower the heat before adding butter and honey. Stir until each piece is well coated.

115.intro: One of the tastiest meal preps i’ve made! The chicken is bursting with flavour, perfectly complemented by the garlic and herb potatoes. So easy and simple, with amazing macros!

groups.name: Creamy Garlic Herb Potatoes
items: 2 Tsp Olive Oil (Optional) or Cooking Spray

steps.text: Slice the chicken breasts into cubes. In a bowl, season them with salt, parsley, chilli flakes, garlic & onion powder, paprika, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until the color deepens and all cubes are well coated.
Wash and dice the potatoes into small, even cubes. In another bowl, season them with the same spices and a light drizzle of olive oil. Toss until every piece is evenly coated.
Place the seasoned potatoes on a lined sheet pan (use baking paper) and bake or air fry at 200°C/400°F for 20–22 minutes until golden and crispy.
Meanwhile, heat a pan over medium-high heat and melt 10g of butter. Add half of the marinated chicken in a single layer and cook for 3–4 minutes per side until a golden-brown crust forms.

Once cooked, lower the heat and add 5g extra butter, minced garlic, and parsley. Stir until each piece is evenly coated in the rich, garlic butter, then transfer to a plate. Repeat this process for the remaining chicken.

Back to the pan on low heat, add evaporated milk with garlic & herb cream cheese. Stir until the cheese melts and the sauce thickens slightly for about 5 minutes. Add the crispy potatoes in the sauce, gently mix until well combined and creamy
Finally serve and distribute into equal servings with the delicious chicken and your high protein meals are ready for the week, ENJOY!

notes: Cook chicken on medium-high heat for 3–4 minutes per side until golden brown. Avoid overcrowding.
Lower heat before adding butter, garlic, and parsley. Stir for 1 minute to coat evenly.
Keep pan on low heat when adding milk and cream cheese.
Stir continuously for 5 minutes until slightly thickened, then add cooked potatoes.
Reheat in a pan on low for 4–5 minutes or microwave for 5 minutes.

117.intro: One of the easiest and tastiest meal preps, incredibly flavourful chicken paired with fragrant and crunchy fried rice.

groups.name: Fried Rice Mix
items: 200g (7oz) Uncooked White Rice/500g (17.5oz) Cooked Rice (leftover/day old rice is best)

steps.text: Slice the chicken breast into bite-sized cubes, then add soy sauce, all-purpose seasoning, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until well coated and set aside to marinate.
In a separate bowl, make the teriyaki sauce by combining soy sauce, honey, minced garlic, cornflour (or cornstarch), and water. Mix until smooth and set aside for later.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat, add cooking spray or a little olive oil, add the beaten eggs then scramble for 2–3 minutes until fluffy. Remove from the pan and set aside.

In the same pan on medium high heat, cook the marinated chicken for about 7–8 minutes until golden brown. lower the heat then pour in the teriyaki sauce, mix and let it bubble and thicken for 2–3 minutes until all pieces are well coated, then set the chicken aside.

Using the same pan, add a bit more oil if needed, then sauté chopped onions, ginger, carrots, peas, and bean sprouts for 5–8 minutes until soft and fragrant. Add cooked white rice, soy sauce, and oyster sauce. Stir well to combine.

Add the teriyaki chicken, scrambled eggs, and green onions to the fried rice mixture. Mix everything thoroughly until well combined. Garnish with sesame seeds and distriute into 4 even portions and ENJOY!

notes: Marinate the chicken for at least 30 minutes (or longer) for deeper flavor.
Scramble the eggs on medium high heat, stirring constantly for 3–4 minutes until fluffy — don’t overcook.
Cook the chicken on high heat, stirring frequently to develop a golden brown color. Once browned, add the sauce on medium heat, let it thicken, then remove from heat with all the sauce.
When cooking the vegetables, make sure the carrots have fully softened before adding the rice.

118.intro: There’s no reason to be eating plain chicken & rice! One of the best tasting chicken recipes i’ve made, the sauce has so much flavour, macro friendly & perfect for meal prep!

groups.name: Serve With
items: 210g Uncooked Basmati/Approx 140g Cooked Rice per serving
Sprinkle Mixed Herbs and Salt to taste

steps.text: Slice the chicken breasts into cubes and place them in a bowl. Add minced garlic, dried basil, chili flakes, salt, smoked paprika, and a drizzle of olive oil. Toss until well coated, then set aside to marinate.

For the creamy sauce, blend milk, cream cheese, grated Parmesan, tomato paste, dried basil, and salt to taste until completely smooth. Set aside. (Tip: Start cooking the rice now so it’s ready when serving the creamy chicken)

Heat a pan over medium-high heat and add a little olive oil or butter. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes on one side, then flip. Lower the heat and pour in the creamy sauce, followed by cherry tomatoes and spinach. Stir lightly, cover with a lid, and let it simmer on low heat for 5–7 minutes.

Remove the lid halfway through and stir gently to prevent sticking while allowing the sauce to thicken. By now, the chicken will be coated in the creamy sauce, the spinach will have wilted, and the cherry tomatoes will be soft and bursting with flavor.
Serve the creamy chicken over hot herb-seasoned rice, distribute evenly, and ENJOY!

notes: Lower the heat after cooking the chicken for 4 minutes before adding the creamy sauce to prevent splitting.
Cook rice in advance so it’s ready to serve with the chicken and sauce.

119.intro: Truly one of the easiest and most delicious meal preps, packed with flavour and so easy to make. The Korean Spicy Sauce is INCREDIBLE!

groups.name: For The Fried Rice
items: 200g (7oz) Uncooked White Rice or 530g Leftover Cooked Rice

steps.text: In a mixing bowl, combine light & dark soy sauce, honey, minced garlic and gochujang. Mix until smooth and well combined. You will use this sauce for the both the beef and rice.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat, add olive oil, then cook the minced beef for 6 minutes until fully browned with no pink bits remaining. Use a spatula to break up the meat while it cooks.

Lower the heat to medium, add half of the prepared Korean sauce along with chopped green onions and sesame seeds. Stir well and cook for another 4–5 minutes until the beef turns golden and crispy then set aside.
In the same pan over medium heat, add chopped onions and grated carrots. Cook for 5 minutes until softened, then push them to one side of the pan and add the whisked eggs.
Continuously stir the eggs until scrambled, then mix them with the vegetables until well incorporated.
Add your leftover cooked rice to the pan along with the remaining Korean sauce and more chopped green onions. Stir thoroughly until every grain of rice is evenly coated.
Return the cooked crispy beef to the pan and gently mix until fully incorporated. Garnish with sesame seeds.

For the Korean spicy sauce, mix together light mayo, gochujang, garlic powder, and rice vinegar until smooth. Serve the beef fried rice evenly into 4 portions with a drizzle of spicy Korean sauce and ENJOY!

notes: Use half of the sauce for the beef and the other half for the fried rice. If needed, add extra soy sauce or mix in a little water to increase volume.
When cooking the beef, let most of the moisture evaporate before adding the sauce. Allow it to cook for a few minutes until golden brown and crispy.
Swap whole eggs for egg whites if preferred. Cook on low heat until scrambled for a softer texture.
After adding the sauce to the rice, mix thoroughly and cook for 3–4 minutes before adding the beef to ensure even flavor distribution.

121.intro: There’s no reason for you to be eating plain chicken and rice!

groups.name: Cajun Spice Mix (1 Serving)
items: 1 Tsp each: Salt, Black Pepper, Garlic Powder, Onion Powder, Oregano, Thyme, Paprika, Chilli Powder

steps.text: Butterfly the chicken breasts into thinner halves. Season with 1.5 servings of Cajun spice mix and olive oil. Mix until both sides are fully coated, then let it marinate.
Cook the plain white rice for later. Bring a pot of water to a boil, add basmati rice, and cook for 8–10 minutes until fully cooked and fluffy. Drain and set aside.
Heat a pan over medium heat, melt butter, and cook the chicken fillets in batches for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and charred, then set aside.

Using the same pan with the flavorful butter left behind, keep the heat on medium and add chopped onion and garlic. Sauté for 5 minutes until fragrant, then stir in ½ serving of Cajun spice mix. Cook for 2–3 minutes until the spices are toasted and aromatic.
Add the cooked rice to the pan and mix thoroughly until every grain is coated and takes on the color of the spices. Stir in fresh parsley, then set aside.

For the creamy sauce, on low heat melt butter in a pan, then stir in ½ serving of Cajun spice mix. Toast for 1–2 minutes before adding milk, cream cheese, and parmesan. Stir over low heat for 4–5 minutes until smooth and slightly thickened.
Slice the cooked chicken into strips and serve over the spiced rice. Drizzle with the creamy sauce, garnish with fresh parsley, and enjoy your high-protein meals for the week!

notes: Marinate the chicken overnight for maximum flavor, ensuring each piece is well coated on both sides.
Cook on medium-high heat to develop a crispy crust, then let it rest before slicing.
Keep the heat low when making the sauce. Store separately and serve with the chicken and rice when ready to eat.

123.intro: Healthy Chinese Sesame Chicken! Super easy and a great way to change how you eat chicken and rice! This would be perfect for meal prep too.

groups.name: Chicken marinade
items: 300g (10.6oz) Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes

groups.name: For the cooking process
items: 1 Tsp Olive Oil or Cooking Spray
Serve with 120-140g (5oz) Cooked Rice per Serving

steps.text: Cut the chicken into cubes and season with garlic, soy sauce, Chinese 5 spice, and paprika. Mix thoroughly until the chicken is well coated.
Heat a pan over medium heat, add olive oil or cooking spray, and cook the chicken for about 5 minutes on each side until golden and cooked through. Remove from the pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add chopped onion and cook until browned. Then add carrots, bell pepper, sweet corn, and the special sauce. Let it cook on low heat until the sauce begins to thicken.
Return the cooked chicken to the pan, mix well, and let it simmer on low heat for another 4–5 minutes to absorb the flavors.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve hot with steamed rice. Enjoy!

notes: Add more water with corn flour for more sauce.

128.intro: This is a perfect example that you can eat delicious creamy pasta for weight loss, it’s so simple to make, tastes incredible and packed with protein.

groups.name: Shrimp
items: Cook in 1-2 Tsp Olive Oil or Cooking Spray

groups.name: Pasta
items: 120-130g (4.6oz) Uncooked Linguine (or Any Pasta of Choice)

steps.text: Rinse and pat dry the shrimp, then place in a bowl. Add minced fresh garlic, Italian herbs, paprika, salt, pepper, chilli flakes, and a splash of lemon juice. Mix until the shrimp are evenly coated, then set aside to marinate briefly.
Heat a pan over medium heat and add olive oil or cooking spray. Once hot, add the shrimp and cook for 3–4 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and fully cooked. Remove from the pan and set aside.

Reduce the heat to low. In the same pan, pour in a bit of milk and add cream cheese, grated parmesan, Italian herbs, garlic powder, and a splash of reserved pasta water. Stir continuously until the mixture melts and forms a smooth, creamy sauce.
Add a handful of fresh spinach, then return the cooked shrimp to the pan along with your pre-cooked pasta. Toss everything together until well combined and the spinach wilts.
Once the dish is evenly heated and coated in the sauce, serve immediately. Optionally garnish with extra parmesan or herbs.

129.intro: Such an indulgent and homey meal, way better than takeout!

groups.name: Fragrant Vegetable Rice
items: 150g Mixed Vegetables (Frozen or Fresh Carrot, Sweetcorn, Green Beans and Peas)

steps.text: Cut the chicken breast into cubes. In a mixing bowl, combine the chicken with yogurt, tikka masala spice mix, fresh minced garlic, and ginger. Mix thoroughly, then set aside to marinate.
Place the chicken cubes on a lined baking tray and air fry at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden and charred. Meanwhile, prepare the rice and sauce.

In a pot over medium heat, add butter and mixed vegetables. Sauté for 3–4 minutes until softened, then stir in fresh garlic, salt, turmeric, and cumin seeds. Cook for an additional 5 minutes until fragrant.
Add the washed, uncooked rice to the pot and stir to combine. Pour in water, bring to a gentle boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 8 minutes until the rice is fully cooked and fluffy.

In a separate pan over medium heat, melt butter and sauté chopped onions for 2 minutes. Stir in extra tikka masala spice mix and blended tomatoes, then cook for 8 minutes until the sauce thickens into a curry consistency.

Remove the sauce from the heat and stir in cream cheese until silky smooth and creamy. Fold in the cooked chicken, mixing well. Garnish with fresh coriander, then serve with the fragrant vegetable rice and ENJOY!

notes: Cook the chicken in an air fryer or oven for 20 minutes until juicy and golden; pan-cooking works too.
For a smoother sauce, blend the tomatoes thoroughly before adding to the pan.
Prepare the rice in advance or cook it simultaneously with the chicken.
For fluffy rice, bring the water to a boil, then lower the heat, cover, and simmer until fully cooked.

131.intro: There’s no reason for you to be eating plain chicken and rice - This is one of the best chicken recipes you will ever try!

groups.name: Spicy Rice
items: 1 Tsp each: Salt, Cumin, Smoked Paprika, Chilli Powder, Turmeric

steps.text: Trim any excess fat from the chicken thighs. In a bowl, combine with peri-peri spice mix, Nando’s marinade, and a squeeze of lemon juice. Toss until well coated, then let it marinate for at least 30 minutes—or overnight for best flavor.
Prepare the peri-naise by mixing mayo, Nando’s hot sauce, garlic powder, smoked paprika, and a squeeze of lemon juice until completely smooth. Transfer to a bottle and store in the fridge.

Heat a pan over medium-high heat and add a little butter. Cook the marinated chicken for about 5 minutes on each side until golden and juicy. Remove from the pan and set aside. Repeat for the remaining chicken.
In the same pan, add chopped garlic, onion, and bell pepper. Sauté for 3–4 minutes until soft, then stir in salt, cumin, smoked paprika, chilli powder, and turmeric.
Mix in the tomato paste and cook for another 3–4 minutes. Then add the cooked white rice and fresh parsley, stirring well until every grain of rice turns a bright yellow-orange color.
Serve and distribute the spicy rice evenly with the chicken and a generous drizzle of peri-naise then ENJOY!

notes: Marinate the chicken overnight for optimal flavor; chicken breast is a leaner alternative.
Cook on medium high heat for 5 mins each side to develop that golden colour
Prepare the Perinaise sauce ahead of time, bottle it, and refrigerate until needed.
Reheat the dish by warming it in a microwave or on a pan for 5 minutes.

138.intro: My Best Healthy Salmon & Rice! So Juicy & Flavorful it melts in your mouth. This recipe literally take less than 20 mins so perfect for a quick and easy meal!

groups.name: Veggies
items: Season With Salt & Pepper, Garlic Powder & Lemon juice
Serve With 100-120g (4.2oz) of Cooked Jasmine Rice

steps.text: In a bowl, combine all the marinade ingredients and mix thoroughly until smooth and well blended.
Preheat your oven to 220°C (430°F). Line a baking tray with parchment paper and place the salmon fillets on top. Spoon the marinade evenly over each piece, spreading it to coat fully.
Switch your oven setting to broil. Place the salmon in the oven and broil for 6–10 minutes, depending on thickness. Keep an eye on it to avoid overcooking.
While the salmon cooks, stir-fry your choice of vegetables in a hot pan, or roast them alongside the salmon in the oven if you prefer.
Once everything is ready, plate the salmon with your veggies and a portion of jasmine rice. Serve immediately and enjoy!

notes: If you use skinless salmon the calories will be lower!

143.intro: High Protein Garlic Shrimp Fried Rice!

steps.text: Wash and devein the shrimp. In a bowl, marinate them with soy sauce, black pepper, garlic & onion powder, and chilli flakes. Toss until evenly coated, then set aside.
Prepare the yum yum sauce by combining light mayo, ketchup, sriracha, rice vinegar, ginger powder, and paprika. Mix until completely smooth. (You can bottle and store this sauce for later use)
Heat a pan over medium heat and add a little light butter. Cook the marinated raw shrimp for 1–2 minutes per side until golden and juicy, then set aside.
In the same pan, add chopped garlic and green onion; sauté for 2 minutes. Then add peas and carrots, cooking for another 2 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Push the vegetables to one side of the pan, add the whisked eggs, and stir continuously until scrambled. Once the eggs are softly cooked, combine them with the vegetables.

Add your day-old cooked rice along with extra soy sauce, oyster sauce, and a dab of light butter. Toss well, then return the cooked shrimp and additional green onion to the pan. Mix until everything is evenly combined.
Give the dish a final toss, then divide into 4 servings. Drizzle generously with the yum yum sauce and serve. ENJOY!

notes: Use raw or par-cooked shrimp; if par-cooked, reduce the cooking time.
Marinate for at least 30 minutes for enhanced flavor.
If you don’t have day-old rice, cook fresh rice and chill it in the freezer until cooled.
Make the yum yum sauce in batches and store it for future meals.
Reheat in a microwave or pan, and serve the sauce fresh when ready to eat.

144.intro: Tastes absolutely incredible for how easy this is to make, packed with 56g of protein!

steps.text: In a bowl, combine light and dark soy sauce, garlic and ginger paste, gochujang, honey, oyster sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame seeds. Mix until fully combined, then set aside.

Heat a pan on medium, melt some butter, and cook chopped onions for 5 minutes until soft. Increase heat to high, add lean ground beef, and cook for 8 minutes until browned, using a spatula to break it up.
Lower the heat to medium, pour in the prepared sauce, and cook for 4-5 minutes until the beef turns golden and slightly caramelised. Finish with chopped green onion and sesame seeds, then set aside.
For the Korean spicy sauce, mix low-fat yogurt, gochujang, and honey in a bowl. Add a splash of milk to loosen the consistency if needed. Bottle and store for future use.

In a large bowl, combine thinly sliced cucumber, grated carrots, red onion, green onion, light soy sauce, sriracha, rice vinegar, and garlic powder. Toss gently until evenly coated. Store separately to keep fresh and make reheating easier.
Serve and divide the Korean beef, white rice, crunchy slaw, and spicy sauce into 5 portions. Your high-protein Korean-style meals are ready to ENJOY!

149.intro: If you love Butter Chicken and Pasta, why not combine the two? This is one of the best combos, taste absolutely incredible, perfect meal prep for the week ahead!

groups.name: Chicken
items: 600g (21.2oz) Chicken Breast, cubed (You can use Chicken Thighs instead for better flavour)
1-2 tsp Olive Oil or Cooking Spray for Cooking

groups.name: Butter Chicken Sauce
items: 2 Large Tomatoes Chopped or 1 Canned Tomatoes (400g)

steps.text: Cut the chicken into cubes and marinate with spices, lemon juice, and yogurt. Mix well and let it sit for at least 30 minutes.

While the chicken marinates, slice the onion. In a pan over medium heat, melt a bit of light butter, then cook the onions for 3 minutes. Add chopped tomatoes, cashews, and extra seasoning. Cook for 5 minutes, then stir in yogurt.
Let the mixture cool slightly, then blend until smooth and creamy. Meanwhile, cook the pasta according to package instructions, then drain and set aside.
In the same pan, cook the marinated chicken for about 4 minutes on each side until golden and fully cooked.
Pour the blended sauce into the pan with the chicken, then add the cooked pasta. Mix well until everything is fully coated and heated through.
Garnish with fresh coriander, divide into 4 portions, and enjoy!

155.intro: Warm, aromatic spices with juicy, tender chicken and bold Middle Eastern flavours. Perfect with rice, wraps, fresh salads, and creamy garlic sauces.

groups.name: Chicken Shawarma
items: Juice of 1 Lemon (big batch, store in bottle)

groups.name: Special Garlic White Sauce
items: 40g (1.4oz) Pickle Juice, add to desired consistency

steps.text: Place the boneless, skinless chicken thighs into a large mixing bowl. steps.text: Start by prepping all your vegetables- finely chop the onion, red and green bell peppers, and mince the garlic. Wash your rice and set it aside for later.

Add the cooked veggies back into the pan along with tomato paste, salt, oregano, onion powder, smoked paprika, cumin, and chili powder. Stir well for 1–2 minutes until the spices are toasted and the meat turns a rich golden brown.

Lower the heat to medium-low, then stir in the canned chopped tomatoes, chopped pickled jalapeños, and 300-400ml of beef broth. Mix everything thoroughly, then cover with a lid and let it simmer on low heat for 15–20 minutes.

While the chili simmers, prepare the rice. In a separate pot, bring water to a boil, add the raw rice, and simmer on low heat for 8–10 minutes until fully cooked and fluffy. Drain any excess water, then stir in a big handful of chopped coriander, the juice of one lime, and salt to taste. Mix well and set aside.

After the chili has simmered for 15 minutes, remove the lid and add the red kidney beans. Stir to combine, then simmer uncovered for another 5 minutes. If the sauce is too thick, add a splash of beef broth or water to adjust consistency.

To serve, divide the coriander lime rice evenly into 5 containers. Top with the beef chili, then garnish with shredded cheese, chopped coriander, and green onion. Your high-protein meals are ready to ENJOY!
