steps.text: Slice the chicken breast into thin fillets, add a drizzle of olive oil, and season with the listed spices. Mix well until the chicken is evenly coated.
In a blender cup, combine milk, cream cheese, mozzarella, garlic powder, and a bit of pasta water. Blend for about 30 seconds until completely smooth and creamy.

Cook your pasta according to the package instructions. While it cooks, heat a pan over medium heat, spray with oil, and cook the chicken for 3–4 minutes on each side. Once done, remove from the pan and let it rest before cutting into cubes.

In the same pan, add finely chopped garlic and onion. Sauté for 3–4 minutes until softened, then add the bell peppers and cook for another 4 minutes. Pour in the creamy blended sauce and add extra seasoning if needed.
Stir the sauce well and let it thicken slightly. Add the cooked pasta and cubed chicken back into the pan, give everything a final mix, then serve hot and enjoy!

notes: Make sure the chicken is well seasoned and once cooked allow it to rest before cutting into cubes.
When adding the sauce, lower the heat so the sauce does not curdle.

234.intro: This dish is absolutely amazing, chicken is so juicy and flavourful then you have the fragrant rice and top it with that yogurt mint sauce! SO GOOD. is perfect for meal prep and weight loss and another delicious way to have your chicken and rice!

groups.name: Chicken marinade
items: 300g (10.6oz) Chicken Breast, cut into large cubes
75g (2.7oz) Low Fat Free Yogurt (Can Use Greek Yogurt)
Place Onto 4 Skewers (4-5 Pieces per Skewer)

groups.name: Seasoning
items: 1 Tsp Each, Salt, Pepper, Paprika, Turmeric

groups.name: Mint sauce
items: Serve the Chicken On Top of the Rice With the Mint Sauce

steps.text: Cut the chicken breast into thick cubes and marinate with all the listed ingredients for the chicken. Mix well to coat evenly, then thread the pieces onto 4 skewers, placing 4–5 cubes on each.

Wash the rice and chop the vegetables. Heat a pan over medium heat, add 1 teaspoon of olive oil, and sauté the vegetables for 2 minutes. Add the uncooked rice along with the listed seasonings and toast for 1 minute.

Pour in water, bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 8–10 minutes until the rice is fully cooked. While the rice is cooking, prepare the mint sauce by blending all the sauce ingredients until smooth.
Once the rice is done, set it aside. In the same pan, increase the heat to high, spray with oil, and cook the chicken skewers for 4–5 minutes on each side until golden brown and cooked through.
Serve the chicken skewers over the rice, drizzle generously with the mint sauce, and enjoy!

notes: You can use chicken thighs but keep in mind the extra calories and lower protein.

235.intro: So much flavor with every bite and the chicken is always so juicy, melts in your mouth

groups.name: Rice
items: 1 Cup Uncooked Rice (This Will Be More Rice Than Needed)
1 Tsp of All the Same Seasonings You Used For the Chicken

groups.name: Burrito
items: Red Bell Pepper (Cooked After the Chicken)

steps.text: Season the chicken with olive oil and all the listed spices, ensuring each piece is well coated for maximum flavour.

In a pan over medium heat, spray with oil and add black beans, rice, the same seasonings, and 2 cups of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook for 8–10 minutes until the rice is fully done. Remove from the pan and set aside.
In the same pan, cook the chicken over medium-high heat for about 5 minutes on each side until golden and cooked through. Let it rest for 2–3 minutes before cutting into small pieces.
Lay out a tortilla wrap and add a layer of rice, followed by the chopped chicken, cheese, sliced peppers, avocado, and jalapeños.
Fold the wrap into a burrito, then lightly toast it in the pan or a sandwich press until golden and sealed. Serve warm and enjoy!

notes: This recipe make more rice than you will need.
Reduce fat and calories by using less avocado and/or no cheese!

236.intro: Healthy Easy Chicken Parm! This is another very tasty chicken recipe and it’s incredibly easy to make. Plus the macros are crazy good!

groups.name: Chicken
items: 300g (10.6oz) Chicken Breast, cut in half (4 pieces)
1 Tsp Garlic Powder + Extra for Sauce
1 Tsp Olive Oil or Cooking Spray

steps.text: Cut the chicken breasts in half to create thinner pieces. In a bowl, mix together parmesan, paprika, oregano, garlic powder, and salt. Use this mixture to thoroughly coat each piece of chicken.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat, spray with oil, and cook the chicken for 4 minutes on one side. Flip the chicken, immediately lower the heat, and add chopped tomatoes around the chicken in the pan.
Season the tomatoes with oregano, garlic powder, and salt, then place mozzarella on top of each chicken piece. Cover the pan and let it cook for 2–3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.
Once the cheese has melted and the chicken is fully cooked, remove from the heat and let it rest for a minute.
Serve the chicken over rice or your favorite carb source—this also pairs perfectly with some warm bread. Enjoy!

notes: Macros include 140g of cooked rice per portion.
Serve with rice or any carb source you prefer or enjoy on its own!
Calories and macros may vary based on ingredients and brands you use!

237.intro: Healthy Juicy Chicken Burger/Sandwich! Lower calorie and macro friendly too. The flavors were incredible! Perfect balance of spicy, acidity from the pickled onions and sweetness.

groups.name: Chicken
items: 1 Tbsp Sriracha or Any Hot Sauce of Your Choice

groups.name: Burgers
items: Spicy Mayo (1 Tsp Hot sauce + 1 Tbsp Light Mayo)
1 Light Mozzarella Slice or Any Other Light Cheese

steps.text: Marinate the chicken with light mayo, sriracha or your preferred hot sauce, garlic powder, onion powder, cumin, salt, and pepper. Mix thoroughly until the chicken is evenly coated.

Heat a pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 3–4 minutes on each side, or 5 minutes if the pieces are thicker. Once cooked, let the chicken rest for 5 minutes to allow the juices to absorb.
While the chicken rests, lightly toast the burger buns until golden and warm.
To assemble, spread a layer of spicy mayo on the bottom bun, add the juicy piece of chicken, then layer on slices of tomato, pickled red onion, lettuce, and cheese.
Place the top bun on, press gently, and enjoy your spicy chicken sandwich!

238.intro: Quick note: you can make this with boneless chicken breast. This is easily one of my favorite chicken recipes, it’s sooo easy to make. Would go perfect with some roasted potatoes or with rice.
238.makes: MAKES 4 PIECES OF CHICKEN/ 2 BREASTS + 2 THIGHS

groups.name: Nachos
items: 1 Whole Chicken (2 Breasts & 2 Thighs) You Can Use 4 Boneless Chicken Breasts
1-2 Tbsp Sriracha (Depends How Spicy You Want It)
1 Tbsp Soy Sauce (Dark or Low Sodium)

groups.name: For the baking tray
items: Sprinkle of Salt, Chilli Flakes and Parsley
Serve With Roasted Potatoes or Rice

steps.text: Place your whole chicken or boneless chicken breast in a large bowl, add all the marinade ingredients, and mix thoroughly until the chicken is fully coated. Let it marinate for as long as possible—the longer it rests, the more flavorful it will be.
Preheat your oven to 220°C (430°F). Prepare a baking tray by spreading a layer of sliced bell peppers and onions (or any vegetables of your choice) to act as a base.
Arrange the marinated chicken pieces over the vegetables and season the top with salt, chili flakes, and parsley. Cover the tray tightly with foil.
Bake in the oven for 20 minutes at 220°C, then remove the foil and return the tray to the oven. Broil for an additional 5–7 minutes to develop a golden, slightly charred color on the chicken.
Once done, baste the chicken with the flavorful juices from the tray and serve with your favorite carbs like roasted potatoes or rice. Enjoy!

239.intro: This one is a BANGER! Super simple, hint of sweetness with a perfect balance

items: 300g (10.6oz) Chicken Breast, cut into bite size pieces

steps.text: Chop the chicken into bite-sized pieces and season with soy sauce, garlic powder, paprika, and the juice of half a lemon. Mix well until the chicken is evenly coated.
Heat a pan over medium heat, spray with oil, and add the chicken. Cook for about 2 minutes on each side until lightly browned.
Turn off the heat, drizzle in the honey, and toss the chicken until fully coated. Transfer to a plate and set aside.
Dice the bell pepper and add it to the same pan along with the spinach. Cover and cook until the vegetables are softened.
Add the chicken back into the pan along with cooked rice, and adjust the flavor with more honey, soy sauce, and lemon juice to taste. Mix well and serve hot!

240.intro: Absolutely delicious pizza you can enjoy guilt free!

groups.name: (1 Pizza)
items: Thin Crust Lebanese Flatbread (You Can Use Wholemeal Wraps Too)

steps.text: Cut the chicken breast into small bite-sized pieces and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. Mix well to evenly coat, then cook over high heat for 5 minutes until golden. Set aside once cooked.
Place a flatbread on a pizza tray and spread a thin, even layer of tomato paste over the surface.
Top the flatbread with mozzarella, the cooked chicken pieces, sliced red onion, bell pepper, cherry tomatoes, and a generous sprinkle of Italian herbs.
Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C (350°F) for 10 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and serve immediately. It’s light enough to enjoy the whole pizza yourself—enjoy!

241.intro: Struggling to lose weight? These are perfect, low cal, high protein, filling and Delicious!

items: 300g (10.6oz) 2 Chicken Breast, cut into small pieces

steps.text: Cut the chicken into small pieces and place in a bowl. Add salt, pepper, olive oil, garlic, and paprika, then mix thoroughly until well coated. Set aside to marinate briefly.
Heat a pan on high, spray with oil, then add chopped onions and courgette/zucchini. Season with the same spices as the chicken and cook for 5 minutes until slightly softened. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add the marinated chicken and cook for about 5 minutes until golden brown. Add the cooked vegetables back in, mix everything together, then turn off the heat.
Slice bell peppers in half, remove the seeds, and place them on a lined baking tray. Fill each pepper with the chicken and veggie mixture, then bake at 180°C (350°F) for 15 minutes.
Remove the tray, top each pepper with jalapeños and low-fat cheese, and return to the oven for another 5 minutes until the cheese is melted. Serve hot and enjoy!

items: 300g (10.6oz) 2 Chicken Breast, cut through the middle

steps.text: Butterfly cut your chicken breasts and season generously with Cajun seasoning. Add olive oil and rub until both sides are evenly coated.
Heat a pan over high heat, add the chicken, and cook for 5 minutes. Flip the chicken, then immediately lower the heat.
Add diced onion, bell pepper, chili pepper, uncooked rice, and 1.5 to 2 cups of water to the pan. Season again with Cajun seasoning for extra flavour.
Cover the pan and let it simmer for 10–12 minutes. At the 6-minute mark, uncover and stir the rice to prevent sticking and ensure even cooking.
Once the rice is fully cooked and the chicken is tender, remove from heat and serve hot. Enjoy!

243.intro: Guilt-Free low calorie high protein mini pizzas. You can have all 6 and they’re super filling & satisfying!

groups.name: (6 Pizzas)
items: 50-60g (2.1oz) Low Fat Mozzarella (or Any Shredded Cheese)

steps.text: Cut the chicken breast in half and marinate with olive oil, salt, garlic powder, and Italian herbs. While it marinates, finely chop the red onion, bell pepper, and tomato.
Cook the chicken over medium-high heat for 4 minutes on each side until fully cooked. Remove from the pan and shred using two forks or a knife.
Arrange 6 rice cakes on a baking tray. Spread a thin layer of tomato paste on each one, then top with shredded mozzarella, the cooked chicken, and chopped veggies.
Sprinkle extra Italian herbs and a pinch of salt over the top for added flavour.
Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C (350°F) for 8 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbling. Serve hot and enjoy immediately!

notes: You can drizzle some olive oil on the pizzas after they’re cooked, just be mindful of the extra calories.
You could easily substitute the chicken with turkey slices or any meat slices - will just be less protein.

244.intro: One of the most popular fast food items made healthier with bettermacros AND lower calories! Tastes absolutely incredible especially with that special sauce.

groups.name: Burgers
items: 4 Slices of Low Fat American Cheese

steps.text: Divide the beef into four equal 100g balls, season each with salt and pepper, and place them in the fridge to firm up while you prepare the other ingredients.
Thinly slice the onion and lettuce, and cut the tomato into slices. Set all the vegetables aside for assembling the burgers later.
In a bowl, mix together all the ingredients for the special sauce until smooth and well combined. Set the sauce aside.
Remove the beef from the fridge and heat a pan on high. Add a little light butter, place two beef balls in the pan, and use the back of a wide spatula to smash each one flat.

Cook the patties for 2–3 minutes, then flip them and add a slice of American cheese to each. Cook for another 2 minutes, then turn off the heat, splash in a bit of water, and cover with a lid to melt the cheese.

Toast the burger buns, spread the special sauce on both sides, and assemble with lettuce, a tomato slice, one cheesy patty, sliced onion, a second patty, and the top bun. Serve hot and enjoy! EXCLUSIVE COOKBOOK

notes: If you don’t have a wide spatula to smash the burgers in the pan, I would recommend using and plate to small the balls before placing into the pan to cook.

245.intro: Simple, easy & tastes absolutely incredible! This is also perfect for meal prep for the week!

groups.name: Pasta
items: 120g (4.2oz) Uncooked Fusilli Pasta (Or Any Other Type of Pasta)

steps.text: Boil water in a pot, add a teaspoon of salt, then cook the pasta for 8–10 minutes. Before draining, reserve ½ cup of the pasta water, then drain and set the pasta aside.

In a pan over medium heat, add olive oil and garlic cloves. Cook for 1 minute, then add chopped bell pepper and tomato. Season with salt, pepper, Italian herbs, and paprika. Cook for 5 minutes until softened.
Transfer the cooked vegetables to a blender along with the reserved pasta water and cream cheese. Blend until smooth and creamy, about 1 minute.
In the same pan, cook the beef over medium heat for 5 minutes. Season with salt, pepper, Italian herbs, and paprika as before.
Once the beef is cooked, add the drained pasta and blended sauce. Stir everything together, let it simmer for a few minutes, then top with grated parmesan and enjoy!

246.intro: Lasagna is one of my favorite comfort foods, this tastes incredible and is so easy to make! Also perfect for meal prep

groups.name: Meat & Lasagna
items: 500g (17.6oz) Lean Ground Beef (I Use Topside Beef)
140ml (5oz) Beef Stock (I Used an OXO Beef Cube)
1 Tsp Garlic Powder, Italian Herbs & Salt

groups.name: For the lasagna layers
items: 210g (7.4oz) Uncooked Lasagna Sheets / 390g (13.7oz) Cooked Lasagna Sheets

steps.text: Start by making the Béchamel sauce —combine all the listed ingredients in a blender cup and blend until smooth and creamy, then set aside.

In a pan over medium heat, add olive oil, chopped onion, grated carrot, salt, pepper, and tomato paste. Cook for 5 minutes, then add the ground beef and smoked paprika, cooking for another 5 minutes while breaking up the beef.

Add beef stock or water, canned tomatoes, garlic powder, Italian herbs, and salt to the pan. Mix well, stir in some basil leaves, cover, and let simmer for 10–15 minutes. Meanwhile, boil your lasagna sheets for about 6 minutes until al dente.
In a baking dish, start layering in this order: meat mixture, lasagna sheets, then Béchamel sauce. Repeat the process two more times.
Top with shredded mozzarella and bake at 180°C for 25–30 minutes. Once golden and bubbly, remove from the oven and serve hot—enjoy!

notes: I boiled the lasagna sheets for 6 mins before hand.
Layer order: meat, sheets, sauce x3 Bake at 180°C / 370°F for 25-30 mins.
Macros will vary based on brands and ingredients you use.

247.intro: One-Pan Tomato Beef Pasta! Perfect for meal prep all in one pan, it’s so easy to make! Saves you so much time cooking everything in one pot/pan, and the flavours are amazing!

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add ground beef and chopped onions, then season with garlic powder, salt, pepper, Italian herbs, and Worcestershire sauce. Cook until the beef is browned.
Add pasta sauce or canned tomatoes, chopped bell peppers, water, and uncooked pasta directly into the pan.
Stir everything together, then add more seasoning if needed.
Cover the pan and let it simmer for 15–18 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking.
Once the pasta is fully cooked and the sauce has thickened, garnish with parsley and a sprinkle of mozzarella if desired. Serve and enjoy!

notes: Mix and cook the beef for 8 mins on medium high heat till a good brown colour.
Cover and simmer for 15-18 mins till pasta is fully cooked.
Mix occasionally so it cooks evenly and prevent sticking to the pan.
After adding the pasta in the pan, cover to make sure it cooks thoroughly.
Add extra liquid if needed to cook further.
Calories will vary based on ingredients you use.

steps.text: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Add the pasta and cook until tender. Reserve some pasta water before draining, then set the pasta aside.

In a pan over medium heat, add olive oil and whole garlic cloves. Cook until fragrant and lightly golden. Add chopped bell pepper and tomato, then season with salt, pepper, Italian herbs, and chili flakes. Sauté until softened.
Transfer the cooked vegetables and garlic to a blender. Add the reserved pasta water and cream cheese. Blend until the sauce is smooth and creamy.
In the same pan, cook the ground beef over medium heat. Season with salt, pepper, Italian herbs, and paprika. Cook for about 5 minutes or until browned.
Add the cooked pasta and creamy sauce to the pan with the beef. Stir everything together and let it simmer for a couple of minutes. Finish with a sprinkle of parmesan cheese and serve warm.

249.intro: One of my all time favorite takeout meal made Healthy & Macro Friendly! This was honestly super easy to make and tastes absolutely amazing!

groups.name: Beef
items: 400g (14.1oz) Raw Weight Lean Beef Steak Cut Into Thin Strips Cut Diagonally Against the Grain of the Meat

groups.name: Tip
items: 1/2 Tsp Baking Soda (This is Very Important to Make the Beef Really Tender!)
1 Tsp White Pepper or Black Pepper

groups.name: Sauce
items: 1 Tbsp Oyster Sauce (You Can Replace with Low Sugar Ketchup)

groups.name: For the cooking process
items: 1 Tsp Olive Oil or Cooking Spray
Green Onion/Scallion, Cut Into Long Pieces
Serve with 120-140g (5oz) Cooked Jasmine Rice per Serving

steps.text: Slice the steak into thin strips, ideally cutting on a diagonal for tenderness. Marinate the beef with olive oil, soy sauce, rice vinegar, baking soda, cornstarch, and white pepper. Mix well and let it sit while you prepare the other ingredients.
Chop your vegetables, then prepare the stir-fry sauce in a bowl by mixing soy sauce, oyster sauce, rice vinegar, water, and cornstarch until smooth.
Heat a pan on high and spray with oil. Add the marinated beef in batches, cooking 1–2 minutes per side until browned. Avoid overcrowding the pan. Remove and set aside.

In the same pan, add a small amount of olive oil, followed by garlic, ginger, red chilli, and green onion. Stir-fry for 2–3 minutes until fragrant, then pour in the prepared sauce. Let it cook for another minute or so until it thickens.
Return the beef to the pan, toss everything together until well coated, and serve with hot jasmine rice. Garnish with sesame seeds and extra green onion, then enjoy!

250.intro: Another high volume, low calorie banging meal, this time with beef! Stir fries are just TOO GOOD!

items: 200g (7.1oz) Lean Beef Steak, cut into thin strips
1 Tbsp Garlic Powder or Fresh Garlic, Chopped
1 Tbsp Ginger Powder or Fresh Ginger, Crushed

steps.text: Slice the steaks into thin strips and place in a bowl. Marinate with soy sauce, Worcestershire sauce, black pepper, garlic, and ginger. Mix well and let it sit for a few minutes while prepping other ingredients.

Heat a pan over medium heat and add a bit of olive oil. Add diced carrots, broccoli, bell pepper, and cashews. Season with soy sauce and Worcestershire sauce, then cook for about 5 minutes until the vegetables are slightly soft. Remove from the pan and set aside.
Increase the heat to high and cook the marinated beef in the same pan. Let it sear for about 5 minutes until browned and most of the liquid has evaporated.
Once the beef is browned, return the cooked vegetables to the pan. Mix everything together and let it simmer for a minute so the flavors combine.
Serve hot with steamed rice and enjoy! EXCLUSIVE COOKBOOK

notes: If you’re allergic to nuts then remove or substitute with sesame seeds.
Use cooking spray to reduce fat and calories.
If you’re looking to gain weight you can use 10% fat beef, olive oil for extra calories

251.intro: Probably one of the easiest recipes I’ve made but still having tons of flavour and lower calories.

steps.text: In a bowl combine ground beef with minced garlic, your preferred spices, and chopped coriander. Mix thoroughly until everything is well incorporated.
Place the mixture in the fridge for about 10 minutes to help the meat firm up and hold its shape better.
Shape the meat into kebab-style pieces and bake in a preheated oven for around 10 minutes. Be careful not to overcook them, as they can dry out.
While the kebabs are cooking, prepare your flatbread by getting lettuce, sliced tomato, and red onion ready. Also, mix your white sauce if you haven’t already.
Once cooked, place three kebabs onto each flatbread, add the veggies, drizzle with white sauce and sriracha, then wrap it up and enjoy!

252.intro: Healthy Loaded Fries!! These taste absolutely incredible, so much flavor and will definitely satisfy your cravings! You can make this with any protein source such as ground chicken, turkey or even tofu!

groups.name: Fries
items: 1 Tsp Olive Oil or Cooking Spray

steps.text: Cut your potatoes into fry-shaped pieces. Toss them in olive oil, salt, and paprika, then spread them out evenly on a lined baking tray.
Bake in a preheated oven at 220°C for about 15–20 minutes, or until crispy and golden, flipping halfway through if needed.
While the fries are baking, cook your ground beef in a pan with chopped onions and bell pepper. Season with salt, cumin, garlic powder, paprika, oregano, and a splash of Worcestershire sauce.
Once the beef is nicely browned, sprinkle some low-fat cheese over the top and let it melt.
When everything is ready, plate the fries, top with the cheesy beef, then finish with jalapeños and spicy sauce. Enjoy!

253.intro: One of the easiest and tastiest meal preps, so crispy, easy to make with great macros!

items: 700g (24.7oz) Skinless Raw Salmon, cut into cubes
15-20ml (1oz) Light Soy Sauce (Can Mix Light and Dark Soy Sauce)
20g (1oz) Cornflour (Makes it Crispy) You Can Use an Air Fryer or Oven to Cook the Salmon and Make it Even Crispier

groups.name: Quick Note
items: 1 Tsp Olive Oil for Cooking or Cooking Spray

steps.text: Slice skinless salmon into bite-sized cubes. Season with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, black pepper, soy sauce, and a little cornflour. Mix until evenly coated.
Heat a pan over medium heat, spray lightly with oil, and cook the salmon pieces for 2–3 minutes until golden and crispy. Cook in batches if needed, then set aside.
In the same pan, add mixed vegetables and cook for a couple of minutes. Push to one side, crack in the eggs, and stir continuously until scrambled, then mix everything together.
Add cooked rice along with a bit more soy sauce and oyster sauce. Stir well to combine and heat through. Adjust seasoning as needed.
Finally, add the crispy salmon back in, top with a drizzle of spicy lemon mayo, and enjoy!

notes: Make sure each piece of salmon is well coated with cornflour to get the best crispness.
Cook on medium heat for 2-3 mins each side till golden and crispy.
Reheat the meal in the microwave, can use air fryer to make the salmon crispy again.

254.intro: You don’t have to eat boring foods to lose weight! These are absolutely incredible and bursting with flavour! That yellow mango sauce is such a game changer paired with perfectly seasoned shrimp, avocado and salsa!

groups.name: Yellow mango sauce
items: Pinch of Salt, Pepper, Garlic Powder & Chilli Flakes
1/2 Lime, Juiced Keep in mind you will only be using a small amount of this per taco, can store the rest in the fridge for up to a week!

groups.name: Salsa
items: 1/2 Red, Green and Yellow Bell Pepper, Finely Chopped
Pinch of Salt, Pepper, Paprika and Lime Juice

groups.name: Tacos
items: About 8 Pieces of Shrimp Per Taco Salsa
3 Thin Slices of Avocado Per Taco

steps.text: Season your shrimp with paprika, garlic powder, cumin, salt, pepper, lime juice, and a bit of olive oil. Mix everything thoroughly to coat the shrimp evenly, then set aside to marinate while you prepare the sauce.

In a blender, add fresh mango, plain yogurt, a pinch of salt and pepper, garlic powder, chilli flakes, and a squeeze of lime juice. Blend until smooth and creamy. Adjust the seasoning to taste, then set the sauce aside.

Heat a pan over medium-high heat and lightly spray with oil. Add the shrimp in a single layer and cook for 2–3 minutes on each side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from the pan and set aside. In a bowl, prepare the salsa.
Toast your mini tortillas over the stove flame for a few seconds on each side until lightly charred or warm.

Assemble the tacos, lay the shrimp on each tortilla, spoon over the salsa, add a few slices of avocado, and drizzle a generous amount of the mango sauce on top. Garnish with fresh coriander and serve immediately. Enjoy!

notes: Keep in mind you will only be using a small amount of the mango sauce per taco, can store the rest in the fridge for up to a week!
This recipe makes 4-5 tacos depending on how much filling you put in each taco

255.intro: One of my favorite ways of eating salmon, packed with flavor, so filling, easy to make and perfect for a quick healthy lunch or dinner.

groups.name: Cucumber salad
items: 1/4 Tsp Chilli Flakes or Paprika (Depends If You Want It Spicy)
1 Tsp Rice Vinegar or Lemon Juice

groups.name: Serve with
items: Spicy Lemon Mayo (Light Mayo, Sriracha & Lemon Juice)

steps.text: Slice your skinless salmon into bite-sized cubes. Add your seasonings, garlic powder, paprika or chilli flakes, soy sauce, and a touch of oil —then mix until the salmon is evenly coated. Set aside while you prepare the rest.

Thinly slice your red onion and carrot, then make a quick cucumber salad by combining sliced cucumber with soy sauce, garlic powder, chilli flakes or paprika, and a splash of rice vinegar. Stir well and let it sit to marinate.

Rinse your jasmine rice thoroughly, then cook it in boiling water until fluffy. While the rice cooks, heat a pan on medium heat with a bit of oil and sear the salmon cubes for 2–3 minutes on each side until golden and slightly crisp on the edges.
Prepare your toppings: slice avocado, and if using, mix up a spicy lemon mayo by combining light mayo with a bit of hot sauce and lemon juice.

Assemble your bowl with a portion of rice, cooked salmon, cucumber salad, sliced onion, carrot, and avocado. Drizzle over the spicy lemon mayo and top with sesame seeds and chopped green onion if you like. Serve and enjoy!

256.intro: One of my favourite stir fry recipes, meals like this are amazing for weight loss and it’s ready in minutes!

groups.name: Stir fry
items: 1-2 Tsp Olive Oil or Cooking Spray

steps.text: Season the shrimp with minced garlic, smoked paprika, pepper, chilli flakes, honey, lemon juice, and soy sauce. Mix until everything is well combined, then set aside to marinate.

Thinly slice the onion, bell peppers, and broccoli. Heat a pan on medium heat with a little olive oil, then cook the shrimp for about 2 minutes on each side until golden and pink. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add the sliced vegetables and cook for 3–4 minutes until they begin to soften.
Push the veggies to the side and add a bit more garlic, honey, and soy sauce in the middle. Let it bubble and caramelise for a minute, then mix everything together.
Add cooked basmati rice (about one portion) and stir to combine well. Return the shrimp to the pan, toss everything together, sprinkle sesame seeds on top and enjoy!

Fill a large pot with water and bring it to a boil. Add salt, then stir in the pasta. Cook for 8–10 minutes until al dente. Before draining, reserve about ½ cup of pasta water. Drain the pasta and set aside.

In a hot pan, lightly spray with oil and add garlic cloves, sun-dried tomatoes, and chopped onion. Season with salt, pepper, and Italian herbs. Sauté for about 5 minutes until the onions are soft and fragrant.
Transfer the sautéed mixture to a blender. Add the reserved pasta water, cream cheese, and a splash of almond or low-fat milk. Blend for 1–2 minutes until smooth and creamy.
Season salmon fillets with salt and pepper. Heat a pan over medium-high heat with a little oil or spray. Cook the salmon for about 6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Set aside.
Lower the heat and return the pasta to the pan. Pour in the sauce and stir to coat evenly. Place the salmon on top, cover briefly to warm everything through, then serve immediately.

258.intro: Easy & delicious Tuna Stir Fry, perfect for weight loss. Low calorie and high protein, this meal is super filling plus it’s so easy to make takes literally 15 mins or less. Let’s change the way you eat Tuna!

items: 2 Cans of Tuna (110g (3.8oz) Drained Weight per Can)
1 Cup of Cooked Rice (Can easily adjust this depending on your calorie goals)
Sesame Seeds & Spring Onion, for Garnish (Optional)

steps.text: Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and add a small amount of olive oil. Once hot, add your chopped vegetables (like bell peppers, carrots, or onions) along with your spices of choice — garlic powder, black pepper, and a pinch of chili flakes work great. Sauté everything for about 2 minutes until the veggies start to soften.
Add in the canned tuna and stir it through the veggies, letting it cook for another 2 minutes to warm up and absorb the flavors.

Next, add your cooked rice followed by soy sauce and oyster sauce. Mix everything together thoroughly to coat the rice and tuna in the sauces. Let it cook for another 2 minutes so the flavors blend well.
Finish by sprinkling over some sesame seeds and freshly chopped spring onion. Serve warm and enjoy your quick and flavorful tuna fried rice!

259.intro: Super fresh and bursting with flavours!

items: Mixed Salad Greens (your choice of salad)

steps.text: Add the shrimp to a mixing bowl and season with salt, garlic powder, paprika, chilli flakes, and freshly squeezed lemon juice. Toss thoroughly so the seasoning coats each piece evenly. Set aside to briefly marinate while you prep the rest.

Slice the cherry tomatoes in halves, thinly slice the red onion, and cube or slice the avocado. In a large salad bowl, add a base of fresh salad greens, then top with the prepared tomatoes, onion, avocado, and a handful of blueberries.
For the dressing (optional but recommended), whisk together honey mustard, a pinch of salt and pepper, garlic powder, and a bit more lemon juice until well combined and creamy.

Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and cook the marinated shrimp for 2–3 minutes on each side until golden and cooked through. Add the shrimp to the salad, drizzle generously with the dressing, and serve immediately— fresh, zesty, and full of flavour!

260.intro: These are seriously addictive, so well seasoned and flavorful and are perfect as a side dish or when you’re craving French Fries. Also that sauce is incredible!

items: 250g (8.8oz) Raw Potato, cut into thin fries
1 Tbsp Garlic Powder or Fresh Garlic

groups.name: The sauce
items: 1-2 Tbsp Fat Free Greek Yogurt (creamier the better)

steps.text: Slice the potatoes into thin, even fries. Place them in a large bowl and season with garlic powder, oregano, black pepper, grated parmesan cheese, and cornflour. Lightly spray with cooking spray and toss everything together until the fries are evenly coated.

Preheat your oven to 220°C (425°F). Spread the fries out in a single layer on a lined baking tray, ensuring they’re not overlapping. Bake for 25–30 minutes, flipping halfway through, until crispy and golden. Alternatively, cook in an air fryer at 220°C for 12–14 minutes, shaking halfway.
Once the fries are cooked, immediately sprinkle with salt, a bit more parmesan, and some freshly chopped parsley for extra flavour and a pop of colour.

For the dipping sauce, combine light mayonnaise, fat-free yogurt, crushed or finely minced garlic, paprika, and a pinch of salt in a small bowl. Stir until smooth. Serve the fries hot with the sauce on the side—enjoy!

261.intro: A perfect way to enjoy crispy fries guilt free while trying to lose weight! These are so easy, delicious and so satisfying - also that sauce is unreal, goes perfectly with these.

steps.text: Wash the potatoes thoroughly and cut them into thin, even fries. Spread them out on a lined baking tray. Season generously with smoked paprika, black pepper, garlic powder, and a dusting of cornstarch. Toss well to ensure all the fries are evenly coated.
Preheat your oven to 220°C (430°F). Once heated, bake the fries for 20–23 minutes or until golden and crispy, flipping them halfway through for even browning.
While the fries are baking, prepare your dipping sauce of choice. Once the fries are out of the oven, sprinkle with salt while still hot and serve immediately with the sauce—enjoy!

262.intro: Super Easy Delicious Yellow Rice, make eating healthy more enjoyable! One of the ways is making your average carb source more tasty and flavorful like white rice. Sometimes i get bored of eating normal white rice and this is a great way to spice it up!

items: 420ml (14.7oz) Water or Chicken Broth (for more flavour)

steps.text: Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onions, carrots, and red bell pepper. Sauté for 3–4 minutes until the vegetables begin to soften and the onions turn translucent.

Push the vegetables to the sides to make a well in the center of the pan. Add the washed, uncooked rice into the well. Season with salt, black pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and turmeric. Stir to evenly coat the rice in the spices and let it toast for 2–3 minutes, allowing the flavors to infuse.

Pour in water or chicken broth, just enough to cover the rice. Stir everything together, then bring the mixture to a light boil. Once boiling, reduce the heat to low, cover the pan, and let it simmer for 8–10 minutes until the rice is fully cooked. Stir gently halfway through to prevent sticking and ensure even cooking.
Once the rice is tender and the liquid absorbed, fluff it gently. Serve warm with your favorite protein—like grilled chicken or fish —and garnish with fresh parsley or coriander. Enjoy!

notes: Bring to a boil then simmer on low heat for another 8 mins till fully cooked through.
Check and mix the rice half way so it doesn’t stick to the pan.
You can also make this in a pot for convenience.

263.intro: High Protein Spicy Creamy Breakfast Wraps! ONLY 300 CALORIES!

groups.name: (2-3 Wraps)
items: 6 Boiled Eggs (keep 3 Egg Yolks and 6 whites)

steps.text: Bring a pot of water to a gentle boil and carefully add 6 eggs. Boil for 8 minutes, then immediately transfer the eggs to a bowl of cold water to cool. Once cooled, peel the eggs and separate the yolks from the whites into two separate bowls.

Mash the egg yolks until smooth, then add a spoonful of Greek yogurt or light mayo, a squeeze of mustard (optional), salt, pepper, and a pinch of paprika. Mix until it becomes a creamy, well-seasoned base.
Finely chop the egg whites and add them to the yolk mixture. Stir thoroughly to combine into a cohesive, creamy egg salad.

Lay out your tortilla wrap of choice. Add a layer of shredded lettuce, a generous spoonful of the egg salad, a sprinkle of grated cheese, and a touch of fresh parsley. Fold the wrap, toast it in a pan on medium heat until golden and warm, then slice and enjoy!

264.intro: Quick & Easy Healthy Breakfast. Crispy Potatoes with scrambled eggs. One of the easiest healthy breakfasts, so tasty and perfect for a quick meal .

items: 250g (8.8oz) Raw Potatoes, cut into little cubes

steps.text: Start by slicing your potatoes into small, evenly sized cubes. Transfer them to a bowl and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and oregano. Microwave the seasoned potatoes for 4–5 minutes until they become soft and partially cooked.

Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and add a bit of olive oil or cooking spray. Add the microwaved potatoes and cook for about 4 minutes until they begin to turn golden. Then sprinkle in 1 teaspoon of paprika and continue cooking for another 4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they’re crispy and golden brown.
While the potatoes are finishing up, prepare your scrambled eggs. Crack your eggs into a bowl, whisk well, then pour into a pan over low heat. Stir gently and continuously for soft, fluffy eggs.

To serve, plate the crispy potatoes and fluffy eggs together. Drizzle with spicy mayo, season the eggs with salt, pepper, and chili flakes, and garnish with fresh parsley. Enjoy your hearty, flavour-packed breakfast!

notes: Microwave the potatoes for 4-5 mins before cooking.
They come out soft and this will save you a lot of time!
It’s such a great hack.

265.intro: A perfect meal prep sandwich and a new way for you to eat eggs with toast so tasty using simple ingredients.

steps.text: Begin by boiling your eggs for 8 minutes until hard-boiled. Once done, cool them under cold water, peel carefully, and separate the yolks from the whites.
In a bowl, place 2 of the yolks and add low-fat cream cheese. Season with salt, pepper, onion powder, paprika, and finely chopped green onion. Mix everything together until smooth and creamy.
Chop the remaining egg whites into small pieces and fold them into the creamy yolk mixture. Stir until everything is evenly combined.

Toast 4 slices of wholemeal bread to your preferred crispiness. Assemble each slice with a layer of fresh lettuce, a generous spoonful of the egg mix, and finish with a sprinkle of chilli flakes and chopped parsley. Serve and enjoy!

266.intro: This is one of my go to breakfast meals, it’s so easy takes literally 10 mins to make and tastes so good! Great macros and perfect way to start you day.

groups.name: (1 Wrap)
items: Spicy Mayo (mix Sriracha Light Mayo and Lemon Juice)

steps.text: Place a non-stick pan over medium heat and add the turkey bacon. Cook until crispy, turning occasionally to ensure even browning.
Once the bacon is cooked, pour the beaten eggs directly over it in the pan, spreading evenly.

Reduce the heat to low and immediately place a tortilla wrap on top of the eggs while they’re still wet. Gently press the wrap down so it sticks. Let the eggs cook through completely, then carefully flip the entire wrap using a wide spatula. Toast the underside for 1–2 minutes until lightly golden.
With the egg side facing out, layer on fresh spinach, tomato slices, a pinch of salt and pepper, sliced avocado, and a drizzle of spicy mayo. Fold the wrap over, remove from the pan, and serve warm.

267.intro: Super easy, delicious & with great macros! They’re really filling as well, and the pancakes are really soft and easy to eat

steps.text: In a blender cup, combine oats, Greek yogurt, eggs, baking powder, and a pinch of salt. Blend for about 1–2 minutes until the mixture is completely smooth and pourable.

Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat. Pour the pancake batter into the pan in small rounds and cook for 1.5–2 minutes per side, or until golden and cooked through. In the same or a separate pan, scramble your eggs and cook 3 pieces of turkey bacon until crispy.
Assemble your plate with the pancakes, scrambled eggs, and turkey bacon. Top with low-fat cheese, a drizzle of sriracha, and your favorite seasonings. Enjoy!

268.intro: Packed with layers of flavor, each bite just tastes amazing! One of my favourite breakfast meals, ready in 15 mins perfect if you’re looking for a quick & delicious breakfast or lunc

groups.name: Cooking spray
items: 1 Egg + 2-3 Egg Whites (i used a golden yolk egg)
Salt, Pepper, Chilli Flakes & Garlic Powder (for seasoning)
4 Slices of Leaner Turkey Bacon (you can use any meat slices like chicken or beef)
50g (1.7oz) Sriracha or Spicy Mayo You can reduce the fat by using only egg whites and using less or no avocado!

steps.text: Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and lightly spray with oil. Pour in your whisked egg mixture, then immediately lay two slices of wholemeal bread on top of the uncooked egg. Allow the egg to fully cook and set for a few minutes.
Use a spatula to gently loosen the edges of the egg from the pan. Slide the spatula underneath and carefully flip the entire egg and bread layer in one motion.

Once flipped, fold the sides of the cooked egg inward. Layer your fillings on one side: lettuce or greens, sliced tomato, seasonings ( salt, pepper, chili flakes, garlic powder ), cooked turkey bacon, sliced avocado, and a drizzle of spicy mayo.
Fold the other slice of bread over the filling to form a sandwich. Toast both sides for a couple more minutes until golden and crispy. Slice and serve warm — enjoy!

269.intro: Tastes absolutely incredible, layered to perfection!

groups.name: Filling
items: 1 Tbsp Fat Free Greek Yogurt (vanilla preferably)

steps.text: In a bowl or dish, combine the eggs and egg whites, almond milk, vanilla extract, and a dash of cinnamon. Whisk thoroughly until the mixture is frothy and bubbles form on the surface.

Dip the slices of bread into the egg mixture, ensuring both sides are lightly soaked. Heat a pan over medium heat and cook each slice for about 2 minutes per side, or until golden brown and cooked through.
In a small bowl, mix together cream cheese and Greek yogurt until smooth. Add a teaspoon of your favorite jam and gently fold it in to create a swirled effect.

On a serving plate, start layering by placing a slice of the cooked bread, then spread some of the cream cheese mixture, and top with sliced strawberries. Repeat this layering two more times. Finish with a sprinkle of cinnamon or a drizzle of maple syrup, then enjoy!

270.intro: Perfect way to start your day!

items: 1 Tbsp Olive Oil or Cooking Spray

steps.text: Cut the potato into thin chips or fries. Heat a pan over medium-high heat and add olive oil. Once hot, add the potatoes and cook for 5–6 minutes, stirring occasionally until they turn crispy. To speed up cooking and promote even crispiness, cover the pan with a lid.
Add diced onions, bell pepper, and red chili pepper to the pan. Season everything with mixed herbs and paprika, then cook for another 2–3 minutes until the vegetables soften.

Lower the heat and crack in 4 eggs or egg whites evenly over the vegetables. Season again to taste. Cover the pan with a lid and let the eggs cook through, spreading the egg whites evenly for better, consistent cooking. Serve and enjoy!

notes: You can reduce the calories and fats by using egg whites indtead of whole eggs + using cooking spray instead of olive oil!
Check the potatoes to make sure they are fairly cooked before adding the eggs.
One tip to make the potatoes crispier, add paprika when you first cook them

271.intro: Takes literally 10 mins and tastes amazing with a sweet and spicy hint.

steps.text: Crack your eggs into a bowl and whisk them thoroughly until well combined. Pour the eggs into a non-stick pan over low heat and begin scrambling, stirring gently until they are about 80% cooked but still slightly soft.
Add dollops of cream cheese to the eggs and slowly fold it in, allowing it to melt and create a creamy texture. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Toast your wholemeal bread, then spoon the creamy scrambled eggs on top. Sprinkle with chili flakes, chopped chives, and drizzle some spicy honey over everything. You’re ready to enjoy!

272.intro: If you love Tiramisu, you can’t go wrong with this one! Perfect Breakfast for Coffee Lovers!

groups.name: (4 Medium Pancakes)
items: 1 Coffee Shot (1 Tsp Instant Coffee mixed with 2 Tbsp Almond Milk)

groups.name: Filling
items: 150g (5.3oz) Fat Free Vanilla Greek Yogurt (any yogurt works with some vanilla extract)

steps.text: Add all your ingredients to a blender cup, starting with the dry ingredients followed by the wet ones. Blend for 1–2 minutes until the batter is completely smooth and lump-free.

Heat a non-stick pan over medium-low heat and lightly spray with oil. Pour in 1/4 cup of the pancake batter and cook for about 2 minutes until bubbles form and the edges are set. Flip and cook for another minute. Repeat with the remaining batter to make 4 pancakes.

Once all pancakes are done, stack them layer by layer—starting with a pancake, then a drizzle of coffee, followed by a spoonful of yogurt. Repeat for all layers. On the final pancake, dust with cocoa powder and enjoy!

273.intro: Healthy Fluffy Pancakes, super easy to make!! These take 10 mins and only use 5 ingredients! Easily my best pancake recipe

groups.name: Pancakes
items: 125g (4.4oz) Low Fat Vanilla Greek Yogurt (High Protein)

steps.text: Add all your ingredients to a blender and blend for 45 seconds to 1 minute until smooth and well combined. Let the batter sit for a few minutes to thicken slightly and allow the ingredients to settle.

Heat a non-stick pan over low heat and lightly spray with oil if needed. Pour in about 1/3 or 1/4 cup of the batter per pancake. Cook each one for 1 to 1.5 minutes per side, flipping once the edges are set and bubbles appear on the surface.
Stack the pancakes on a plate and top with fresh blueberries, sliced strawberries, and a drizzle of sugar-free syrup. Serve and enjoy!

274.intro: Easy & delicious, literally takes 15 mins to make! Great for a quick breakfast or any time of the day.

groups.name: Cooking Spray
items: 3 Slices Tomato (season with Salt and Pepper)
1/2 Tsp Mixed Herbs you can use any low calorie tortilla or low fat cheese

steps.text: Heat a non-stick pan over low heat and lightly spray with oil. Pour in your whisked eggs and let them begin to set for about 1 minute. Then gently press a tortilla onto the eggs and flip it so the tortilla sits underneath and the egg is on top.

Let the egg cook for another 3–4 minutes until fully set. Use a spatula to gently loosen the edges and slide underneath the tortilla to ensure it’s not sticking. Carefully flip it over so the tortilla side is now on the pan.
On one half of the tortilla, layer fresh spinach, tomato slices, cooked turkey bacon, shredded cheese, a drizzle of sriracha, and any desired seasoning.
Fold the other half of the tortilla over to close it. If it’s not golden and crisp enough, toast each side for another minute or two. Serve warm and enjoy!

notes: Make sure you toast the tortilla properly to get a nice hard crust.

275.intro: Full of flavour, low carb & super filling breakfast!

items: 1/4 Cup (2oz) Almond or Low Fat Milk

steps.text: Crack the eggs into a bowl, add a splash of almond or low fat milk, and whisk until fully combined and slightly frothy.
In a pan over medium heat, cook the turkey slices until crispy, then set aside on a plate.
Using the same pan, add halved cherry tomatoes and season with salt, pepper, paprika, and garlic powder. Cook for about 2 minutes, then add spinach and cover until it wilts.
Add the cooked veggies and turkey to the egg mixture, gently stirring to combine.

Pour the egg mixture back into the pan over low heat. Add a few small dollops of cream cheese and lightly season the top. Cook gently until set, or finish under the grill for 2 minutes until lightly golden. Serve and enjoy!

276.intro: One of the easiest healthy breakfasts with NO OIL!

items: Pinch of Salt, Pepper and Paprika (For Seasoning)

steps.text: Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F) and place a tortilla wrap into a small baking dish or oven-safe bowl, pressing it in so the edges form a raised crust.
Crack a couple of eggs directly into the center of the wrap.
Add chopped chilli pepper, diced tomato, a handful of spinach, and shredded mozzarella on top.
Season with salt, pepper, and any herbs you like.
Bake in the oven for about 10 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the edges of the tortilla are golden. Remove and enjoy immediately!

notes: Make sure you toast the tortilla properly to get a nice hard crust.

277.intro: Healthy Cheesecake Overnight Oats! So creamy and tastes just like strawberry cheesecake!

items: 30g (1.1oz) Fat Free Greek Yogurt (Makes it extra creamy)

steps.text: In a bowl, combine oats, protein powder, cream cheese, Greek yogurt, strawberry jam, and milk. Mix until smooth and fully combined.
Grab a glass or jar and start layering: begin with granola, then yogurt, followed by jam, cheesecake mixture, more jam, another layer of cheesecake mix, and finish with a spoonful of yogurt.
Add your favorite toppings like fresh fruit, extra granola, or a drizzle of jam.
You can enjoy it right away for a quick treat, or refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight for a creamier texture.
Serve chilled and enjoy!

278.intro: Switch up your breakfast with this easy and banging breakfast egg fried rice!

items: 3 Turkey Bacon or Any Meat Slices
Oil or Cooking Spray Calories and macros will vary based on the ingredients you use. You can reduce calories and fat by using just egg whites! (350 calories & 6g fat with 5 egg whites).

steps.text: Thinly dice the onion and bell pepper. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat, spray with oil, then add the veggies and turkey bacon. Cover and cook until the bacon is crispy.
Remove the bacon, cut it into small pieces, and set aside. Push the veggies to one side of the pan.
Pour in the eggs and stir continuously over low heat until softly scrambled.
Mix the scrambled eggs with the veggies, then add cooked rice and the chopped bacon back into the pan.
Season with salt, chili flakes, and parsley. Cook everything together for 2–3 minutes on low-medium heat, garnish with spring onion, and enjoy!

279.intro: If you love banana bread, you MUST try these delicious & super easy overnight oats. Tastes just like dessert and the flavours are immaculate!

steps.text: In a jar, add oats, mashed banana, Greek yogurt, cinnamon, chopped walnuts, and a protein shake made by mixing protein powder with almond milk.
Stir thoroughly with a spoon until everything is well combined and the texture is creamy.
Seal the jar with a lid and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Before serving, top with a few crushed walnuts and a sprinkle of cinnamon.
Grab a spoon and enjoy—this one’s a favorite for a reason!

notes: I mix the protein powder with the almond milk to make a protein shake then pour it into the jar.
You can use normal milk or water if you want.
This is highly customisable with what ever toppings you like, nuts of your choice.

280.intro: Super easy and really tasty healthy breakfast!

items: 1 Tsp Olive Oil or Cooking Spray

steps.text: Heat a pan over medium heat, spray lightly with oil, and crack in your eggs. Season with salt, pepper, chilli flakes, and paprika, then cook until done to your liking.
Toast your bread and place it on a plate. Spread a layer of cream cheese on the toast, then add fresh spinach, avocado slices, and a drizzle of sriracha.
Place the cooked eggs on top of everything.
It’s ready to enjoy, simple, hearty, and full of flavour!

notes: Reduce fat by using egg whites and less avocado.

281.intro: These pancakes taste amazing and have crazy good macros per pancake!

steps.text: Add all ingredients to a blender in the listed order and blend until the mixture is completely smooth with no lumps.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat. Pour in about 1/4 cup of the pancake batter.
Cook for around 2 minutes or until the edges are set and the bottom is golden, then flip and cook the other side.
Stack the cooked pancakes on a plate. Top with fresh berries and a drizzle of low-sugar maple syrup — ready to enjoy!

282.intro: If you love French Toast, you HAVE to try these easy FT muffins!

groups.name: (8 Muffins)
items: 1 Cup (8oz) Low Fat or Almond Milk

steps.text: In a large bowl, whisk together egg whites, almond milk, protein powder, vanilla extract, and cinnamon until smooth and bubbly. Cut 8 slices of low-calorie bread into cubes, then gently fold them into the mixture and let soak for a few minutes.
Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and lightly grease a muffin tray with cooking spray.
Divide the soaked bread mixture evenly into the muffin tray cups, topping each with a teaspoon of apple sauce.
Bake for 20–25 minutes until golden and set. Let cool slightly, then enjoy warm with maple syrup if you like!

283.intro: Low calorie, super filling and packed with flavour.

steps.text: Dice the potatoes into small pieces and chop all your vegetables. Heat a pan with cooking spray, add the potatoes, season with salt, pepper, and paprika, then cook for about 10 minutes. Spray more oil if needed and cover the pan to speed up cooking.
Push the potatoes to one side of the pan, add the chopped onion and bell pepper, season again, and cook for 2 minutes. Then mix everything together and add the chopped tomatoes.
Make a well in the center of the pan and pour in the eggs. Stir continuously over medium heat until the eggs begin to scramble.
Mix the eggs with the veggies, add a handful of chopped spinach, cook briefly until wilted, then serve hot. Don’t forget to add sriracha for that extra kick! Enjoy!

notes: You can reduce cals by just using egg whites.

284.intro: One of my go-to breakfasts so easy to make - nutritious, tastes delicious and fills you up

groups.name: (1 Wrap)
items: Handful Spinach, Chopped 1 Tsp Salt & Pepper

steps.text: Dice the onion, bell pepper, and spinach. Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat, then add the onion and bell pepper. Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika, and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the spinach, stir to combine, then push all the veggies to one side of the pan.
Pour the eggs into the empty side and stir continuously until cooked through. Mix the eggs with the veggies.
Place a low-calorie tortilla on a plate, add the egg and veggie mixture in the center, top with mozzarella, sriracha, and sliced avocado. Roll it up and enjoy!

notes: You can reduce fat by using just egg whites.

285.intro: My all time favorite way of making a healthy sandwich taste banging!

steps.text: Spray oil on a non-stick pan over low heat. Crack the eggs into the pan and immediately place two slices of bread on top.
Cook until the eggs are almost set, then carefully flip the bread and eggs together using a wide spatula.
Fold the sides of the bread inward, season with salt, pepper, and paprika. Layer turkey slices, bell pepper, mixed greens, sriracha, and low-fat cheese on top.
Fold the top slice of bread over, then toast both sides for a few minutes until crispy. Serve and enjoy!

notes: Lower calories/fat with egg whites.
Calories & Macros will vary based on ingredients you use!

286.intro: High protein & low fat pancakes, they taste incredible and super filling!

steps.text: Wash the sweet potatoes and pierce them with a fork. Microwave for about 8 minutes until soft, then peel and transfer to a bowl.
Add egg whites, vanilla extract, cinnamon, and protein powder. Mix until the batter is smooth and well combined.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat, spray with oil, and pour in about 1/4 cup of the batter per pancake. Cook for 2 minutes on each side until golden. You should get around 7 pancakes.
Stack the pancakes on a plate and top with your favorite toppings—low-sugar maple syrup works great. Enjoy!

287.intro: If you’re looking for a tasty high protein shake that tastes very similar to a Snickers bar then I’ve got you covered!

groups.name: Toppings
items: Sugar Free Chocolate Syrup or Melted Dark Chocolate

steps.text: Add all your ingredients to a blender one at a time, being careful not to overfill it — the mixture will expand slightly as it blends. Secure the lid and blend on high speed for at least 30 seconds until smooth and creamy.
Pour into a glass, drizzle with sugar-free chocolate syrup, and finish with a sprinkle of crushed peanuts on top. Serve immediately and enjoy!

288.intro: Soft & fudgy chocolate cookies to satisfy all your chocolate cravings!

groups.name: (6 Medium Cookies)
items: 30g, (1.1oz) Honey or Sugar Free Syrup (For Lower Calories)

steps.text: In a mixing bowl, combine blended oats, protein powder, cocoa powder, baking powder, applesauce, and honey or sugar-free syrup. Stir until the mixture is smooth, then fold in dark chocolate chips.
Line a baking tray with parchment paper and spoon the mixture into 6 equal portions. Shape into cookies and, if desired, press in extra chocolate chips and sprinkle a little flaky salt on top.
Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C (350°F) for about 7 minutes. Once baked, transfer to a wire rack and let them cool for 5 minutes. Enjoy with a cold glass of milk!

notes: You can reduce calories and carbs by using sugar free syrup [Calories: 95 per cookie - Macros: 14g carbs / 6g protein / 2g fat]

289.intro: A healthy alternative to ice cream!

steps.text: Add all the ingredients to a blender or food processor and blend for at least 5 minutes until the mixture is completely thick, smooth, and creamy.
Pour the blended mixture into a container and spread it out evenly. Place it in the freezer for 3–4 hours to set.
Once frozen, scoop and serve with your favorite toppings —enjoy!

290.intro: Soft and chewy for the perfect texture! Great to satisfy that sweet tooth!

steps.text: In a mixing bowl, combine peanut butter, eggs, and coconut sugar. Stir until the mixture is smooth and well blended.
Add protein powder, baking soda, and coconut flour. Mix until a soft dough forms. If you like, fold in some dark chocolate chips.
Line a baking tray with parchment paper. Scoop and shape the dough into 12 small cookies, gently flattening each one with your fingers.
Bake in a preheated oven at 170°C (340°F) for 5 minutes. Let them cool slightly—they should be soft in the center. Enjoy!

291.intro: Crunchy & tasty af snack bars, high protein too!

steps.text: In a large bowl, combine Rice Krispies, peanut butter, honey, and protein powder. Mix thoroughly until everything is evenly coated and well combined.

Transfer the mixture to a lined baking dish and press it down firmly using a spatula or your hands until compact. Drizzle melted dark chocolate over the top and refrigerate for at least 1 hour to set.
Once firm, slice into bars and enjoy your homemade protein-packed snack!

292.intro: Fluffy and delicious pancakes, they’re perfect for weight loss!

steps.text: In a blender cup, combine cottage cheese, coconut flour, eggs, baking powder, and vanilla extract. Blend for 2–4 minutes until the batter is completely smooth. Let it rest for 10 minutes to thicken slightly.

Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and lightly spray with oil if needed. Pour about 1/4 cup of batter for each pancake. Cook for around 2 minutes until the edges set and bubbles form, then flip gently and cook for another 1–2 minutes until golden brown.
Stack your pancakes on a plate and top with your favorite toppings —I used low-sugar maple syrup and fresh blueberries. Time to enjoy!

293.intro: Perfect if you have sweet tooth cravings when trying to be healthy

groups.name: (1 Bowl)
items: 3 Tbsp Low Fat Milk / Almond Milk

steps.text: In a bowl, combine oat flour, cocoa powder, protein powder, applesauce, low-fat milk, and vanilla extract. Stir until the mixture is smooth and fully combined.
Add your preferred toppings, then microwave for 40–50 seconds—just until the center is set but still soft. Don’t overcook it! Let it cool slightly and enjoy warm.

294.intro: One of the easiest recipes for making healthy cookies!

steps.text: In a bowl, mash 2 ripe bananas with a fork, then add the egg, oats, and a scoop of protein powder. Mix thoroughly until fully combined, then fold in some dark chocolate chips.
Line a baking tray and spoon the mixture into 8 evenly sized cookies. Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 8–10 minutes. Keep an eye on them—don’t overbake. Let cool slightly and enjoy warm!

295.intro: Easily one of the easiest pancakes, make use of that leftover rice!

steps.text: In a blender, combine cooked rice, whole eggs, egg whites, protein powder, baking powder, cinnamon, and vanilla extract. Blend for a few minutes until smooth.
Adjust the batter consistency if needed—add more egg whites if it’s too thick, or more rice if too runny.
Heat a non-stick pan over low-medium heat. Pour in 1/4 cup of the batter for each pancake and cook for about 1 minute per side, or until golden. You should get around 5 pancakes.
Stack the pancakes and top with your choice of toppings. I used half a banana, low sugar maple syrup, and a dollop of whipped cream. Enjoy!

296.intro: What an incredible combo! So cheesy & creamy, perfect for meal prep, great macros and so simple to make!

groups.name: Philly Cheesesteak Beef
items: 20g (0.7oz) Grass Fed Butter (or any butter for cooking)
1.5 Tsp each Salt, Pepper, Paprika, Chilli Flakes

groups.name: Mac N Cheese Sauce
items: 125g ( ½ Cup or 4.5oz) Pasta Water (after the pasta is cooked)

steps.text: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the macaroni and cook for 7–8 minutes until slightly underdone. Before draining, reserve 1 cup of pasta water (keep extra on hand if needed). Drain the pasta and set it aside.

While the pasta cooks, heat a pan over medium heat. Melt the butter, then add the minced garlic, chopped onion, and mixed bell peppers. Sauté for 5–6 minutes until the vegetables become soft and fragrant.

Push the vegetables to the edges of the pan to create a central well. Add the minced beef along with salt, pepper, paprika, and chilli flakes. Break the beef into small pieces with a spatula and cook on high heat for 6–8 minutes until it is fully browned. Once browned, mix the beef with the vegetables.

Reduce the heat to low and add the cream cheese, shredded mozzarella, cheese slices, and the reserved pasta water. Stir continuously until the cheese melts and the sauce becomes smooth, creamy, and well combined with the beef and vegetables.

Lastly add the cooked macaroni into the sauce, mixing thoroughly to ensure everything is well coated. If needed, add extra pasta water to adjust the consistency. Finally, distribute the dish evenly into 4 servings, garnish with parsley, and ENJOY!

notes: Remove the veggies when cooking the beef or make a well in the center as instructed in Step 3.
Cook the beef thoroughly (add an extra 2–3 minutes if needed) before mixing in the cream cheese and mozzarella.
Lower the heat before adding any dairy ingredients to prevent curdling.
