Add the cooked macaroni to the sauce and gently fold until evenly combined and creamy. Divide the mac and cheese with the crispy Nashville chicken into 5 portions - your high protein meals are ready to ENJOY!

313.intro: Taking one of my most popular recipes and making it even better! This tastes ridiculously good for how easy it is to make with those macros

groups.name: Cajun Honey Butter Chicken
items: Extra Seasoning: garlic, Onion Powder, Paprika, Oregano

steps.text: Slice the chicken breasts into cubes and place in a mixing bowl. Season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, oregano, chilli flakes, and a drizzle of olive oil. Mix well until fully coated and the colour deepens, then set aside to marinate.

Cut the uncooked potatoes into small cubes and place in a separate bowl. Season with garlic powder, Italian herbs, paprika, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly, then lay them flat on a lined sheet pan. Oven bake or air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 20-22 minutes until golden and crispy.

While the potatoes cook, heat a pan on medium, melt a little butter, and cook the seasoned chicken for 6-8 minutes until golden. Lower the heat, then add extra butter, this seasoning mix (garlic & onion powder, paprika, oregano), a drizzle of honey, and fresh parsley. Mix well until fully glazed and juicy, then set aside. Repeat if needed for remaining chicken.

In the same pan, add chopped onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft. Stir in tomato paste and cook for another 2 minutes until fragrant. Lower the heat, then pour in evaporated milk and add garlic & herb cream cheese. Stir continuously until the sauce is smooth and slightly thickened.

Once the potatoes are cooked, fold them into the creamy sauce gently until fully coated and indulgent. Divide the creamy potatoes and honey butter chicken into 5 even portions - your high-protein meals are ready to ENJOY!

314.intro: Tastes absolutely phenomenal, extremely easy to make with minimal ingredients. This is the best meal prep i’ve made in a while!

groups.name: Chicken & Seasoning
items: 1000g (35oz) Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes

groups.name: Street Corn Salsa
items: 50g (1.7oz) Cholula Hot Sauce, or hot sauce of choice
50g (1.7oz) Jalapeños, de seeded and finely chopped

groups.name: Coriander/Cilantro Rice
items: Optional Squeeze of Lime, i didn’t add it as the other components already have lime juice

steps.text: Slice the chicken breasts into cubes and place them in a mixing bowl. Season with salt, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, cumin, parsley, olive oil, and a good squeeze of lime juice. Toss until evenly coated and set aside to marinate while you prep the rice.

In a pot, add water using a 1:2 rice-to-water ratio. Add the washed uncooked rice, bring to a light boil, then reduce to a simmer for 10–12 minutes or until almost fully cooked. Once slightly underdone, remove from heat, drain any excess water, and cover with a lid to let the rice steam and ﬂuff up. Stir in a big handful of chopped fresh coriander and a pinch of salt. Mix gently to combine.

Heat a pan over medium heat and melt some butter. Add the marinated chicken and cook for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and seared. Lower the heat, then stir in extra butter, minced garlic, and chopped fresh parsley. Toss the chicken to coat it in the buttery, fragrant glaze.

In a large bowl, combine sweetcorn, light mayo, Greek yogurt, chopped and deseeded jalapeños, fresh coriander, Cholula hot sauce, Tajín, lime juice, and crumbled feta. Mix until creamy and well combined. Store in a separate container for best freshness.
Divide the chicken, coriander rice, and creamy corn salad into 5 equal portions. Your high-protein meals are now ready to fuel your week!

notes: Let the chicken marinate for at least 20 mins for better ﬂavour.
Cook chicken on medium heat for 6-8 mins till golden. Lower the heat when adding minced garlic and parsley.
Store the corn salsa in a separate container to make reheating easier.

315.intro: Incredibly delicious, vibrant ﬂavours, easy and simple with great macros. A game changer to meal prep for the week!

groups.name: Chilli Lime Chicken Marinade
items: Marinate for as long as you can
Spread evenly on a lined sheet pan, make sure it ﬁlls the pan well
Oven bake or air fry for 20- 22 mins at 200C / 400F

groups.name: Fresh Mango Salsa
items: 150g (5.3oz) Red & Green Bell Peppers, finely chopped

steps.text: Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs and place them in a large mixing bowl. Season with salt, black pepper, lots of minced garlic, chilli flakes, smoked paprika, a drizzle of honey, lime zest and juice, and a splash of light soy sauce. Mix thoroughly with your hands until well coated and the colour deepens. Set aside to marinate.

Slice the uncooked potatoes into small cubes and place on a lined sheet pan. Season with black pepper, smoked paprika, cumin, parsley, garlic powder, shredded coconut, and olive oil. Toss well until evenly coated, then spread out on the tray.Oven bake or air fry at 200°C / 400°F for 20–24 minutes until golden, crispy, and aromatic. Sprinkle with salt once cooked and set aside.
In a blender, combine Greek yogurt, light mayo, honey, 1 deseeded green chilli, a large handful of fresh coriander, salt, and pepper. Blend until smooth, then bottle and refrigerate.

In a large bowl, add finely chopped cucumber (deseeded), red onion, ripe mango, red and green bell peppers, and fresh coriander. Mix until well combined. Optionally, sprinkle chilli flakes or Tajín seasoning. Store in a separate container and refrigerate.
Spread the marinated chicken thighs evenly on a lined sheet pan. Oven bake or air fry at 200°C / 400°F for 20–22 minutes until juicy and lightly charred.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing into cubes. Distribute the chicken, potatoes, sauce, and salad into 5 portions - and your high protein meals are ready for the week!

notes: Marinate for as long as you can.
Spread evenly on a lined sheet pan, make sure it fills the pan well.
Store the mango salsa in a separate container to make reheating easier.

316.intro: Easily the best steak recipe i’ve made, the rice alone is incredibly flavorful. This meal prep is a game changer!

groups.name: Garlic Butter Steak Bites
items: 1000g (35oz) Raw Top Sirloin Steaks, cut into 1 inch cubes

groups.name: Creamy Sauce
items: 250g (8.8oz) Low Fat Milk or Light Evaporated Milk

steps.text: Slice the beef steaks into 1-inch cubes and place them in a mixing bowl. Season with salt, black pepper, Italian herbs, garlic powder, paprika, and a drizzle of olive oil. Mix thoroughly with your hands until evenly coated, then set aside to marinate.

In a large pan over low heat, melt a little butter or spray lightly with oil. Add chopped sun-dried tomatoes and a sprinkle of Italian herbs. Sauté for 2 minutes until fragrant. Add the cooked white rice and mix well until everything is incorporated. Remove from heat, stir in plenty of grated parmesan and freshly chopped parsley, then fluff until rich, cheesy, and aromatic.

Heat a separate large pan over medium heat and melt a little butter. Add the marinated steak bites and sear for 3–4 minutes on each side until browned and juicy. Reduce the heat, then add a bit more butter, minced garlic, and chopped parsley. Toss until the beef is coated in the garlicky butter glaze. Cook in batches if needed to avoid overcrowding.

Using the same pan on low heat, add low-fat milk, light cream cheese, paprika, and mixed herbs. Stir continuously until the cream cheese is fully melted and the sauce is smooth. Let it bubble gently to thicken to your desired consistency. Store separately for the best texture and taste when reheating.
Distribute the Tuscan-style rice and steak bites evenly into 5 meal prep containers. Your high-protein meals are now ready to enjoy throughout the week!

317.intro: Two comfort food classics that taste absolutely indulgent and fit your goals

groups.name: Korean BBQ Chicken
items: 1000g (35oz) Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed
1.5 Tsp Red Pepper Flakes or Chilli Flakes

steps.text: Trim excess fat from the boneless chicken thighs and place them in a large mixing bowl. Season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, red pepper flakes, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated, then set aside to marinate.
Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add macaroni or your preferred pasta and cook for 8-10 minutes until al dente. Drain and set aside.

In a mixing bowl, combine thinly sliced cucumbers, red onion, green onion, red pepper flakes, garlic powder, sesame seeds, gochujang sauce, light soy sauce, and rice vinegar. Mix thoroughly, then store in a separate container and refrigerate.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat and melt a little butter. Cook the marinated chicken thighs for 4-5 minutes on each side until golden and crispy. Remove from the pan and set aside.

In the same pan over low heat, add minced garlic, gochujang hot sauce, a drizzle of honey, and rice vinegar. Stir to form a rich, vibrant glaze. Add the chicken back to the pan and coat evenly until glossy and golden. Remove from heat and set aside.

In the same pan over medium-low heat, add milk, cream cheese, salt, black pepper, paprika, and a pinch of nutmeg. Stir until smooth, then add low-fat cheddar and mix until melted. Add the cooked macaroni and stir until fully coated and creamy.
Slice the glazed Korean chicken into bite-sized cubes. Distribute evenly across 5 servings along with the mac & cheese and cucumber gochujang salad. Your high-protein meals are ready to ENJOY!

318.intro: Every bite is bursting with flavor - Savoury, sweet and a lil spice. Crispy, juicy chicken, seasoned rice, and a bright pineapple avo salsa that cuts through with freshness. A combo that’s seriously next level

groups.name: Honey Chilli Crisp Chicken
items: 30-40g (1.4oz) Chilli Crisp Oil drain the extra oil (Brand: Lee Kum Kee)

steps.text: Trim any excess fat from the boneless chicken thighs and place them in a mixing bowl. Season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, paprika, chilli crisp, and a drizzle of honey. Mix well with your hands until the colour deepens and the chicken is fully coated. Set aside to marinate.

In a large bowl, combine diced pineapple (fresh or canned), cucumber, red onion, red bell pepper, avocado, and plenty of chopped coriander. Season with salt, black pepper, and a squeeze of fresh lime juice. Mix gently until well combined. Transfer to a separate container and refrigerate to keep it fresh and crisp for the week.

Add washed uncooked basmati rice to a pot of water (use your preferred rice-towater ratio). Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer for 8-10 minutes or until the rice is cooked through and fluffy. Once cooked, stir in freshly chopped coriander, dried oregano, and a few cracks of chilli garlic salt. Mix gently and set aside.
Spread the marinated chicken thighs evenly on a lined sheet pan. Oven bake or air fry at 190°C / 385°F for 16-18 minutes until golden brown and juicy.

Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes, then slice into juicy cubes. Toss the pieces back onto the tray to soak up all those resting juices. Serve with the herby seasoned rice and the vibrant pineapple avocado salsa. Enjoy your flavour packed, high protein meals!

notes: Spread evenly on a lined sheet pan, oven bake or air fry for 16-18 mins at 190C/ 385F until golden brown and juicy
Once cooked, rest for 5 mins then slice into delicious cubes and mix in all the resting juices
Mix thoroughly till well combined then store in separate containers and refrigerate. Makes reheating the chicken and rice easier and keeps salsa fresh

319.intro: Incredibly delicious for how easy it is to make with over 60g of Protein! A popular dish also known as Yalanci Manti. Juicy ground beef serve with pasta of choice topped with mint garlic sauce and chilli butter

groups.name: Juicy Ground Beef
items: Avocado Oil Cooking Spray (or any of choice)

groups.name: Extra Seasoning
items: Add extra tomato paste if needed

steps.text: In a large bowl, combine a generous amount of thick yogurt (I used Skyr for its high protein content), minced garlic, dried or fresh mint, a pinch of salt, and a good squeeze of lemon juice. Stir until smooth and creamy. Transfer to a separate container and refrigerate to keep it fresh for the week.

Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add your pasta of choice (I used a mix of conchiglie and fusilli) and cook for about 8 minutes or until al dente. Reserve some of the pasta water, drain the rest, and set the pasta aside.

Heat a pan over medium heat and add avocado oil spray. Sauté chopped onions for 8–10 minutes until soft and golden brown. Then add salt, black pepper, paprika, cumin, minced garlic, and tomato paste. Cook for another 3-4 minutes until fragrant and well combined.

Increase the heat to high, add the lean ground beef to the pan, and use a spatula to break it up. Cook for about 8 minutes until browned and fully cooked through. Season again to taste with salt, pepper, and spices. Mix well until juicy and flavourful, then set aside.

In a small pan over low heat, melt a little light butter. Add paprika, chilli flakes, tomato paste, a pinch of salt, and a splash of the reserved pasta water. Stir until smooth and let it simmer gently until rich and glossy.

Divide the pasta and juicy beef into 5 equal portions. Top each with a few spoonfuls of the garlic mint yogurt and a drizzle of the chilli butter sauce. Garnish with chopped cherry tomatoes, fresh mint and chilli garlic seasoning. Your delicious high protein meals are ready to ENJOY!

notes: Pan on medium heat, cooking spray, cook chopped onion 8-10mins till golden and soft. Add initial seasoning mix with garlic and tomato paste. Cook for 3-4 mins till fragrant
Add lean ground beef, increase heat to high. Use spatula to break up the meat, cooking spray 8 mins or till fully brown. Add extra seasoning to taste
Once pasta is cooked, reserve some pasta water to use for later
Make this sauce ahead if time, store separately to keep fresh and unspoiled

320.intro: Pure indulgence in every bite - taking chicken and rice to the next level!

groups.name: Chicken Marinade
items: 1000g (35oz) Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cubed

groups.name: Lemon Garlic Herb Coconut Rice
items: 260g (9.1oz) Uncooked White Rice (freshly cooked or leftover cooked)
Extra Seasoning: 1 Tsp each Salt, Oregano, Parsley, Chilli Flakes

steps.text: Slice the boneless, skinless chicken thighs into bite-sized cubes. Place them in a large bowl and season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, ginger powder, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until the chicken is evenly coated and the colour deepens. Set aside to marinate.

To make the bang bang sauce, combine light mayo, yogurt, sweet chilli sauce, sriracha, rice vinegar, and freshly chopped parsley in a bowl. Mix until smooth. Separate a small amount of this sauce into another bowl—this will be used to baste the chicken during cooking.

Spread the marinated chicken cubes in a single layer on a lined sheet pan. Use a brush to lightly coat each piece with the reserved bang bang sauce. Bake or air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 22–25 minutes until golden and slightly crispy. Once cooked, while the chicken is still hot, brush over a final layer of bang bang sauce to create a glossy, flavour-packed glaze.

In a large pan over medium heat, melt a knob of butter. Add chopped garlic and onion, and sauté for 5 minutes until soft and fragrant. Add salt, oregano, parsley, chilli flakes, and shredded coconut. Stir well and cook for another 3 minutes to toast the coconut slightly. Add your cooked rice, mix thoroughly, then finish with lemon zest and a squeeze of lemon juice. Stir until the rice is fluffy and aromatic.
Serve and divide the bang bang chicken and fragrant coconut rice evenly into 5 portions. Your high-protein meals for the week are ready to ENJOY!

321.intro: Perfect sweet and savoury balance, chicken is crispy & juicy with that signature orange pepper flavour, paired with garlic herb infused rice and a tangy cucumber salad

groups.name: Orange Pepper Chicken
items: 1100g (39oz) Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, trim any excess fat
1 Large Orange Juiced + Orange Zest. I like to add bits of the pulp in the marinade for extra caramelized texture

steps.text: Trim any excess fat from the chicken thighs, then place them in a large mixing bowl. Season with salt, black pepper, and garlic powder, then add a drizzle of honey, sriracha, fresh orange juice, orange zest (add extra orange pulp for more texture when cooking), and light soy sauce. Mix thoroughly until fully combined and the colour changes. Set aside to marinate for at least 30 minutes.

Slice all the vegetables for the crunchy cucumber salad. In a large bowl or dish, add thinly sliced cucumbers, red onion, grated carrots, chopped red bell pepper, green onion/scallion, and sesame seeds, followed by a drizzle of honey and rice vinegar. Mix thoroughly until well combined, then store in separate containers and refrigerate to keep fresh and crisp for the week.

Bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Add the uncooked basmati rice (rinsed and drained beforehand) and cook for 8-10 minutes, until tender and fluffy. Drain any excess water and set aside. At the same time, line a sheet pan with parchment paper and spread the marinated chicken evenly in a single layer. Sprinkle a little extra garlic powder and black pepper over the top, then add additional orange juice and orange zest. This will help create a sticky, caramelized glaze as it cooks. Air fry or oven bake for 25-27 minutes at 200C / 400F, until golden brown and sizzling.

While the chicken cooks, heat a large pan over medium–low heat and melt light butter. Add plenty of chopped garlic and cook for about 4 minutes, until fragrant and infused into the butter. Add the leftover cooked rice, mix well, and allow it to heat through. Let the rice cool slightly before adding freshly chopped parsley, a pinch of salt, and chilli flakes. Mix until fluffy.

Once the chicken is cooked, slice it into juicy cubes, mixing it with the resting juices in the sheet pan for extra flavour. Serve and portion with the fluffy garlic rice and crunchy cucumber salad, then ENJOY!

notes: Aim for at least 30 minutes of marinating, but longer (up to a few hours in the fridge) will deepen the sweet spicy citrus flavour and help keep the chicken juicy and tender.
Spread evenly on a lined sheet pan, squeeze extra orange juice and zest. This will caramelize while cooking and create a sticky glaze. To achieve a good crust, you can broil for 2-3 mins at the end
When making the garlic butter rice, keep the heat medium low and cook the garlic gently. If it browns too much, it will turn bitter and overpower the dish.
Keep the salad in separate meal prep containers and combine right before eating to maintain crunch. The vinegar base helps preserve the texture for 2-3 days
Let the rice cool slightly before folding in the herbs to keep them vibrant and fresh. You could also top each container with a sprinkle of fresh herbs right before serving to brighten it up

When you slice the chicken and mix it back through the juices on the sheet pan, you’re essentially making a quick pan sauce. Don’t skip this step - it adds moisture and boosts that orange honey sriracha flavour.

322.intro: Absolutely phenomenal meal prep. Low effort, very simple ingredients for maximum flavour, doesn't get easier than this!

groups.name: Golden Aromatic Rice
items: 250g Uncooked Basmati Rice (cook in advance) (8.8oz / ~1.5 cups uncooked)
Few Cinnamon Sticks or cinnamon powder

steps.text: Trim any excess fat from the boneless chicken thighs, then slice into cubes and place in a mixing bowl. Season with salt, black pepper, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cinnamon, and coriander powder, then add a drizzle of olive oil, yogurt, and honey. Mix until fully coated and the colour deepens, then set aside to marinate.
In a large mixing bowl, add sliced red onion, plenty of freshly chopped parsley, sumac, a pinch of salt, and a squeeze of lemon juice. Mix well, then store in a separate container and refrigerate.

Rinse the uncooked basmati rice, then place it in a pot of water and bring to a boil. Reduce to a medium low simmer and cook until fully tender and fluffy. Meanwhile, line a sheet pan with parchment paper and spread the marinated chicken in a single, even layer. Oven bake or air fry for 25 minutes, until golden orange with crispy edges.

In a large pan over low heat, melt butter, then add a few cinnamon sticks. Cook for 2-3 minutes, until fragrant, before adding the cooked basmati rice, along with turmeric, salt, paprika, and freshly chopped parsley. Mix until every grain is golden yellow, fluffy, and aromatic.
Serve the crispy, juicy honey garlic chicken with the pickled red onions, then ENJOY!

notes: Marinate the chicken for longer if possible. The yogurt, spices, and honey help tenderise the
meat and deepen the flavour.
Infuse the butter properly with cinnamon sticks over low heat. Rushing this step reduces aroma and depth of flavour in the rice.
Rest the chicken briefly before serving, then mix with any tray juices for extra flavour and
moisture.

323.intro: Absolutely phenomenal flavours for the calories. Seriously indulgent, every bite is bursting with flavour and easy to meal prep for the week!

groups.name: Creamy Tuscan Potatoes
items: 3 Tsp Olive Oil or Cooking Spray
120g (4.2oz) Sun-dried Tomatoes, oil drained and chopped

steps.text: Slice the sirloin steaks into 1-inch cubes and place them in a mixing bowl. Season generously with salt, black pepper, parsley, chilli flakes, paprika, and garlic powder, then drizzle with olive oil. Mix well until fully coated and the colour deepens.

Slice the potatoes into small cubes. Place them in a large tray and season with salt, paprika, mixed herbs, and garlic powder, followed by a drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated, then spread them in an even layer on a lined sheet pan. Oven bake or air fry for 20 minutes at 200°C / 400°F, until golden yellow and crispy.

Heat a pan over medium heat and melt butter. Cook the steak bites for 3-4 minutes per side, until perfectly seared. Lower the heat, then add extra butter, a drizzle of honey, and fresh parsley. Mix until all steak pieces are coated in this rich honey butter glaze, then set aside. Repeat with the remaining steak bites.

In the same pan over low heat, add the chopped sun-dried tomatoes, along with salt and mixed herbs. Cook for about 2 minutes, then add evaporated milk, light cream cheese, Dijon mustard, and freshly chopped parsley. Stir continuously until the sauce becomes smooth, rich, and creamy.
Keeping the heat on low, add the crispy potatoes to the pan. Fold gently to coat the potatoes evenly in the creamy sauce. Serve and portion with the honey butter steak bites, then ENJOY!

notes: Pat the steak dry before seasoning for a better sear. Moisture on the surface prevents browning and can cause the steak to steam instead of caramelise.
Do not overcrowd the pan when searing. Cook the steak bites in batches to maintain high heat and achieve a deep golden crust.
Use medium heat for searing, then reduce to low before adding butter, honey, and parsley. This prevents the glaze from burning and helps it thicken into a sticky coating.
Keep the heat low when making the sauce. Evaporated milk and cream cheese can split if overheated, so gentle heat ensures a smooth, creamy texture.

324.intro: Pure comfort for a fraction of the calories. Every bite is indulgent, packed with 65g of protein & easy to meal prep!

groups.name: Garlic Steak Bites
items: 1000g (35.2oz) Raw Sirloin or Topside Beef, cut into 1 inch cubes

groups.name: Fluffy Mashed Potatoes
items: 1000g (35.2oz) Raw Potatoes, peeled cut into chunks

groups.name: Creamy Mushroom Sauce
items: 3-4 Sprigs of Fresh Thyme or Dried Thyme

steps.text: Slice the steaks into 1-inch cubes and place them in a mixing bowl. Season generously with salt, black pepper, Italian herbs, garlic powder, parsley, and a drizzle of olive oil. Mix until evenly coated, then set aside to marinate briefly.

Wash and peel the potatoes, then slice them into thick chunks. Place them in a pot of cold water and bring to a boil. Cook for about 20 minutes, or until fork-tender. Drain the water, then cover the pot with a lid and let the potatoes steam for 5 minutes.

Once steamed, use a potato masher to mash the potatoes gently until smooth and free of clumps. While still steaming hot, add a knob of butter, warm milk, and a good pinch of salt. Use a spatula to mix thoroughly until perfectly smooth and fluffy, then set aside.

Line a sheet pan with chopped broccoli florets, red onion, grated Parmesan, Italian herbs, garlic powder, salt, and chilli flakes, then spray with avocado cooking oil. Mix well with your hands until fully coated and spread into an even layer. Oven roast or air fry for 18 minutes at 180°C / 370°F, until golden and crispy.
Heat a pan over medium high heat and spray with cooking oil. Cook the steak bites for 3-4 minutes per side, until seared and golden. Set aside and repeat with the remaining steak.

In the same pan over medium heat, add the sliced brown mushrooms. Cook for about 5 minutes, until softened. Reduce the heat, then add fresh thyme, salt, black pepper, Dijon mustard, light cream cheese, and evaporated milk. Stir continuously with a spatula until melted, smooth, and richly creamy.
Serve the steak bites alongside the mashed potatoes and Parmesan roasted broccoli, then top with the creamy mushroom sauce and ENJOY!

notes: Start the potatoes in cold water. This ensures they cook evenly from the inside out and prevents a gluey texture.
Always steam the potatoes after draining (5 minutes covered). This removes excess moisture, helping the mash become light and fluffy instead of watery.
Mash the potatoes while hot, before they cool. Adding butter and warm milk at this stage allows them to absorb properly for a smooth, creamy consistency.
Avoid over-mashing. Overworking potatoes breaks down the starch and can make them gummy; stop once smooth and lump-free.
Pat the steak dry before searing for the best crust. Moisture prevents browning and causes the steak to steam.
Cook steak bites in batches. Overcrowding the pan drops the temperature and stops proper searing.
Lower the heat before adding mustard, cream cheese, and evaporated milk. High heat can cause the sauce to split or become grainy.

325.intro: Pure comfort in each bite - crispy juicy chicken paired with salt n pepper fries and a creamy homemade coleslaw. An incredible combo you have to try!

groups.name: Tandoori Chicken
items: 1100g (39oz) Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat

groups.name: Crispy Fries
items: 1100g (39oz) Uncooked White or Yellow Potatoes, cut into fries

steps.text: Trim any excess fat from the boneless chicken thighs, then place them in a large mixing bowl. Season with tandoori masala, black pepper, smoked paprika, garlic powder, cumin, and coriander powder, then add olive oil, yogurt, and a squeeze of lemon juice. Mix well until fully combined and the colour deepens. Set aside to marinate - the longer it rests, the more intense the flavour will be.

While the chicken marinates, slice and chop the vegetables for the coleslaw. In a large bowl, add shredded cabbage, grated carrots, sliced red onion, freshly chopped coriander, a pinch of salt and pepper, yogurt, light mayo, a drizzle of honey, and a squeeze of lemon juice. Mix thoroughly until creamy and fully combined, then store in separate containers and refrigerate for the week.

Line a sheet pan with parchment paper. Spread the marinated chicken thighs in a single layer and sprinkle a little extra tandoori seasoning on top. Oven bake or air fry for 20-25 minutes, until cooked through, golden, crispy and absolutely delicious.
While the chicken cooks, slice the washed potatoes into fries. Season with black pepper and garlic powder, then spray with cooking oil (such as avocado oil spray). Mix until well coated.
Once the chicken is cooked, set it aside to rest. Then oven bake or air fry the fries for 22-27 minutes at 200C / 400F, until golden and crispy. Once cooked, sprinkle salt over them to taste.

Slice the tandoori chicken into juicy cubes, making sure to mix it with the resting juices left in the sheet pan for extra flavour. Serve and portion with the crispy fries and creamy coleslaw, then ENJOY!

notes: The yogurt, lemon juice, and spices in the marinade help tenderise the chicken and infuse flavour. For the best results, marinate for at least 1 hour, or overnight if possible.
Make sure the chicken thighs are not overlapping. Air circulation is key for crispy edges and caramelisation.
Once cooked, rest the chicken for 5 minutes before slicing into cubes. Make sure to mix with all the resting juices from the pan - no flavour gets wasted!
Add salt to the fries after cooking. Sprinkling salt later helps prevent excess moisture release during cooking, keeping them crisp.
Make the salad in batches and store it separately in the fridge to keep it fresh and crisp throughout the week.
Use salt lightly in the coleslaw to prevent it becoming watery.
When reheating, reheat the chicken and fries in the air fryer for 5 minutes at 190°C for the best texture.

326.intro: This combo is truly INCREDIBLE! Chicken is so flavorful, served on top of seasoned fries and topped with pickled onions and a delicious white sauce!

1 Tsp each Salt, Black Pepper, Paprika, Cumin

steps.text: Slice the chicken breasts into thin strips and place them in a bowl. Add olive oil, minced garlic, 1.5 servings of shawarma spice mix, and a squeeze of lemon juice. Mix thoroughly until well coated—if the color isn’t vibrant, add more seasoning. Let marinate while prepping the fries.

While the chicken and fries cook, prepare the white sauce. In a bowl, whisk together sour cream, mayo, minced garlic, black pepper, and a squeeze of lemon juice until smooth. Transfer to a bottle and refrigerate for meal prep use.
