notes: Pan-fry the chicken in light butter or air fry—both methods offer great results.
Make the white sauce in bulk and store it in the fridge for other meals.
Serve the white sauce, pickled onions, and feta cheese fresh when ready to eat.

327.intro: An incredible combo, packed with flavour and perfect for weight loss.

groups.name: Honey Buffalo Sauce
items: ½ Tsp each: Garlic Powder, Smoked Paprika, Black Pepper

groups.name: Serve With
items: 200g Uncooked Basmati Rice/Approx 135g Cooked Rice per serving

steps.text: Slice the chicken breasts into cubes and place them in a bowl. Add minced garlic, black pepper, onion powder, paprika, salt, and olive oil. Toss until evenly coated, then set aside to marinate.

Prepare the honey buffalo sauce by blending mayo, buffalo hot sauce, honey, lemon juice, garlic powder, paprika, and black pepper until smooth and creamy. Transfer to a bottle for easy use throughout the week. (Tip: Start cooking the white rice now so it’s ready by the time everything else is done)

For the crunchy slaw, combine thinly sliced red cabbage, grated carrots, chopped green onion, and fresh cilantro in a bowl. Add mayo, honey, salt, and black pepper, then toss until well incorporated. Store separately for easier reheating.

Heat a pan over medium-high heat and melt butter. Add the marinated chicken and cook for 4 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy. Lower the heat, then drizzle in honey and buffalo sauce, stirring until the chicken is well coated and the sauce thickens slightly. Set aside and repeat for any remaining chicken.
Assemble the meal by serving the hot rice with crispy honey buffalo chicken and crunchy slaw on the side. Drizzle with extra sauce, garnish with fresh cilantro, and ENJOY!

notes: Lower the heat before adding honey and buffalo sauce. Let it simmer for 1–2 minutes until the glaze thickens.
Store the sauce and crunchy slaw separately from the chicken for easier reheating. Serve fresh when ready to eat.

328.intro: My take on a very popular Korean dish! Genuinely one of the tastiest meal preps i’ve made.

groups.name: Serve With
items: 210g (7.4oz) Uncooked Short Grain or Basmati Rice/Approx 140g Cooked Rice per serving

steps.text: In a bowl, combine dark soy sauce, light soy sauce, honey, minced garlic, gochujang paste, and sesame seeds. Whisk until well mixed and set aside. (Tip: Start cooking the rice now so it’s ready when serving)

Heat a pan over high heat and melt butter. Add the ground beef and cook for 6–8 minutes, using a spatula to break it up as it browns. Once fully cooked, pour in the prepared sauce along with chopped green onion. Stir and cook for another 5 minutes until well combined, golden brown, and slightly crispy. Remove from heat.

For the quick pickled cucumber slaw, combine sliced cucumber, grated carrot, soy sauce, rice vinegar, garlic powder, chili flakes, and sesame seeds in a large bowl. Mix well with a spoon, then store separately to keep the texture fresh.
To make the spicy mayo, whisk together mayo, sriracha, garlic powder, and lemon juice until smooth. Transfer to a squeeze bottle for easy use throughout the week.

Assemble the meal by serving the flavorful beef with the hot rice, adding a side of pickled cucumber slaw and a generous drizzle of spicy sauce. Garnish with extra green onion and sesame seeds, then ENJOY!

notes: Store pickled cucumbers separately and keep the sauce in a squeezy bottle for easier reheating. Serve when ready to eat.
Reheat beef and rice in a pan or pot on low heat, covered, for 5 minutes. Add a splash of water if it’s too dry.

329.intro: Combining two of the most popular dishes into one! So indulgent, creamy, packed with protein and perfect to meal prep for the week ahead!

groups.name: Pasta
items: 270g Uncooked Penne Pasta (Or use protein pasta)

groups.name: Butter Chicken Sauce
items: Spice Mix: ½ Tsp each Smoked Paprika, Turmeric, Garam Masala, Chilli Powder, Salt, Black Pepper

steps.text: Slice the chicken breasts into cubes and place them in a bowl. Add minced garlic, smoked paprika, turmeric, garam masala, chili powder, salt, black pepper, yogurt, and lemon juice. Mix until evenly coated, then set aside to marinate.

Heat a pan over medium heat and melt butter. Add thinly sliced onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft and fragrant. Stir in the spice mix, ensuring the onions are well coated, then add canned chopped tomatoes and cashew nuts.

Mix well and let everything cook for another 5 minutes on medium-low heat. Turn off the heat and stir in yogurt, then let the mixture cool for 5 minutes. (Tip: Transfer to a large dish for faster cooling)
While the sauce cools, bring a pot of water to a boil and cook the penne pasta for 7–8 minutes until al dente. Once cooked, reserve 1 cup of pasta water, then drain the rest.
Transfer the cooled sauce to a blender, add ½ cup of pasta water, and blend for 2–3 minutes until completely smooth and creamy.

Reheat the pan over medium-high heat, melt butter, and cook the marinated chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden brown. Lower the heat, then pour in the butter chicken sauce and add the cooked pasta. Stir until well combined and heated through.
Garnish with fresh coriander and white sauce, then evenly portion, serve and ENJOY!

notes: Marinate the chicken overnight for the best flavor, but 10–15 minutes works if short on time.
Use fresh tomatoes instead of canned to reduce acidity and add natural sweetness.
Let the sauce cool before blending to prevent pressure buildup and spills.
Turn off the heat before adding yogurt to keep the sauce smooth and prevent curdling.

330.intro: One of the best breakfast combos, so much flavour, filling and easy to meal prep for busy mornings!

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into small cubes and season with oregano, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Toss until evenly coated, then spread them on a plate and microwave for 5 minutes until soft and fork-tender.
Heat a pan over medium heat and add olive oil. Cook the microwaved potatoes for 4 minutes to crisp them up slightly, then add paprika, chopped red onion, red bell pepper, and chopped turkey bacon.
Stir everything together until the potatoes are well mixed with the vegetables and turkey bacon. Cook for another 5 minutes until golden brown and crispy, then set aside.

In the same pan over low heat, pour in the whisked eggs. Stir gently with a spatula for 4–5 minutes, scrambling them slowly. Just before they fully cook, add cream cheese and fold it in gently until melted, creating a fluffy, creamy texture.
Serve the creamy scrambled eggs alongside the crispy potato mix, drizzle with spicy mayo, garnish with fresh parsley, and ENJOY!

notes: Microwave potatoes in batches for 4–5 minutes, laying them flat for even softening and quicker cooking.
Crisp up potatoes in the pan for 4–5 minutes on medium-high heat before adding other ingredients. Add cooking spray or olive oil if needed.
Cook eggs on medium-low heat for a soft, fluffy texture. Stir in cream cheese until fully melted and combined.

331.intro: One of the easiest and most delicious pastas, perfect for meal prep & incredibly easy to make!

groups.name: Pasta
items: 250g Uncooked Fusilli Pasta (or pasta of choice)

steps.text: Chop the garlic cloves, red bell pepper, and tomatoes. Heat a pan over medium heat, add olive oil, and sauté the garlic for 2 minutes until fragrant. Then, add the chopped bell peppers and tomatoes.
Season with Italian herbs, paprika, salt, and black pepper, then cook for 5 minutes until soft and fragrant. Transfer the mixture to a dish and let it cool while preparing the next step.
Bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Add the fusilli pasta and cook for 8 minutes until al dente. Reserve ½ cup of pasta water, then drain the rest and set the pasta aside.
In a blender cup, combine the cooled vegetable mixture, cream cheese, and reserved pasta water. Blend for 2 minutes until completely smooth and creamy. The sauce should be a vibrant orange color.

Return the pan to high heat, add a drizzle of olive oil, and cook the ground beef with extra seasoning (Italian herbs, paprika, salt, black pepper) for 6–8 minutes. Use a spatula to break up the meat while cooking until fully browned with no pink bits remaining.

Lower the heat and pour the creamy sauce over the beef, followed by the cooked pasta. Stir gently until well combined and indulgent. Let it simmer on low heat for 3–4 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly.
Garnish with fresh parsley and parmesan, then serve and distribute evenly. ENJOY!

notes: Let the tomato mixture cool completely before blending to prevent pressure buildup and spills.
After combining pasta and sauce, let it simmer for 3–4 minutes to thicken and coat the pasta.
Freeze for later and reheat on low heat for 5 minutes. Add a splash of milk, cover, and heat until creamy again.

332.intro: There’s no reason to be eating plain Chicken & Rice! This One Pan Chicken Fajita Rice is a game changer for meal prep!

groups.name: Fajita Rice
items: 230g (8.1oz) Uncooked Basmati Rice/ Approx. 520g Cooked Rice
1 Tsp each: Salt, Paprika, Cumin, Garlic Powder, Turmeric

steps.text: Butterfly slice the chicken breasts into thinner fillets/cutlets. Season both sides evenly with oregano, garlic powder, cumin, smoked paprika, salt, black pepper, and olive oil. Rub the spices into the chicken until fully coated, then set aside.

Thinly slice the onions and bell peppers for later. For the creamy green sauce, blend yogurt, mayo, garlic cloves, fresh coriander, salt, black pepper, and lemon juice until smooth. Adjust seasoning to taste and set aside.
Heat a pan over medium heat and add olive oil. Cook the chicken cutlets for 3–4 minutes per side until golden brown and fully cooked. Set aside and repeat until all the chicken is done.

In the same pan over medium heat, add the sliced onions and bell peppers. Sauté for 4–5 minutes until soft and fragrant. Stir in the washed uncooked rice along with the spice mix (salt, paprika, cumin, garlic powder, turmeric).
Mix everything well and toast the rice for 2 minutes, then add water or stock. Bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook on low heat for 8-10 minutes until the rice is fluffy and fully cooked.
Slice the chicken cutlets into thin strips, then serve over the fajita-seasoned rice. Drizzle generously with the creamy green sauce and ENJOY!

notes: Season the chicken thoroughly on both sides to ensure even flavor in every bite.
Toast the rice with the veggies and spices for a deeper, more aromatic flavor before adding water.
Let the rice come to a gentle boil, then cover and simmer for 8–10 minutes until fully cooked and fluffy.

333.intro: This will guarantee be your new favourite pasta meal prep! Perfect balance of sweet and spicy - incredibly flavourful chicken paired with spicy chipotle creamy pasta.

groups.name: Chipotle Chicken
items: 1.5 tsp each: Salt, Cumin, Smoked Paprika
200g (7oz) Uncooked Penne Pasta (or pasta of choice)

groups.name: Creamy Sauce
items: 1 Tsp Chipotle Chilli Flakes (omit for less heat)

steps.text: Start by slicing the chicken breasts into cubes, then season with chipotle paste, minced garlic, honey, lime juice, salt, cumin and smoked paprika. Mix till the color changes then set aside to marinate
Now cook your pasta. Get water in a pot, bring to a boil then add your pasta and boil for 8-9 mins till al dente. Once cooked, remove ½ cup pasta water and drain the rest then set aside
Next for the creamy sauce, in a blender cup add milk, cream cheese, parmesan,chipotle paste, chili flakes, salt, pasta water. Blend till smooth and creamy!
Then get a pan on medium heat, melt down butter and cook the chicken for 8-10 min (4-5 mins each side) till golden brown and charred

Once the chicken is cooked, lower the heat then add the cooked pasta with the creamy sauce over it and give it all a thorough gentle mix till well incorporated. Let it simmer for 1-2 mins to thicken the sauce then you’re ready to serve and distribute evenly, garnish with fresh parsley and ENJOY!

notes: Marinate the chicken for at least 30 minutes or overnight for deeper flavor.
Swap chipotle paste for other chili pastes or tomato paste if needed.
Ensure the sauce isn’t too watery before blending; it will thicken when heated in the pan.
Store for up to 4 days and reheat in a pan or microwave when ready to eat.

334.intro: No more boring chicken & rice! This is some of the best tasting chicken i’ve made. Packed with flavor, so juicy & perfect with fragrant garlic herb rice.

groups.name: Garlic Herb Chicken
items: 20g (1.5 Tbsp) Garlic Paste or Minced Garlic
1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (omit for milder flavour)

steps.text: Place the chicken thighs in a mixing bowl. Add garlic paste, salt, black pepper, mixed herbs, parsley, paprika, chili flakes, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until well coated, then set aside to marinate.

While the chicken marinates, cook the rice by boiling it in a pot of water for 8–10 minutes. Once done, drain any excess water and set aside. While the rice cooks, chop the garlic, red onion, and bell peppers.
Heat a pan over medium heat, melt butter, and cook the chicken thighs for 5–6 minutes per side until a deep golden crust forms. Once cooked, set aside to rest. Repeat for the rest of the chicken.

In the same pan over medium-low heat, sauté the chopped garlic, onion, and bell peppers for 5–6 minutes until soft and fragrant. Stir in extra seasoning (salt, pepper, mixed herbs, parsley, paprika) till the the onions and peppers catch colour
Add the cooked basmati rice and mix well until every grain is coated in the spices and takes on a vibrant orange color.
Garnish the rice with freshly chopped parsley. Slice the chicken thighs into cubes, serve with the rice, and ENJOY!

notes: Marinate the chicken for at least 30 minutes or overnight for the best flavor.
Cook the chicken thighs over medium heat with a little butter or cooking spray for 5–6 minutes per side until a deep golden crust forms.
Mix the cooked rice thoroughly to ensure every grain is coated in seasoning and vibrant in color. Add extra paprika and salt if needed.
Slice the chicken thighs into cubes and serve over the rice. Finish with a squeeze of lemon juice or pair with a sauce of your choice.

335.intro: Truly one of the best and tastiest meal preps, flavours are incredible, easy to make and very filling!

groups.name: Garlic Teriyaki Beef
items: 20g (1.5 Tbsp) Minced Garlic or Garlic Paste

groups.name: Low Cal Yum Yum Sauce
items: Dash of Milk for desired consistency

groups.name: Garlic Fried Rice
items: 200g Dry Weight / ~520g Cooked White Rice (I use basmati but you can use short grain rice)

steps.text: First chop up all your vegetables, this includes green onions, white onion, garlic and coriander/cilantro. And also cook your rice by boiling in a pot or use leftover rice
Get a pan on high heat, melt down some butter then cook all your ground beef for 6-8 mins till completely brown and no pink bits remain. Use a spatula to break up the meat to cook quicker
Once cooked lower the heat to medium heat, add lots of minced garlic, soy sauce, honey or maple syrup, rice vinegar, green part of the green onion and sesame seeds
Mix till well incorporated then cook the beef for another 5 mins till golden brown and slightly crispy. Once cooked set the beef aside
Now in the same pan add chopped garlic white onion and the white part of green onion. Cook these for 5-6 mins on medium heat till soft and fragrant then push to the side of the pan
Add in your whisked eggs and use a spatula to keep stirring gently till the eggs are scrambled. Once ready, mix with all the veg
Now make a well in the middle and add in your cooked rice with more soy sauce, chilli garlic sauce, green onion, coriander and sesame seeds.
Mix everything till well combined and every grain of rice is coloured
For the Yum Yum sauce, In a bowl combine yogurt, light mayo, ketchup, sriracha, garlic powder and a dash of milk. Mix till smooth then bottle this up!
Finally serve with the beef and the fried rice then ENJOY your high protein meals for the week!

notes: Cook the beef on high heat for 6-8 mins to develop a good brown colour
Lower the heat to medium when adding the garlic, soy sauce and maple syrup
Let the beef cook for another 5 mins to get crispy then set aside
Cook the onions and garlic for 5 mins till softened
Push the veg to the side and cook the eggs on low heat till scrambled
When adding the rice and extra soy sauce, give everything a good mix to coat every grain of rice. Add extra soy sauce if needed to darken

336.intro: One of the most indulgent combos, bursting with flavour, easy to make and great for meal prep! The garlic parmesan steak goes SO WELL with the creamy Alfredo.

groups.name: Garlic Parmesan Steak Bites
items: 800g (28oz) Raw Topside/ Top Sirloin, 1 inch cubed

groups.name: For Cooking & Final Coating
items: 30g (2 Tbsp) Garlic Paste or Minced Garlic

groups.name: Alfredo Pasta
items: 1 Tsp each: Salt, Black Pepper, Italian Herbs, Parsley, Smoked Paprika
210g (7.4oz) Uncooked Linguine Pasta (or pasta of choice)
50g ( ¼ Cup) Pasta Water (Optional for sauce consistency)

steps.text: Slice the beef steaks into bite-sized cubes. Season with salt, black pepper, Italian herbs, parsley, garlic powder, smoked paprika, and olive oil. Mix well until evenly coated.
Bring a pot of water to a boil, then add your pasta of choice. Cook for 8–10 minutes until al dente. Reserve 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain the rest and set aside.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat, add butter, and sear the steak bites for 2 minutes per side until a golden-brown crust forms.

Once cooked, lower the heat and add extra butter, minced garlic, and grated parmesan. Stir until the steak bites are well coated in this flavourful butter, then set aside. Repeat for the remaining steak bites.
In the same pan over low heat, sauté chopped garlic and onion for 5 minutes until soft and fragrant. Stir in the extra seasonings (salt, pepper, Italian herbs, parsley, smoked paprika).
Mix until the spices are well combined, then add evaporated milk, cream cheese, parmesan, and reserved pasta water. Stir gently until smooth and thickened.
Add the cooked pasta into the creamy sauce, stirring until fully combined and coated. Serve with the juicy steak bites, and your high-protein meal prep is ready for the week!

notes: Marinate steak bites for at least 30 minutes for deeper flavor.
Sear on medium-high heat with butter for 2 minutes per side until a golden crust forms.
Add milk and cream cheese on low heat to prevent splitting. Stir until smooth, let it bubble slightly to thicken, then mix in cooked pasta.
Freezes well and reheats easily. Warm in a pan or microwave for 5 minutes on low, adding a splash of milk to restore creaminess.

337.intro: Truly one of the best combos, the perfect balance of sweet, savoury and spicy! Also another great way to add variety to your weekly meal preps.

groups.name: Mac N Cheese
items: 60g (2.1oz) Buffalo Hot Sauce (or any hot sauce)

steps.text: Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized cubes. In a bowl, mix with minced garlic, black pepper, paprika, salt, and olive oil until evenly coated. Adjust seasoning if you need a deeper color.
Meanwhile, cook the macaroni pasta in a pot of water for 8 mins until al dente. Drain and set aside.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat and lightly coat with cooking spray. Sear the chicken cubes for 3–4 minutes per side until they are golden brown and nicely charred.
Turn off the heat completely, then drizzle honey and BBQ sauce over the chicken. Toss well until every piece is coated and juicy, then transfer to a bowl. Repeat for the remaining chicken.
In the same pan over low heat, add milk, hot sauce (such as buffalo sauce), cream cheese, and shredded cheddar cheese. Whisk gently until the mixture is smooth and creamy.
Stir the cooked macaroni into the cheese sauce until thoroughly combined. Garnish with chopped parsley, then serve with the delicious BBQ chicken, divide into 4 equal servings and ENJOY!

notes: Cook chicken on medium-high heat for 3–4 minutes per side until golden brown.
Turn off the heat before adding honey and BBQ sauce to prevent burning.
For the creamy sauce, add all ingredients on low heat and stir gently (preferably with a whisk) until thick and smooth.
Store in the fridge for up to 4 days or freeze for later. Reheat in a pan or microwave when ready to eat.

338.intro: Macro friendly comfort food at its best! Welcome to my new series where i will be making the world’s best comfort foods healthier and still packed with flavour!

groups.name: Creamy Sauce
items: ½ tsp each: Garlic Powder, Italian Herbs, Salt, Paprika

steps.text: Slice the chicken breasts into thinner halves. In a bowl, season with garlic powder, Italian herbs, salt, paprika, olive oil, and grated parmesan. Rub in thoroughly to ensure both sides are evenly coated, then set aside to marinate.
Cut the washed potatoes into 1-inch cubes. Place them in a pot of water and boil for 12–14 minutes until fork-tender. Drain the water and allow the remaining steam to evaporate any excess moisture.
Using a potato masher, mash the potatoes until smooth and fluffy. Be careful not to over-mash; you want to maintain a pleasant texture.
Stir in a knob of butter, evaporated milk, garlic powder, salt, and freshly cracked black pepper. Mix until the mash is smooth and well combined.

Heat a pan over medium-low heat and cook the marinated chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden and crispy, forming a flavor-packed crust. Once cooked, set the chicken aside. Repeat for the remaining chicken cutlets.
In the same pan on low heat, add the same spices used for the chicken to toast in the remaining oil. Then, stir in milk, light cream cheese, and parmesan until the sauce is smooth and well blended.

Continue stirring the sauce until it becomes completely smooth and creamy, letting it bubble slightly to thicken. Chop the rested chicken into bite-sized pieces, then serve by layering the creamy mash with the sauce and topping with the chopped chicken. ENJOY!

notes: Coat the chicken evenly with seasoning on both sides; add more if needed.
Cook on medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes in a non-stick pan (no butter or oil) until a golden crust forms.
(Optional) Peel potatoes, boil until fork-tender (12–14 minutes), then drain and mash until smooth.
For reheating, warm everything in a pan on low for 5 minutes; store the creamy sauce separately for best results.

339.intro: The most incredible combo, bursting with flavour, packed with protein and so easy to make.

groups.name: Marinated Chicken
items: 800g (28oz) Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cubed
20g (1.5 Tbsp) Minced Garlic or Garlic Paste

groups.name: Butter Chicken Sauce
items: ½ Tsp each: Salt, Garam Masala, Paprika, Turmeric

steps.text: Trim any excess fat from the chicken thighs and cut into cubes. In a bowl, marinate the chicken with minced garlic, salt, garam masala, paprika, turmeric, chilli powder, yogurt, and lemon juice.
Mix the chicken thoroughly until its color deepens, then set aside. Next, slice the potatoes into small cubes and season with salt, paprika, garam masala, garlic powder, and olive oil.
Mix the potatoes till well coated then place on a sheet pan/tray and oven or air fry for 20-23mins at 200C/400F till golden and crispy

Spread the marinated chicken on a separate sheet pan or tray and cook in the oven or air fryer at 200°C/400°F for 18–20 minutes until golden and juicy. (Tip: You can cook the chicken and potatoes simultaneously if your equipment allows)
In a pan over medium heat, melt butter and add sliced onions, salt, garam masala, paprika, and turmeric. Sauté for 5–6 minutes until the onions are soft and fragrant.
Make a well in the center of the pan and add minced garlic, cashew nuts, and the tomatoes (canned or fresh). Stir thoroughly, then cover with a lid and let it simmer on low heat for 6–8 minutes.
Stir the mixture, then allow it to cool before transferring to a blender. Blend for 2–3 minutes until completely smooth.
Return the blended sauce to the pan and add yogurt, evaporated milk, and a few small cubes of butter. Stir gently until the sauce becomes creamy.

Fold in the cooked chicken, mixing thoroughly so each piece is well coated. Finally, distribute the butter chicken with the masala potatoes into 4 portions and drizzle with the white sauce then ENJOY!

notes: Use cubed chicken breast as an alternative—marinate for at least 30 minutes or overnight for deeper flavor.
Pan-cook the chicken over medium heat for 3–4 minutes per side as another option.
Sauté onions in butter for at least 5 minutes until softened, then add garlic and cashews before stirring in the tomatoes.
Cover and cook on low heat for 6–8 minutes until the tomatoes break down.
Let the sauce cool completely before blending to prevent pressure buildup.

340.intro: Every bite is bursting with flavour! Taste is absolutely incredible for how simple and low calorie.

groups.name: Taco Spice Mix (1 Serving)
items: 1 Tsp each: Salt, Black Pepper, Garlic Powder, Onion Powder, Paprika, Oregano, Cumin

groups.name: Crispy Taco Fries
items: 900g Raw Potatoes, cut into thin fries

steps.text: Slice the washed potatoes into thin French fries. Mix with 1 serving of taco spice mix and a drizzle of olive oil until evenly coated.
Arrange the fries on a lined sheet pan and oven bake or air fry at 200°C/400°F for 20–25 minutes until golden and crispy.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat, add butter, and cook all the ground beef for 5–7 minutes, breaking it up with a spatula until browned

Once the beef is browned, stir in 1 serving of taco spice mix, tomato paste, chopped jalapeños, and jalapeño juice. Cook for 2 more minutes until the mixture is juicy and flavours intensify then set aside

Using the same pan on low heat, add evaporated milk, American cheese slices, sharp cheddar, and a splash of jalapeño juice. Stir until the cheeses melt and the sauce becomes silky smooth. (This sauce can be stored in a container and refrigerated for later use)

Prepare the side salad by combining chopped tomatoes, red onion, red and green bell peppers, avocado, coriander, lime juice, honey, salt, and black pepper in a bowl. Toss until well combined and store separately.
To serve, distribute the crispy taco fries evenly and top with the juicy jalapeño beef. Drizzle generously with the nacho cheese sauce and serve alongside the fresh salad. ENJOY!

notes: Prepare the nacho cheese sauce on low heat, stirring until thick and smooth. Store in a bottle and reheat before use, as it will harden when cooled.
Keep the side salad in a separate container—it stays fresh for 4–5 days.
For reheating, warm the beef and fries in a pan, or air fry the fries for 4–5 minutes for extra crispiness.

341.intro: There’s no reason to meal prep boring and plain chicken & rice!

steps.text: Slice the chicken breasts into small ½‑inch cubes. In a bowl, combine with minced garlic, salt, oregano, smoked paprika, chilli flakes, cumin, olive oil, and lemon juice. Mix thoroughly until well coated.
Prepare the white sauce by whisking together yogurt, mayo, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and a squeeze of lemon juice until smooth. Transfer to a bottle and refrigerate.
Cook the white rice according to package instructions. Meanwhile, chop the lettuce, tomatoes, and cucumbers for the salad. Season the salad to taste - I like a light sprinkle of chilli flakes.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat with a knob of butter. Cook the marinated chicken for 3–4 minutes per side until golden brown and juicy.
Reduce the heat to low and add extra butter and freshly chopped coriander to the chicken. Stir until the chicken is evenly coated, then remove from heat and set aside. Repeat for all the chicken.
In the same pan, add chopped garlic and either harissa or tomato paste. Sauté for 2 minutes, then add additional spices with a dash of water. Stir for another minute until well combined.

Add the cooked rice to the pan and mix thoroughly until every grain is infused with the vibrant spice mix. Finally, serve the red rice alongside the chicken and salad, drizzle with the white sauce, and ENJOY!

notes: Marinate the chicken for at least 30 minutes—or overnight for deeper flavor.
Cook the chicken in a little butter over medium-high heat for 3–4 minutes per side until a rich, golden-brown crust forms.
Store the sauce in a bottle in the fridge for future meals—double the batch if needed.
Keep the side salad separate or prepare fresh when serving.

342.intro: Packed full of fresh flavours, with a rich buffalo sauce taste paired perfectly with crispy potatoes and salsa

groups.name: Fresh Side Salad
items: ½ Tsp each: Salt, Black Pepper, Garlic Powder, Cumin

steps.text: Slice the chicken breasts into small ½‑inch cubes. Season with salt, parsley, garlic powder, cumin, smoked paprika, and olive oil. Toss until evenly coated, then set aside.

Chop the potatoes into small cubes and spread them on a lined sheet pan (use baking paper). Season with salt, smoked paprika, garlic powder, cumin, and parsley, then drizzle with olive oil or lightly coat with cooking spray. Mix till well coated.
Air fry or bake the seasoned potatoes in a preheated oven at 200°C/400°F for 18–20 minutes until golden and crispy.
While the potatoes cook, prepare the creamy buffalo sauce. In a bowl, combine buffalo hot sauce, yogurt, mayo, and honey. Mix until the sauce is smooth and slightly thick.
For the fresh salad, combine chopped tomatoes, red onions, cucumber, green onions, and parsley in a large bowl. Season with your preferred spices and a squeeze of lemon juice; toss thoroughly.

Heat a pan over medium-high heat and add butter. Cook the marinated chicken for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and charred. Once cooked, lower the heat and add additional buffalo hot sauce and a bit more butter, stirring to coat the chicken evenly.
Ensure the chicken is well coated, then serve it alongside the crispy potatoes and fresh salad. Drizzle with the creamy buffalo sauce, and ENJOY!

notes: Slice the chicken into smaller cubes than usual and season thoroughly—add extra if needed.
Prepare the buffalo sauce and side salad in advance—store the sauce in a bottle in the fridge and keep the salad separate for easier reheating.
Reheat chicken and potatoes in an air fryer at 200°C for 5–6 minutes to restore crispiness.
Important: Lower the heat before adding buffalo sauce to the pan to ensure it coats the chicken properly.

343.intro: This is without a doubt one of the greatest fusion combos!

steps.text: Slice the chicken into cubes and place in a bowl. Add fresh garlic, butter chicken spice mix, yogurt, and lemon juice. Toss until evenly coated and set aside to marinate.

Wash the potatoes and cut them into fries. Season with salt, garlic, paprika, cumin, garam masala, and olive oil. Toss well, then spread on a baking tray. Air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 20 minutes until golden and crispy.
While the fries are cooking, heat a pan over medium-high heat and melt butter. Add sliced onions and sauté for 5 minutes until soft and fragrant.
Stir in chopped tomatoes, extra butter chicken spice mix, and cashew nuts. Simmer for 8–10 minutes until the mixture reduces to a sauce-like consistency.
Turn off the heat and stir in yogurt. Let the mixture cool slightly before transferring it to a blender. Blend for 2–3 minutes until smooth. Allow the sauce to cool further if needed.
In a clean pan over high heat, cook the marinated chicken for 8 minutes until golden. Reduce the heat to medium and add the blended butter chicken sauce. Stir until the chicken is well coated.

Gently combine the chicken with the crispy fries. Top with cheese and cover the pan for 2 minutes to allow the cheese to melt. Garnish with freshly chopped coriander and a sprinkle of chilli flakes. Serve and ENJOY!

notes: Marinate the chicken for at least 30 minutes—or overnight for maximum flavor.
If you don’t have an air fryer, bake the fries in a preheated oven at 200°C/400°F for 20 minutes.
Use fresh chopped tomatoes instead of canned for a brighter, fresher butter chicken sauce.
Let the sauce cool completely before blending to avoid pressure build-up.

344.intro: Combining 2 of the best comfort foods, the flavours will blow you away!

steps.text: Slice your sirloin beef into extra thin strips. Place in a bowl and add 2 servings of shawarma spice mix, olive oil, and lemon juice. Mix in thoroughly and set aside to marinate.
Bring a pot of water to a boil and add your macaroni pasta. Cook for 8 minutes until al dente, then reserve some pasta water, drain the rest, and set the pasta aside.
Prepare the red onion mix by thinly slicing 2 large red onions and combining them in a bowl with chopped parsley, sumac, and lemon juice. Mix well and set aside.

Heat a pan on high heat with some butter. Sear the marinated beef for 1–2 minutes, then reduce the heat to medium and add extra butter and parsley. Mix well for 1-2 minutes until evenly coated and golden brown. Remove the beef from the pan and set aside. Repeat for the remaining beef.
In the same pan, add extra shawarma spice mix to the leftover oil and toast for 2 minutes. Stir in evaporated milk, cream cheese, cheddar, and some reserved pasta water.
Keep the heat at medium-low and stir the sauce until it’s smooth and creamy, letting it bubble slightly. Then add the cooked pasta and toss until creamy and well combined.
Divide the mac n cheese with the shawarma beef and sumac onion mix evenly into 4 containers, serve, and ENJOY!

notes: Slice the beef very thinly for quick cooking, tenderness, and maximum flavor absorption.
Make sumac onions in batches and store them separately in the fridge for future meals.
Toast the spices in the beef’s residual oil for 1–2 minutes before adding milk to the mac sauce. Let it bubble, then lower the heat before mixing in the pasta.
Reheat in a pan on low heat or in the microwave for 5 minutes.

345.intro: If you love Chinese Food but you want to lose weight, this high protein and low calorie Black Pepper Beef will satisfy your takeout cravings.

groups.name: Beef Marinade
items: 800g (28oz) Raw Topside/Top Sirloin Beef, thinly sliced

groups.name: Garlic Fried Rice
items: 200g (7oz) Uncooked White Rice/540g Cooked Leftover Rice (basmati or jasmine)
1 Tsp Red Pepper Flakes to garnish

steps.text: Slice the beef steaks into extra thin strips. In a bowl, combine with dark and light soy sauce, black pepper, garlic powder, baking soda, cornflour, and olive oil. Toss the beef until velvety, then set aside to marinate.
Prepare the black pepper sauce by whisking together beef broth, light and dark soy sauce, hoisin sauce, rice vinegar, black pepper, and cornflour in a separate bowl until smooth.

Heat a pan over high heat and add a little butter. Cook the marinated beef strips for 1–2 minutes per side until a golden, crispy crust forms. Remove the beef from the pan and set aside. Repeat for the remaining beef.
In the same pan, add sliced onions and bell peppers. Sauté for about 5 minutes until soft and fragrant, then return the crispy beef to the pan and pour in the black pepper sauce.
Stir the mixture and let it come to a gentle bubble so the sauce thickens slightly. Simmer on low heat for 3–5 minutes until everything is heated through, then remove from the heat and set aside.
For the garlic fried rice, heat another pan (or reuse the cleaned pan) over medium heat and melt a bit of butter. Sauté chopped garlic until golden and slightly crispy.
Add the leftover cooked rice along with a dash of soy sauce and red pepper flakes. Toss thoroughly until well combined. Serve the garlic rice alongside the black pepper beef and ENJOY!

notes: Use the “velveting” technique to tenderize the beef, helping it crisp up during cooking.
Preheat the pan with a little butter, sear the beef on high heat for 1–2 minutes per side until golden, then set aside.
After adding the sauce, let it simmer until thickened, ensuring the beef is well coated.
For garlic fried rice, sauté garlic in butter until lightly golden, then mix in the leftover rice.
Reheat in the microwave for 3–4 minutes or warm in a pan over low heat.

346.intro: Way better than ordering takeout, great macros & tastes even better the next day!

steps.text: Prepare the sauce by combining light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, honey, sweet chilli sauce, rice vinegar, chilli garlic paste, red pepper flakes, sesame seeds, and water in a bowl. Stir until well blended.

Heat a pan over medium-high heat and melt a little butter. Add all the ground beef and cook for 6–8 minutes until browned and most of the liquid evaporates, breaking it up with a spatula while it cooks.
Reduce the heat to medium and stir in half of the prepared sauce along with chopped green onions. Continue cooking for 5 minutes until the beef becomes golden and crispy, then transfer to a plate.
Cook the noodles by placing them in boiling water for 5 minutes. Drain immediately to prevent overcooking.

In the same pan, add chopped garlic, ginger, and green onions. Sauté for 3–4 minutes until fragrant, then add sliced red onions and bell peppers. Cook for an additional 5 minutes until the vegetables are soft.
Return the crispy beef to the pan and add the remaining sauce along with the cooked noodles and extra green onions. Toss gently until everything is evenly coated and heated through. Serve and ENJOY!

notes: Cook the beef over medium-high heat for 6–8 minutes until most of the liquid evaporates, allowing a good sear before adding the sauce.
After adding the sauce, cook for another 5 minutes until golden brown and crispy, then set aside.
This dish tastes even better after a day in the fridge. Reheat in the microwave or in a pan with a splash of water to restore moisture.

347.intro: If you love a classic bolognaise and love crispy potatoes, this dish is for you! The flavours are just incredible, the potatoes go So well with the beef.

steps.text: Wash the potatoes and cut them into small cubes. Finely chop the onions, celery, and garlic, and grate 2 medium carrots.
Place the potato cubes on a lined baking tray. Season with garlic powder, chilli flakes, paprika, oregano, basil, and a drizzle of olive oil. Toss until well coated.

Air fry or oven-bake the potatoes at 200°C (400°F) for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, heat a pan over medium heat, add light butter, and sauté the chopped onions, celery, garlic, and grated carrots for 5–6 minutes until soft.
Season the vegetable mix with salt and pepper, cook for another 2 minutes, then remove from the pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add a little extra light butter and increase the heat to medium-high. Cook the ground beef for 5–7 minutes, breaking it up with a spatula until slightly charred and fully cooked.
Stir in tomato paste, salt, basil, oregano, chilli flakes, and paprika, then add ½ cans of chopped tomatoes. Let the sauce simmer on low for 5 minutes, then stir in the reserved vegetable mix.
Mix thoroughly and add grated Parmesan. Cover the pan and simmer for 8–10 minutes to meld the flavors. Adjust seasoning and add a splash of water if needed.
Finally, add the crispy potatoes to the pan and gently fold them in until evenly combined. Top with mozzarella cheese and fresh parsley, cover until the cheese melts, then serve and ENJOY!

notes: Sauté the onions, carrots, and celery over medium heat for 5 minutes until softened, then set aside.
Sear the beef over medium-high heat for 5–6 minutes until browned; then stir in tomato paste, spices, and chopped tomatoes.
Return the sautéed celery mixture to the beef and simmer on low heat for 8–10 minutes to meld the flavors.
Air fry or bake the potatoes at 200°C for 18–20 minutes until crisp.
To reheat, warm the dish in a pan or microwave for 5 minutes.

348.intro: An incredibly delicious low carb and high protein meal, so filling and packed with flavour - This is perfect for meal prep and easy to make!

groups.name: Broccoli Mix
items: 1.5 Tsp Black Pepper 40g (1.4oz) Grated Parmigiano Reggiano
5 Whole Garlic Cloves (to roast for the white sauce)

steps.text: Butterfly cut the chicken breasts and season both sides evenly with oregano, garlic powder, chilli flakes, paprika, and olive oil. Set aside to marinate.
Wash and chop the broccoli into small florets. Place on a tray and toss with chilli flakes, garlic powder, salt, pepper, grated Parmesan, thinly sliced red onion, and olive oil.
Arrange 5 whole garlic cloves in the center of the tray. Air fry or oven bake the broccoli for 15–16 minutes at 200°C (400°F).
While the broccoli cooks, heat a pan over medium heat and cook the seasoned chicken for 5–6 minutes per side until golden and juicy. Let the chicken rest, then cut it into cubes.

Remove the roasted garlic cloves from the tray. In a blender, combine yogurt, mayo, the roasted garlic, crumbled feta, honey, and lemon juice. Blend until completely smooth to create your white sauce.

Layer the broccoli on a serving dish, top with the chicken cubes, and drizzle with the white sauce. Gently mix with two large spoons until well combined. Garnish with crushed walnuts and serve. ENJOY!

notes: For the juiciest chicken, cook on medium heat for 5–6 minutes per side, then let it rest before chopping into cubes.
Oven-bake or air-fry the broccoli at 200°C/400°F for 15–16 minutes, taking care not to burn it to avoid a bitter flavor.
This dish stores well in the fridge and tastes great cold, or reheat in the air fryer at 180°C/370°F for 5 minutes. It pairs wonderfully with sourdough bread.

349.intro: Tastes just like you’re eating a burger! One of the tastiest and easiest meal preps, high in protein and volume with low carbs and calories.

steps.text: Wash and slice the sweet potatoes into small cubes. Arrange them on a tray and season with salt, black pepper, garlic & onion powder, smoked paprika, and olive oil.
Toss the potatoes until evenly coated, then bake or air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 25–30 minutes until golden crispy.

Meanwhile, prepare the special sauce. In a bowl, combine light mayo, ketchup, yellow mustard, onion powder, black pepper, smoked paprika, and pickle juice. Mix until smooth. (You can bottle and refrigerate the sauce for later use)
For the pickle salad, shred the lettuce and combine it in a bowl with chopped red onion, tomatoes, and pickles. Toss well and set aside.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat and add butter. Cook the ground beef for 6–8 minutes until a deep, brown crust forms, stirring with a spatula to break up the meat. Season with salt and pepper.

Once the beef is cooked, add a little more butter to the pan and mix it through. Serve the beef (topped with a sprinkle of cheese, if desired) alongside the crispy sweet potatoes, fresh salad, and a generous drizzle of the special sauce. ENJOY!

notes: While the potatoes are cooking, prepare both the special sauce and salad to save time.
Be sure to include the pickle juice in the sauce—it adds a fantastic flavor. Bottle the sauce and store it in the fridge.
For the salad, store the lettuce separately from the other vegetables to prevent sogginess; combine them just before serving.
Reheat the beef and potatoes together on low heat in a pan or in an air fryer for 5 minutes.

350.intro: My twist on an absolute classic dish packed with lots of flavour, super simple to make with great macros and highly nutritious!

groups.name: Seasoned Potatoes
items: Optional 2 Tsp Olive Oil (or cooking spray)

steps.text: Slice the steaks into 1-inch cubes then season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, parsley, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until evenly coated then set aside.

Cut the potatoes into small cubes and season with salt, black pepper, cumin, paprika, and garlic powder. Add a drizzle of olive oil or use cooking spray. Toss well, then spread them on a lined baking sheet. Oven-bake or air-fry at 200°C (400°F) for 20–22 minutes until golden and crispy.
For the spicy sauce, blend together yogurt, light mayo, chipotle chilli paste, salt, paprika, and garlic powder until smooth and creamy. Transfer to a squeezy bottle for easy storage.

Heat a pan over high heat, melt some butter, and sear the seasoned steak bites for 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown and charred. Lower the heat, add fresh minced garlic and fresh parsley, and toss until coated in the garlicky butter then set aside.
In the same pan over medium-low heat, add whisked eggs and stir continuously until scrambled and fluffy. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Evenly distribute the steak bites, crispy potatoes, and scrambled eggs into 4 servings. Drizzle with the spicy sauce and ENJOY!

notes: Marinate the steak for 15-30mins to allow the seasonings to fully absorb.
Prepare the spicy sauce in batches—it can be stored in the fridge for weeks.
Cook the steak on high heat for 2 minutes per side to develop a flavorful crust.
Oven-bake or air-fry the potatoes at 200°C (400°F) for 20–22 minutes until crispy.
Cook the eggs over medium low heat, stirring continuously until fluffy.
To reheat, place everything in a pan before serving then drizzle with the spicy sauce.

351.intro: Easily one of the best mouthfuls you’ll have, super easy to make for the amount of flavour!

groups.name: Tender Beef Marinade
items: 800g (28oz) Raw Topside/Top Sirloin Beef, thinly sliced

groups.name: Golden Fried Rice Mix
items: 4 Whole Eggs (separate egg yolks from egg whites)

steps.text: Slice the beef into thin strips and place in a mixing bowl. Marinate with black pepper, light and dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, and baking soda. Mix thoroughly until velvety and well combined then set aside.
Separate the egg yolks from the whites. In a large bowl, combine the cooked rice with the yolks, mixing until every grain is coated in a golden yellow hue.

Heat a pan over medium-high heat and melt butter. Cook the marinated beef strips for 2–3 minutes per side until a crispy crust forms. Avoid overcrowding the pan to ensure even browning. Once cooked, set the beef aside.
In the same pan on medium-low heat, add the white parts of the green onion along with minced garlic. Sauté for 3–4 minutes until fragrant.
Push the sautéed onions and garlic to one side of the pan, then add the egg whites. Stir continuously until scrambled, then mix them with the onions.

Add the golden-coated rice to the pan, along with extra soy sauce, the green parts of the green onion, a small knob of butter, and the cooked beef. Give everything a thoroug mix until well combined and flavourful.
Serve and distribute evenly into 4 portions, add a drizzle of sriracha and your high protein meals are ready to enjoy!

notes: Marinate the beef for at least 30 minutes to enhance flavor and tenderness.
Mix the egg yolks into the cooked rice in a bowl first to ensure every grain is evenly coated before cooking.
Sear the steak strips in butter or olive oil over medium-high heat for 2–3 minutes per side until browned and crispy.

352.intro: One of the tastiest combos, the beef is so tender and goes perfectly with the noodles. Packed with flavour and lots of protein making this perfect for weight loss and meal prep for the week ahead!

groups.name: Mongolian Beef
items: 700g (25oz) Raw Topside/Top Sirloin Beef, cut into thin strips

groups.name: For the Sauce
items: Garnish with Chilli Flakes & Sesame Seeds

steps.text: Slice the beef steaks into extra-thin strips. Marinate with light and dark soy sauce, garlic powder, black pepper, baking soda, olive oil, and cornflour. Mix thoroughly until velvety and well coated, then let it marinate for 15 minutes.
While the beef marinates, cook the egg noodles according to packet instructions or boil for 4–5 minutes until slightly underdone. Drain and rinse under cold water to stop the cooking process.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat and spray with cooking oil. Cook the marinated beef for 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy, then set aside. Repeat for the remaining beef.

In the same pan over medium heat, add chopped garlic, the white part of the green onion, and red onion. Cook for 4–5 minutes until fragrant, then pour in soy sauce, oyster sauce, and water. Bring to a light simmer, then stir in a cornstarch slurry.
Let the sauce thicken slightly, then add the cooked beef, the green part of the green onion, and the cooked noodles. Toss everything together until fully combined and coated in the rich sauce.
Garnish with chili flakes and sesame seeds, then divide into 4 equal servings. ENJOY!

notes: Marinate the beef for at least 15 minutes to allow the baking soda to tenderize it properly.
Use cooking spray when searing the beef—cook for 2–3 minutes per side to avoid overcooking.
Let the sauce simmer and bubble before adding the cornflour slurry. Allow it to thicken for 2–3 minutes before returning the beef.
Cook the noodles as per packet instructions—I simmered mine in boiling water on low heat for 5–6 minutes.

353.intro: This has to be one of the best chicken & rice recipes, so much flavor, the perfect balance of sweet, spicy & savoury!

groups.name: Pickled Cucumbers
items: 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (omit for no spice)

groups.name: Serve With
items: 210g (7.4oz) Uncooked White Rice/560g Cooked Rice (140g per serving)

steps.text: Slice the chicken breasts into bite-sized cubes, then season with garlic powder, black pepper, paprika, salt, and cornflour. Mix until evenly coated then set aside.
Cook your rice by bringing a pot of water to a boil and simmering for 8–10 minutes until fully cooked. I use basmati rice, but jasmine rice works too! Once done, set aside.
Heat a pan over medium heat, add olive oil, and cook the coated chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden brown with a crispy crust. Set aside and repeat for any remaining chicken.

In the same pan on low heat, add soy sauce mixed with water, a drizzle of honey, and gochujang paste. Stir gently until smooth and well combined. Let it simmer for 2–3 minutes until thickened, then return the crispy chicken and mix until fully coated in the spicy glaze.

For the cucumber salad, thinly slice cucumber and place in a bowl. Add light & dark soy sauce, rice vinegar, garlic powder, chili flakes, and a generous amount of sesame seeds. Mix well until combined and fragrant. Serve alongside the glazed chicken and hot rice, then ENJOY!

notes: Ensure the chicken is fully coated in cornflour for extra crispiness, or skip it if unavailable.
When making the glaze, add ingredients over low heat, stirring continuously until it lightly bubbles, then let it reduce for 3–4 minutes until thickened.
Store the cucumber salad separately and reheat the meal without it—it’s best served cold.

354.intro: Everyone loves Biryani, this is absolutely flavour packed with incredible macros making this an absolute treat for your weight loss journey.

steps.text: Slice the chicken breasts into medium cubes. Marinate with minced garlic and ginger, garam masala, salt, paprika, cumin, turmeric, yogurt, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly then set aside to marinate for 30 minutes or overnight for best flavour.
Meanwhile, wash and cook the basmati rice, then thinly slice the red onions and chop up the tomatoes to use for later.

Spread the sliced onions on a lined baking tray, spray with a little olive oil, and toss to coat. Oven-bake or air-fry at 190°C (380°F) for 10–12 minutes until golden and crispy. Keep an eye on them to prevent burning.
While the onions cook, heat a pan over medium high heat, melt some butter, and cook the marinated chicken cubes for 4 minutes per side until golden brown and charred.
Once cooked, lower the heat, then add half of the crispy onions, the chopped tomatoes, freshly chopped coriander, extra salt to taste, and garam masala.

Give this a thorough mix until combined, cover, and cook on low heat for 10 minutes until the tomatoes break down into a thick curry sauce. Use a spatula to help mash them. This will smell incredibly fragrant!

Once the chicken curry is ready, start layering in the pan: chicken mix, rice, lemon slices, crispy onions, and chopped coriander. Repeat the layers once more and finsih the last layer with saffron infused water.
Cover for 5-10 mins on low heat to let the flavours intensify between the layers. Once done, you’re ready to serve and divide evenly into 4 portions and ENJOY!

355.intro: Absolutely incredible flavours, so indulgent, macro friendly & easy to meal prep! This can be made with your protein of choice, i made it with salmon but is perfect with chicken too!

steps.text: Slice the skinless salmon into equal fillets/steaks. Season both sides with garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. Rub the spices in evenly for maximum flavor absorption.
Heat a pan over medium heat, add a little olive oil, and cook the seasoned salmon for 4–5 minutes per side until beautifully golden brown and seared. Set aside to rest, keeping it warm.

While the salmon cooks, prepare your noodles according to package instructions or boil for 5 minutes until slightly underdone (they’ll finish cooking in the sauce). Drain and rinse under cold water to stop the cooking process, then set aside.

In the same pan over medium-low heat, sauté chopped garlic for 2 minutes until fragrant. Add chili garlic paste and light coconut milk, then season with salt, black pepper, and paprika. Simmer for 4–5 minutes until slightly thickened.
Add the cooked noodles, chopped green onion, and light & dark soy sauce. Mix gently until combined, then let it simmer for 3-4 minutes to thicken further.
Serve and divide the creamy noodles with the juicy seared salmon on top into 4 portions, and ENJOY!

notes: Follow the packet instructions for cooking the noodles (I simmered mine for 5 minutes).
After adding the coconut milk, bring it to a light bubble before adding the noodles. Once added, mix well and let it simmer for a few minutes to thicken the sauce.
Serve the salmon on top and enjoy! For meal prep, store the salmon and noodles separately for easier reheating.

356.intro: Crispy chicken coated in a low calorie dynamite sauce paired with seasoned fries - doesn’t get better than this.

groups.name: Crispy Fries
items: 2 Tsp Olive Oil or Cooking Spray

steps.text: Slice the chicken breasts into cubes and season with oregano, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, soy sauce, and cornflour. Mix thoroughly until evenly coated.

Cut the potatoes into fries, then season with salt, pepper, oregano, paprika, garlic powder, and olive oil. Mix well, then spread on a lined baking tray then oven-bake or air fry for 20-22 minutes at 200°C (400°F) until golden and crispy.
For the dynamite sauce, combine mayo, chili garlic sauce, sriracha, sweet chili sauce, and lemon juice in a bowl. Mix until smooth and set aside.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat, add a little olive oil, and cook the seasoned chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden and a crispy crust forms then set aside. Repeat for the remaining chicken.
Mix in the cooked juicy chicken in the dynamite sauce until fully coated and indulgent.
Distribute the crispy fries and saucy dynamite chicken into 4 equal servings, garnish with green onion and sesame seeds, then ENJOY!

notes: Ensure the chicken is well coated in cornflour for the crispiest texture.
To reduce calories, skip the cornflour—the chicken will still be flavorful!
If air frying, use cooking spray instead of olive oil and avoid over-seasoning the fries.
Make the dynamite sauce in batches for easy storage; swap chili garlic sauce for chili flakes and garlic powder if needed.

357.intro: One of the most indulgent combos, having both orange chicken and noodles together makes this such a treat!

groups.name: Noodles & Garnish
items: Sprinkle Chilli Flakes (omit for less heat)

steps.text: Slice the chicken breasts into bite-sized cubes. Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and cornflour. Mix thoroughly until well coated, then set aside.
Cook the egg noodles according to packet instructions. Once done, rinse under cold water to stop the cooking process, then set aside.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat, add olive oil, and cook the seasoned chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden and a crispy crust forms. Set aside and repeat with any remaining chicken.
In the same pan over medium heat, add chopped garlic, ginger, and chili flakes. Cook for 2 minutes until fragrant, then stir in orange juice, soy sauce, honey, and orange zest.
Let the sauce bubble and reduce for 5 minutes on medium-low heat. Once it slightly thickens, add a cornstarch slurry (water mixed with cornstarch), stirring until the sauce further thickens.
Return the crispy chicken to the pan and coat it well in the sauce. Add the cooked noodles and chopped green onion, then mix everything until well combined and evenly coated.
Finally garnish with sesame seeds and chili flakes, divide into 4 portions, and ENJOY!

notes: Make sure the chicken pieces are evenly coated with corn flour
Cook the noodles in advance, according to packet instructions. I put mine in boiled water for 4-5 mins
Rinse the noodles in cold water after cooked to stop the cooking process
Let the orange juice reduce and thicken

358.intro: Low effort with maximum taste while keeping the calories low, doesn’t get better than this!

groups.name: Garlic Steak Bites
items: 800g (28oz) Raw Topside/ Top Sirloin Beef, cubed
2 Tsp Mixed Herbs (Parsley, Oregano, Thyme, Rosemary)

steps.text: Slice the beef steaks into 1-inch cubes and place them in a mixing bowl. Add minced garlic, salt, black pepper, mixed herbs, smoked paprika, and olive oil. Mix well until evenly coated, then set aside.

Slice the potatoes into small cubes, then season with garlic powder, mixed herbs, smoked paprika, and olive oil. Toss to coat, then spread evenly on a lined baking tray. Bake in a preheated oven or air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 20–23 minutes until golden and crispy.

While the potatoes cook, heat a pan over medium-high heat, melt some butter, and sear the seasoned steak bites for 3 minutes per side until a golden-brown crust forms. Remove from the pan and set aside. Repeat for the remaining steak bites.

In the same pan over medium heat, add chopped onions, mushrooms, and cherry tomatoes. Cook for 5 minutes until softened, then lower the heat and stir in milk, cream cheese, and grated parmesan. Stir continuously for 3–4 minutes until the sauce is smooth, thick, and creamy.

Add a squeeze of lemon juice for tanginess, then return the steak bites and crispy potatoes to the pan. Stir everything together until fully incorporated. Sprinkle cheddar cheese and chili flakes, then serve and ENJOY!

notes: Marinate the steak bites for at least 30 minutes, or overnight, for deeper flavor.
Sauté the onions, mushrooms, and tomatoes for 5–8 minutes until softened before adding the milk and cream cheese.
Lower the heat when adding milk and cream cheese to prevent the sauce from splitting.
Let the creamy sauce come to a light bubble, then add lemon juice for a tangy kick.
This meal prep freezes well for weeks and reheats easily in a pan or microwave while staying fresh and flavorful.

359.intro: This flavour combo is incredible! Shawarma spiced chicken paired with a creamy butter chicken sauce, golden rice and a fresh side salad.

groups.name: Chicken Shawarma
items: 800g (28oz) Raw Chicken Breast, cut into thin strips

groups.name: Side Salad
items: 1/2 Tsp each: Salt, Pepper, Garlic Powder

steps.text: Slice the chicken breasts into thin strips, then marinate with minced garlic, tomato paste, salt, pepper, onion powder, cinnamon, paprika, olive oil, and lemon juice. Mix thoroughly and let it marinate.
For the golden rice, bring a pot of water to a boil and add raw basmati rice with salt, turmeric, and paprika. Stir and cook for 8–10 minutes until fully cooked and fluffy.
Lay the marinated chicken flat on a lined sheet pan, ensuring an even layer, then oven bake or air fry at 190°C (375°F) for 12–15 minutes until golden brown and slightly charred.
While the chicken cooks, heat a pan over medium heat, melt some butter, and sauté sliced onions for 5 minutes until soft. Add fresh tomatoes, cashew nuts, and butter chicken seasoning.
Mix well and let it cook for 5–7 minutes on medium-low heat until the tomatoes break down. Lower the heat and stir in yogurt until fully combined.
Allow the mixture to cool, then blend for 3–4 minutes until completely smooth.
Reheat the sauce in a pan before serving, or store it in a squeeze bottle for easy use.
By now, the chicken shawarma should be done. Prepare the quick side salad, then serve everything evenly with golden rice and a generous drizzle of butter chicken sauce. Enjoy

notes: Marinate the chicken overnight for maximum flavor.
Oven bake for 15 minutes at 190°C (375°F) or air fry for 12 minutes at the same temperature.
Cook the golden rice while the chicken is in the oven or air fryer to save time.
Prepare the butter chicken sauce first before cooking the chicken and rice for better workflow.
Add a splash of milk before blending the butter chicken sauce for a smoother consistency.
Store the sauce in a squeeze bottle for easy serving or spoon it over when ready to eat.

360.intro: If I had to choose one food to eat forever, it would always be pasta This Chicken Alfredo is incredibly delicious, so creamy and easy to meal prep!

groups.name: Alfredo Sauce
items: 1 Tsp each: Italian Herbs, Salt, Black Pepper

steps.text: Slice the chicken breasts into thinner fillets, then season both sides with Italian herbs, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, pepper, and olive oil. Rub the seasoning in evenly, then set aside.
Cook the pasta. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil, add the spaghetti pasta, and cook for 8 minutes until al dente. Reserve some pasta water, then drain the rest.
Prepare the Alfredo sauce by blending milk, cream cheese, parmesan, Italian herbs, salt, pepper, and the reserved pasta water until smooth. Then set aside.
Heat a pan over medium heat with a little olive oil. Cook the seasoned chicken for 3–4 minutes per side until golden brown. Keep an eye on the spices to prevent burning. Once done, set aside.

In the same pan, sauté chopped garlic and onion over medium heat for 2–3 minutes until fragrant. Lower the heat, then pour in the blended Alfredo sauce. Stir continuously with a whisk until thick and creamy.
Add the cooked spaghetti to the sauce, mixing gently until fully coated. Serve with the sliced chicken, garnish with parsley, and drizzle with extra sauce. Enjoy!

notes: Ensure both sides of the chicken are evenly coated with seasoning.
Cook the chicken over medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes per side to prevent the seasoning from burning.
When adding the Alfredo sauce, keep the heat on low and stir gently until it thickens, then mix in the cooked pasta.

361.intro: One of the easiest and tastiest meals, better than any takeout with more protein and better macros!

groups.name: Chicken Marinade
items: 700g (25oz) Raw Chicken Breast, cut into thin strips

groups.name: Chow Mein Noodles + Sauce
items: 220g (7.8oz) Uncooked Egg Noodles (or noodles of choice)

steps.text: Slice the chicken breasts into thin strips and place them in a mixing bowl. Marinate with paprika, black pepper, garlic powder, and light & dark soy sauce. Mix thoroughly and let sit for a few minutes to deepen the flavour.

Slice the red onion, bell pepper, and green onion. Cook the noodles according to package instructions—I boiled and simmered them in water for 4–5 minutes. Drain, rinse under cold water, and set aside.
Heat a pan over medium heat, add cooking spray or olive oil, and cook the marinated chicken for 6-8 minutes until golden brown and slightly charred. Set aside and repeat if needed.

In the same pan over medium-high heat, stir-fry the sliced onion, bell pepper, and green onion for 5 minutes till fragrant. Add minced garlic, soy sauce, oyster sauce, rice vinegar, and the cooked noodles. Mix gently but thoroughly until well combined.
Finally add the cooked chicken and bean sprouts, mix again, then garnish with sesame seeds and chili flakes. Distribute into 4 servings and ENJOY!

notes: Marinate the chicken for at least 30 minutes for deeper flavor.
Cook the noodles according to package instructions—I simmered them in boiling water for 4–5 minutes.
Prep all vegetables before cooking the chicken to streamline the process.
Adjust seasoning by adding extra soy sauce or oyster sauce after mixing in the cooked noodles.

362.intro: One of the most popular meals from Chipotle, packed with lots of flavor, perfect for weight loss and so easy to meal prep for the week!

groups.name: Chipotle Steak
items: 800g (28oz) Raw Topside/Top Sirloin Beef 1 Inch Thick Steaks

groups.name: Creamy Avocado Sauce
items: 1/2 Tsp each: Garlic Powder, Salt, Black Pepper

groups.name: Coriander Lime Rice
items: 210g (7.4oz) Uncooked Basmati Rice (or rice of choice)

365.intro: A classic one pan dish that makes eating healthy a joy. No more boring chicken & rice!

Heat a pan over medium heat and add a drizzle of olive oil or cooking spray. Cook the seasoned chicken for about 7–8 minutes, turning occasionally until golden brown and fully cooked through. Once done, remove from the pan and set aside.

In the same pan, add chopped onions and bell peppers. Sauté for 2–3 minutes until slightly soft. Then add black beans (drained and rinsed), uncooked washed rice, and all the extra seasoning for added flavor.

Toast the rice with the veggies and beans for 1–2 minutes. Pour in canned chopped tomatoes and water (enough to cover the rice by about 1 inch). Stir well and bring to a gentle boil. Cover with a lid and simmer on low heat for 12–15 minutes until the rice is fully cooked and fluffy. Stir halfway through to ensure even cooking and prevent sticking.
Once the rice is cooked, add the cooked chicken back in, along with chopped fresh coriander. Mix everything thoroughly until well combined. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed.
Divide evenly into 4 portions, garnish with extra coriander or lime wedges if desired, and ENJOY!

notes: Toast the uncooked rice with spices for 1–2 minutes to enhance flavor before adding liquids.
After adding water, stir well, cover, and simmer on low heat for 12–15 minutes until fully cooked. Stir halfway through to prevent sticking.

366.intro: This is easily one of the BEST meal preps i’ve ever made! The flavour combinations are truly incredible. Shawarma is the most popular fast food dish.

While the chicken is marinating, slice the potatoes into fries and lay them flat on a lined baking tray. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, paprika, and olive oil, then toss to coat evenly. Bake or air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 20–25 minutes until golden and crispy, flipping halfway if needed.
Take a loaf tin and layer the marinated chicken slices tightly, stacking them to fill the tin completely. Bake for 25 minutes at 200°C (400°F) until cooked through and juicy with a golden top.
Once the chicken is done, let it rest for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare the garlic sauce and crunchy slaw using the ingredients listed (optional: make these ahead for quicker assembly).
After resting, thinly slice the stacked chicken to reveal shawarma-style strips. Serve alongside the crispy fries, pickles, slaw, and drizzle generously with garlic sauce. Enjoy!

notes: Marinate the chicken as long as possible — overnight for best flavor.
When layering the chicken, stack tightly to avoid pieces falling to the sides. You can also use a regular baking dish if you don’t have a loaf tin.
Bake the fries for 25 minutes or air fry for 15 minutes at 200°C / 400°F.
Cook the chicken and fries together in the oven for 25 minutes to save time.
Once the chicken is cooked and slightly cooled, slice thinly using a sharp knife and serve.

367.intro: One of the most popular takeout meals, packed with fresh flavours, indulgent and easy to make!

368.intro: One of the most incredible combos, perfectly cooked steak with a creamy fajita pasta. Indulgent and a perfect way to add steak to your meal preps.

Salsa verde or simple blended green sauce

380.intro: Fresh, zesty and slightly spicy with a vibrant citrus kick. Pairs perfectly with rice, salads, or light sauces for a refreshing, flavourful meal.

steps.title: PREP & MARINATE THE CHICKEN
steps.text: Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs and place them in a large mixing bowl. Add salt, black pepper, minced garlic, chilli flakes, smoked paprika, honey, lime zest, lime juice, and light soy sauce. Mix thoroughly with your hands until the chicken is fully coated and the colour deepens. Set aside to marinate for at least 30 minutes (longer gives deeper flavour).

steps.title: MAKE THE AHI VERDE SAUCE
steps.text: In a blender, combine Greek yogurt, light mayo, honey, deseeded green chilli, fresh coriander, salt, and pepper. Blend until completely smooth, then bottle and refrigerate for the week.

steps.title: COOK THE CHICKEN
steps.text: Spread the marinated chicken thighs evenly on a lined sheet pan, ensuring they sit in a single layer for even browning. Oven bake or air fry at 200°C / 400°F for 20-22 minutes, until juicy with lightly charred edges.

steps.title: REST & STORE THE CHICKEN
steps.text: Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes to retain its juices. For meal prep, store the chicken whole in airtight glass containers and include all resting juices for maximum flavour and moisture. Slice into cubes only when serving.

serve: With cilantro lime rice and fresh pico de gallo
With crispy air fried seasoned potatoes
In a mexican-style salad bowl with black beans, corn, and cucumber
sauces: Ahi verde creamy sauce (included in this recipe)
Chipotle yogurt sauce (yogurt, chipotle, lime)
Lime-garlic crema (yogurt, garlic, lime juice)

381.intro: Sweet, spicy and packed with crispy chilli oil flavour and crunch. Perfect with rice and fresh toppings to balance richness and heat.

groups.name: Honey Chilli Crisp Chicken
items: 1500g (53oz / 3.3lbs) Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat
80g (2.1oz) Chilli Crisp Oil, to keep mostly the crisp well

steps.title: PREP & MARINATE THE CHICKEN
steps.text: Trim any excess fat from the boneless chicken thighs, then place them in a mixing bowl. Add salt, black pepper, garlic powder, paprika, chilli crisp (mostly the crisp, minimal oil), and honey. Mix thoroughly with your hands until the chicken is evenly coated and the colour deepens. Set aside to marinate for at least 30 minutes.

steps.title: COOK THE CHICKEN
steps.text: Spread the marinated chicken thighs evenly on a lined sheet pan. Oven bake or air fry at 190°C / 385°F for 16-18 minutes, until golden brown, juicy, and lightly charred on the edges.

steps.title: REST & STORE THE CHICKEN (KEEP THIGHS WHOLE)
steps.text: Once the chicken is cooked, allow it to rest for 5 minutes. For meal prep purposes, keep the chicken whole to retain maximum juiciness throughout the week. Pour all the tray juices over the thighs - this adds flavour, prevents drying, and enhances the honey chilli glaze as it cools. Slice into cubes only when serving to maintain the best texture and moisture. Enjoy your flavour packed, high protein chicken for the week!

serve: With coconut rice and a pineapple, avocado, cucumber salsa
With jasmine rice and quick pickled cucumbers
In a warm wrap with shredded cabbage and lime
sauces: Honey chilli yogurt drizzle (yogurt, lime, honey, pinch of chilli flakes)
Chilli-lime mayo (olive-oil-based mayo, lime juice, garlic)
Cilantro yogurt sauce (yogurt, coriander, lime, garlic, pinch of salt)

382.intro: Sweet, savoury and umami-rich with a glossy Korean style glaze. Works perfectly with rice, vegetables, and a drizzle of spicy creamy sauce.

steps.title: MAKE THE KOREAN MARINADE
steps.text: In a mixing bowl, combine light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, honey, minced garlic, and gochujang. Mix until smooth and fully combined. This marinade will be used for both the beef and optional rice.

steps.title: COOK THE BEEF
steps.text: Heat a pan over medium-high heat. Add a small amount of olive oil if needed, then cook the 1000g minced beef for about 6-8 minutes, breaking it apart with a spatula until fully browned with no pink remaining.

steps.title: ADD THE MARINADE & STORE
steps.text: Lower the heat to medium, then add half of the prepared Korean sauce, the chopped green onions, and sesame seeds. Stir well and cook for 4-5 minutes until the beef becomes glossy, golden, and slightly caramelised. Once done, remove from heat and transfer the cooked beef into airtight glass containers, spreading it evenly so it cools quickly before storing for meal prep.

serve: With steamed jasmine rice and cucumbers
With kimchi and stir-fried veggies
In lettuce cups with rice and sliced green onion
sauces: Spicy korean sauce (included in this recipe)
Gochujang yogurt drizzle (yogurt, gochujang, lime)
Honey-soy garlic sauce (honey, soy, garlic)

383.intro: Simple, clean and flavourful with a rich garlic and herb profile. A versatile option that pairs well with almost anything from rice to potatoes and salads.

steps.title: MARINATE THE CHICKEN
steps.text: Place the chicken thighs in a large mixing bowl. Add garlic paste, salt, black pepper, mixed herbs, parsley, paprika, chilli flakes, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until every piece is coated and the colour deepens. Set aside to marinate.

steps.title: COOK UNTIL GOLDEN
steps.text: Heat a pan over medium heat and melt the butter. Add the chicken thighs in a single layer and cook for 5-6 minutes per side until a deep golden crust forms and the chicken is cooked through. Remove and set aside to rest, then repeat with the remaining chicken.

steps.title: MEAL PREP STORAGE
steps.text: Keep the chicken whole for storing (this prevents moisture loss). Let it rest fully, then transfer the thighs to airtight glass containers along with the buttery pan juices for flavour. Slice into cubes only when serving to keep each portion juicy and tender. ENJOY!

serve: Creamy mashed potatoes (with garlic, butter, and a splash of warm milk)
Parmesan butter rice (fragrant, golden, and ultra comforting)
sauces: Creamy garlic mushroom sauce
Lemon herb yogurt sauce
Parmesan cream sauce (lightened with milk or broth)

384.intro: Bold, cheesy and loaded with Tex-Mex flavour. Perfect for loaded bowls with chips, fresh salsa, and creamy nacho cheese sauce.

items: 1/2-1 Tsp Chilli Powder (adjust heat to preference) For 1400g beef, you will use 3 of this spice mix.

steps.title: COOK THE BEEF
steps.text: Heat a large pan over medium high heat, add the butter, then cook the ground beef for 5-7 minutes, breaking it apart with a spatula until fully browned with no pink remaining.

steps.title: ADD SEASONINGS
steps.text: Once browned, stir in the taco spice mix, tomato paste, chopped jalapeños, and jalapeño juice. Cook for 2 more minutes until the flavours intensify and the beef turns juicy and fragrant. Set aside.

steps.title: MAKE THE NACHO CHEESE SAUCE
steps.text: Using the same pan on low heat, add the evaporated milk, American cheese slices, cheddar, and a splash of jalapeño juice (optional). Stir continuously until the cheese melts and the sauce becomes silky and smooth. Transfer to a container and refrigerate for later use.

In a loaded salad bowl with black beans, corn, salsa, and crisp lettuce

385.intro: One of the tastiest and most flavorful recipes I’ve made! Perfect for meal prep and weight loss.

groups.name: Special Garlic White Sauce
items: 25g (1oz) Pickle Juice (add to your desired consistency) (big batch, store separately)

steps.text: Place boneless, skinless chicken thighs into a large mixing bowl. Add minced garlic, your homemade shawarma spice mix, tomato paste, olive oil, and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice. Mix thoroughly until the chicken is evenly coated and vibrant in colour. Set aside to marinate for at least 30 minutes-or longer for deeper flavour. Be patient-it’s worth it!

For the garlic white sauce, combine yogurt, light mayo, honey, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and a splash of pickle juice for added tang. Mix until smooth and creamy, then bottle it up and store in the fridge. It’ll keep well for multiple meals throughout the week.

Heat a pan on medium, melt a knob of butter, then sauté minced garlic and chopped onions for 5–6 minutes until softened and fragrant. Add turmeric, smoked paprika, and salt, then stir until the onions take on a deep yellow colour. Add washed basmati rice and toast for 2–3 minutes to build flavour. Pour in double the amount of water (e.g. 1 cup rice = 2 cups water),bring to a gentle bubble, stir once, cover with a lid, and reduce to a low simmer for 10– 12 minutes. Check halfway and gently mix to avoid sticking and ensure even cooking.

Spread the marinated chicken thighs evenly on a lined sheet pan. Bake or air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 20–23 minutes until golden, slightly charred, and juicy. Once cooked, let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing into bite-size cubes.

To make the slaw, combine thinly sliced red onion, halved cherry tomatoes, chopped pickled gherkins, and fresh parsley in a bowl. Season with salt, black pepper, sumac, and a drizzle of olive oil. Toss until fully combined. For meal prep, store this slaw in a separate container to keep it crisp and fresh.

To serve, divide the golden turmeric rice into 5 meal prep containers with the juicy shawarma chicken, a portion of the fresh slaw, and finish with a generous drizzle of the garlic white sauce. Your high-protein shawarma bowls are prepped and ready to ENJOY!

386.intro: Perfect for a 10 mins Breakfast! If you’re looking for a super quick but delicious breakfast you need to try this! Taste to effort ratio is crazy!

items: 2 Whole eggs + 2 Egg Whites (you can use all egg whites)

steps.text: Preheat your oven or air fryer to 180°C (350°F). Line a circular baking dish or pan with baking paper, then gently press a tortilla wrap into the dish, shaping it to fit the base and sides like a crust.

Pour the whisked eggs into the tortilla base. Evenly distribute chopped cherry tomatoes, bell pepper, and red onion over the top. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, and chilli flakes, then sprinkle a generous layer of cheese.
Bake or air fry for about 10 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the cheese is melted and golden.
Remove from the oven, let it cool slightly, then slice into portions and serve warm. Enjoy!
